V6
Which of the following is the next best step in the management 
of this patient?

options.text: Drawing blood cultures and starting antibiotics
Placement of a magnet over the pacemaker

correctAnswer: Placement of a magnet over the pacemaker
englishExplanation:
This patient has a pacemaker with an inappropriately fast 
rate due to a pacemaker-mediated tachycardia. Management of this condition involves disruption of the circuit and can be accomplished by placing 
a magnet over the pacemaker, which sets the pacemaker into an asynchronous mode with no sensing (e.g., DOO). Cardioversion and amiodarone are 
less appropriate in this situation. Consultation with a cardiologist and interrogation of the pacemaker should be performed, although this can be done 
after placement of a magnet over the pacemaker. In the absence of potential 
for pacemaker infection, there is no role for blood cultures or antibiotics
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هالمريضة عندها pacemaker من نوع dual-chamber وبطلت تشتغل بشكل طبيعي، وبيبيّن عليها pacemaker-mediated tachycardia يعني النبض صار سريع بشكل مش مناسب للجهاز. هاد بيحصل لأن الجهاز يعمل circuit، فحله بيتم لمّا تحط magnet فوق الـ pacemaker، وهاد بيحوّل الجهاز لوضع asynchronous بدون sensing، يعني DOO، وبهيك ينقطع الـ circuit. لازم كمان ترجعي للـ cardiologist وتعمل interrogation للجهاز بعد وضع الـ magnet، بس هاد مش بيأخر العلاج.
الفخ: خريجي immediate cardioversion أو amiodarone بيروحوا على synchronised cardioversion لأن المريض خايف وقلبه سريع. بس هاد مش tachycardia عادية، الجهاز هو اللي عامل الـ circuit، ومفيش indication لأخذ blood cultures أو antibiotics لأنه ما في شك بـ infection.

question:
A 68-year-old ED patient with a history of HFrEF presents with 
3 weeks progressive edema and exertional dyspnea, pulmonary 
edema on portable CXR, respiratory rate 35, BP 128/67, and SpO2 
86% on room air. Last week his cardiologist increased his home dose 
of furosemide from 40 mg PO daily to 40 mg BID, with unchanged 
urine output and no improvement in symptoms. Which of the following is the best step in management?

options.text: Nasal cannula oxygen, 160 mg IV push furosemide now
Nasal cannula oxygen, 60 mg IV push furosemide only if creatinine is not elevated from baseline
BiPAP, 160 mg IV push furosemide now
BiPAP, 60 mg IV push furosemide only if creatinine is not elevated from baseline

correctAnswer: BiPAP, 160 mg IV push furosemide now
englishExplanation:
This patient presents with hypoxia, tachypnea, and other 
signs of respiratory failure, and noninvasive positive-pressure ventilation (NPPV) such as CPAP or BiPAP should be the first-line resuscitative therapy. Although nasal cannula may sufficiently reverse the 
hypoxia, NPPV has beneficial effects on work of breathing and possibly 
on AHF hemodynamics. IV furosemide dosing should be 1 to 2.5 times 
the patient’s daily home PO dose (or 40–80 mg IV if they do not take 
furosemide). Because this patient was recently increased to 80 mg, a 
dose of 80–200 mg IV would be possible. Additionally, since the change 
resulted in no change in symptoms at home, this would suggest the 
patient is experiencing some aspect of acute cardiorenal dysfunction, 
loop diuretic resistance, or both. Thus, a dose at the higher end of the 
acceptable range is likely advisable. Finally, elevations in creatinine due 
to acute cardiorenal syndrome are usually due to congestion, and if 
creatinine rises further after IV loop diuresis this typically represents 
a transient response not associated with long-term renal dysfunction. 
In other words, waiting for a creatinine level is not necessary in most 
cases, because worsening creatinine after furosemide rarely represents 
a true acute kidney injury. By contrast, delayed administration of furosemide in AHF is associated with adverse outcomes.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده HFrEF ومعاه worsening edema وdyspnea exertional وpulmonary edema على الصورة، مع respiratory rate 35 وSpO2 86% على هواء الغرفة. هاد كله علامات respiratory failure، والـ noninvasive positive-pressure ventilation زي CPAP أو BiPAP هي first-line resuscitative therapy لأنها بتخفف شغل التنفس وبتحسن الـ hemodynamics. جرعة الـ IV furosemide لازم تكون من 1 إلى 2.5 ضعف جرعة الـ home اليومية، أي 80 لـ 200 mg، لأن مريضه خلا من جرعة 80 mg وما استجاب.
الفخ: خريجي nasal cannula والجرعة المترددة بيعتمدوا إن الـ creatinine لازم يطلع قبل ما تعطي furosemide. بس ارتفاع الـ creatinine بعد الـ IV diuresis غالباً مؤقت بسبب الـ congestion، والتأخير عن الـ BiPAP والجرعة الكاملة بيسبّئ النتائج.

question:
A 65-year-old woman presents to the emergency department (ED) 
with chief complaint of elevated blood pressure, which was discovered at her dentist’s office prior to a routine dental procedure. Her 
blood pressure upon admission is 187/101 mm Hg. Otherwise, the 
patient has no acute complaints, however, she does note chronic 
low grade chronic headaches and intermittent blurry vision. She has 
had previous readings of mildly elevated blood pressure at church 
health fairs, although was never formally diagnosed, and does take 
medication. Which of the following steps would be appropriate in 
the context of and ED visit?

options.text: Obtain a CT of the head to rule out intracranial pathology.
Administer a short-acting antihypertensive to reduce her blood
Prescribe a diuretic such as chlothalidone or hydrochlorothiazide, and refer to outpatient follow up with a hospital affiliated
Discharge home with instructions to follow up with a primary

correctAnswer: Discharge home with instructions to follow up with a primary
englishExplanation:
Most patients who are found to have significantly elevated BP on intake vital signs measurement or who come to the ED 
because BP was found to be elevated in an outpatient setting or by selfmeasurement do not have an acute hypertensive emergency. While 
many patients have vague symptoms, such as headache or mild blurry 
vision, these symptoms do not correlate with the degree of hypertension. For such patients, a head CT or acute reduction of BP is not 
indicated and offers no tangible outcome benefit. This patient has a 
physician and is already on medication. As such, there is no indication 
to start a new medication or make a new referral at this time.
   
   	 C H A P T E R 7 0 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d

998.e1
REFERENCES
arabicExplanation:
ليش: معظم المرضى اللي بيلاقوا ارتفاع كبير بالـ BP وقت الفحص أو بيجوا الـ ED لأن الـ BP انقياس عالية برا مش عندهم hypertensive emergency. عندها الـ headache والـ blurry vision الخفيف اللي عندها ما بيرتبطوا بدرجة الـ hypertension. كمان مريضة عندها دكتور وعمها على دواء، فما في داعي تبدأ دواء جديد أو تحوّلها على specialist. كل اللي لازم يصير هو ترتيب متابعة مع الـ primary care provider.
الفخ: خريجي CT للـ head أو إنك تنزل الـ BP بسرعة بيروحوا على emergency hypertension. بس بلا علامات خطر مقلوبة على الأعضاء المستهدفة، الـ CT ما بيقدّم فائدة، وخفض الـ BP بسرعة ممكن يكون ضار.

question:
The connective tissue disorder responsible for the most cases of 
acute aortic dissection is:
englishExplanation:
Marfan syndrome is the connective tissue disease most 
commonly associated with acute aortic dissection.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: Marfan syndrome هي أكثر connective tissue disease مرتبطة بـ acute aortic dissection. هاد معناها إنها السبب الأكثر شيوعاً للـ dissection الحاد، بينما Ehlers-Danlos type I وtype IV وLoeys-Dietz syndrome أقل تكراراً بهاد المجال. كل الخيارات اضطرابات نسيج رابط، بس Marfan هي اللي عندها أعلى ارتباط مع الـ acute aortic dissection. وهاد اللي بنحفظه للامتحان.
الفخ: خريجي Ehlers-Danlos type IV وLoeys-Dietz syndrome بيعتقدوا إنهم الأقوى ارتباطاً لأنهم أقل شيوعاً وأخطر. بس التكرار هو المعيار، وهون Marfan هي اللي بتغلّب. لأن السؤال صريح عن أكثر الحالات، مش عن أخطرها.

question: What is the most frequent site of acute arterial embolic occlusion?
englishExplanation:
The bifurcation of the common femoral artery accounts 
for 35% to 50% of acute arterial occlusion due to arterial embolism. 
Embolic occlusion most often occurs at major arterial bifurcations 
because of the sudden change in vessel diameter at these locations.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: أكثر مكان يصير فيه occlusion حاد بسبب embolus هو الـ bifurcation بتاع الـ common femoral artery، وبيحساب لنص الحالات تقريباً. السبب إن الـ embolus بيقف عند أكبر نقاط الـ splitting، وهاد بيصير لأن قطر الشريان بيتغيّر فجأة بهالمواقع. وهاد المبدأ بينطبق على كل الـ major arterial bifurcations مش بس الفمورال، لأن الـ sudden change in vessel diameter هو العامل المشترك.
الفخ: خريجي popliteal artery أو carotid artery بيعتقدوا إنهم أشد إصابات، بس الـ embolus بيتعلق بأماكن الـ splitting. الـ common femoral بيحسب 35% إلى 50% من الحالات، فهاد الرقم هو المفتاح.

question:
A supine patient is asked to raise his foot 12 inches above the estimated level of the right atrium and dorsiflex the foot five or six 
times. He is then brought to a sitting position with his feet hanging. 
In the absence of severe advanced ischemia, venous filling of the 
foot should return in less than how many seconds?
englishExplanation:
This bedside test is Buerger sign and can provide reliable 
evidence of advanced ischemia. In the absence of severe advanced 
ischemia, the lower extremity veins should fill within 20 seconds after 
being placed in the dependent position.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الفحص السريري اسمه Buerger sign، وبيعطي دليل موثوق على وجود ischemia متقدمة بالطرف. بينعمل إنك ترفع رجل المريض 12 إنش فوق مستوى الـ right atrium التقديري وتنوي رجله خمس أو ست مرات، وبعدين تجيبه لوضعية sitting ورجله معلّقة. إذا ما في ischemia متقدمة شديدة، الـ veins دي لازم تمتلئ خلال أقل من 20 ثانية.
الفخ: خريجي 5 أو 10 ثواني بيختاروها لأنهم بيقارنوها بوقت الـ refill العادي. بس الفحص هاد مخصص للـ ischemia المتقدمة، والوقت الطبيعي هو 20 ثانية. إذا تأخر امتلاء الـ veins كمان، هاد بيوحي بأسوأ ischemia.

question: What percentage of patients presenting with arteriosclerosis obliterans are younger than 50 years old?
englishExplanation:
Peripheral arteriovascular disease can occur in younger 
patients. Nineteen percent of patients presenting with atherosclerosis 
obliterans are between the ages of 30 and 50 years old. Of all arteriosclerosis patients, 33% have coexistent coronary artery disease, and 
70% to 90% are smokers. The non-smokers have other risk factors 
including significant hypertension and hyperlipidemia.

References
1021.e3
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ peripheral arteriovascular disease بيقدر يصيب صغار بالعمر كمان، و19% من المرضى اللي بيقدموا بـ arteriosclerosis obliterans عمرهم بين 30 و50 سنة. يعني ربع العينة تقريباً تحت الخمسين. وكمان 33% من مرضى الـ arteriosclerosis عندهم coexistent coronary artery disease، و70% إلى 90% مدخنين، وغير المدخنين عندهم عوامل خطر تانية مثل hypertension وhyperlipidemia.
الفخ: خريجي 1% و5% بيختاروها لأنهم بيعتقدوا إن هاد مرض كبار السن. بس الـ arteriosclerosis obliterans بيبدأ بدري، والرقم الصح هو 20% تقريباً تحت الخمسين.

question:
A 49-year-old woman presents with severe left ankle pain. She 
describes a fairly sudden development of a left lateral malleolus 
hemorrhagic blister that transitioned to a painful superficial ulcer 
over 48 hours. She has no prior history of extremity ulcers, and her 
only significant past medical history is hypertension. She has a longstanding history of noncompliance with her hypertensive medications and smokes two packs of cigarettes per day. She has no history 
of myalgias, joint pain, fever, or systemic symptoms. Vital signs 
are: temperature, 36°C oral; heart rate, 90 beats per minute; blood 
pressure, 210/125 mm Hg; respiratory rate, 20 breaths per minute; 
and O2 saturation, 96%. Physical examination reveals a thin black 
female in distress because of pain. Cardiopulmonary examination is 
unremarkable. Abdominal, neurologic, and extremity examinations 
are likewise unremarkable except for a well-demarcated, shallow 
4 × 3 cm ulcer over the left lateral malleolus. There is mild erythema 
but no evidence of active infection. Distal pulses and capillary refill 
are normal. What would be the most appropriate intervention?

options.text: Analgesics and admission for vasculitis evaluation
Wound care and blood pressure control
Wound care and tapering dose of prednisone
Venous Doppler scans and surgical consultation for possible

correctAnswer: Wound care and blood pressure control
englishExplanation:
This patient has a hypertensive ulcer, which is the most 
painful of lower extremity ulcers. They typically occur over the lateral 
malleolus, as opposed to venous stasis ulcers, which are more common 
anteriorly and medially. Ischemic arterial ulcers are more common distally over the digits. Although vasculitis or a collagen vascular disease 
are possible, the lack of any other systemic symptoms or prodrome 
argues against this.
   	 C H A P T E R 7 3 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d
   

CHAPTER 74  Pulmonary Embolism and Deep Vein Thrombosis
1041.e3
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هالمريضة عندها hypertensive ulcer، وهي الأكثر ألماً من قرح الطرف السفلي. هاد النوع بيصير عادة فوق الـ lateral malleolus، على عكس venous stasis ulcers اللي أكتر شيوعاً قدام وفي الوسط. أما ischemic arterial ulcers فأكتر شيوعاً بطرف الأصابع. ولما ما في أي أعراض جهازية ثانية أو prodrome، vasculitis أو connective vascular disease أقل احتمالاً، فالعناية بالجرح مع ضبط الـ pressure هي الصح.
الفخ: خريجي surgical consultation لpossible embolectomy أو venous Doppler بيعتمدوا إن الـ ulcer دي من مشكلة vascular. بس الـ pulses طبيعية والـ capillary refill طبيعي، فهاد قرح pressure مش embolus، والعناية بالجرح مع ضبط الضغط بتكفي.

question:
What is the length of time from acute ischemia of the intestines to 
completion of transmural necrosis?
englishExplanation:
Although the mesenteric circulation is able to adapt 
to variations in circulation, the small bowel is quickly injured after 
acute ischemia. Within 15 minutes, structural damage to the intestinal 
villi can be seen histologically. If blood flow is not restored, mucosal 
sloughing can start to occur within 3 hours and, by 6 hours, transmural 
necrosis is complete.

PART III  Emergency Medicine by System
1103.e2
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ mesenteric circulation عندها القدرة تتأقلم مع التغيرات، بس الـ small bowel بتتأذى بسرعة بعد acute ischemia. خلال 15 دقيقة بتظهر تغييرات بنيوية بالـ intestinal villi تحت المجهر. وإذا الـ blood flow ما رجع، mucosal sloughing بيبدأ خلال 3 ساعات، وبـ 6 ساعات بيكون الـ transmural necrosis اكتمل. يعني لازم تتحرك بسرعة قبل ما يوصل الموضوع لهيكل.
الفخ: خريجي 2 ساعات أو 60 دقيقة بيختاروها لأنهم بيفكروا إن الـ bowel حساس كتير. بس 2 ساعة وقت الـ sloughing بس، والـ transmural necrosis بيحتاج 6 ساعات. الترتيب الزمني هو المفتاح.

question:
A 37-year-old female with a prior history of transverse myelitis at 
the T4 level one year ago presents with several hours of sweating, 
nausea, and headache. At baseline, she is paraplegic to the lower 
extremities, performs intermittent bladder catheterization, and is 
insensate inferiorly to the T4 level. She has never had these symptoms before. Her vitals are: blood pressure 270/130, heart rate 54, 
respiratory rate 16, oral temperature of 97.2°F. ECG performed in 
triage shows no signs of ischemia or infarct. Which of the following 
actions should be taken next?

options.text: Manage blood pressure with nitrates and perform a thorough physical examination including bladder scan and rectal
Administer aspirin and obtain cardiology consult.
Obtain an emergent CTA of chest to assess for aortic dissection.
Order an MRI with IV contrast.

correctAnswer: Manage blood pressure with nitrates and perform a thorough physical examination including bladder scan and rectal
englishExplanation:
The patient is experiencing autonomic dysreflexia, seen 
frequently in patients with spinal cord injuries above the T6 level. Her 
severe hypertension, diaphoresis, nausea, and headache can mimic 
other diagnoses, but her history of spinal cord lesion must be taken 
into consideration. Management focuses around aggressive blood pressure management with nitrates and investigation into the possible noxious stimuli that is causing the syndrome. Bladder-related etiologies 
(particularly distention or detrusor overactivity) cause most episodes 
of autonomic dysreflexia. Other causes are fecal impaction, pain, tight 
clothing, and infection.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها autonomic dysreflexia، وهاد شائع عند مرضى إصابات النخاع فوق مستوى T6. الـ hypertension الشديد مع الـ diaphoresis والـ nausea والـ headache ممكن يشبهوا تشخيصات تانية، بس لازم تأخذ تاريخ إصابة النخاع بعين الاعتبار. العلاج بيركز على ضبط الـ blood pressure بقوة بالـ nitrates، مع البحث عن الـ noxious stimuli المسببة للمشكلة، وأهمها سبب متعلق بالـ bladder.
الفخ: خريجي CT للـ chest أو aspirin وcardiology consult بيروحوا على emergency لأن الـ pressure 270/130 مخيف. بس الـ ECG بدون ischemia، والـ history بتوجّهك لـ autonomic dysreflexia، مش cardiac أو dissection.

question: Which of the following is considered the gold standard for diagnosing somatic symptom and related disorders (SSRD)?

options.text: Elimination of other possible medical conditions via extensive

englishExplanation:
SSRD diagnoses are suggested by overall clinical picture 
and may be supported by self-report questionnaires. However, final 
diagnosis is typically based upon formal structured clinical interview 
in psychiatric or primary care settings. Note that a “positive ROS” is 
similar to high scores on SSRD symptom severity questionnaires.

1357.e1
REFERENCES
arabicExplanation:
ليش: تشخيص SSRD بيبدأ من الصورة السريرية العامة، وبيتقوّى بـ self-report questionnaires. بس التشخيص النهائي بيتم عادةً بناءً على structured clinical interview في عيادة psychiatric أو في primary care. يعني الـ history المنظم هو gold standard، والـ questionnaires بس أداة مساعدة ترفع الـ suspicion. والـ positive ROS يعني في symptoms بس ما بيعني التشخيص، والـ emergency physician gestalt بيكون عليه تحيّز.
الفخ: خريجي emergency physician gestalt أو positive ROS بيروحوا عليها لأنهم سريعة. بس الـ gestalt فيه تحيّز، والـ ROS الإيجابي يشبه score عالي في استبيانات الـ SSRD، مو تشخيص مؤكد.

question:
A patient with a history of SLE presents with shortness of breath. 
CT angiography reveals two segmental pulmonary emboli. Laboratory testing and bedside echocardiography are unremarkable. Chart 
review reveals positive anticardiolipin and β2-glycoprotein I titers. 
Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in therapy 
for this patient?
englishExplanation:
This patient has SLE and antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) 
based on the history of thromboembolic disease and positive antiphospholipid (aPL) antibodies. The most appropriate anticoagulation for 
patients with APS is a vitamin K antagonist (e.g., warfarin) or a heparin analog (e.g., enoxaparin). In the acute setting, however, a heparin 
analog should be used due to the delayed therapeutic effect of vitamin 
K antagonists. Aspirin is insufficient to treat acute thromboembolic 
disease in APS, and direct oral anticoagulants have decreased efficacy 
when compared to vitamin K antagonists and heparin analogs. This 
patient does not have an indication for tissue plasminogen activator.
   	 C H A P T E R 1 0 5 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d

References
1427.e2
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها SLE ومعها antiphospholipid syndrome، والدليل إن عندها تاريخ disease تجلطية مع antibodies إيجابية للـ aPL. أكتر anticoagulation مناسب لمرضى APS هو vitamin K antagonist مثل warfarin أو heparin analog مثل enoxaparin. بس في الحالة الحادة بنستخدم heparin analog لأن تأثير الـ vitamin K antagonists بطيء ويأخذ وقت. الـ Aspirin ما بكفّي، والـ direct oral anticoagulants أقل فعالية من الـ warfarin والـ heparin analogs، ومفيش indication للـ tissue plasminogen activator.
الفخ: خريجي warfarin والـ DOAC بيروحوا عليها بحكم إنها anticoagulants. بس الـ warfarin تأثيره therapeutic بطيء فما ينفع للحالة الحادة، والـ rivaroxaban أقل فعالية مع APS. عالج أولاً بـ enoxaparin.

question: Which of the following can affect the “normal” WBC count?
englishExplanation:
All of the statements are true. One unique problem in WBC 
disorders is the wide variability in normal values and the multiple factors influencing them. Normal values for the WBC count are listed in 
Table 110.1. The “normal” WBC count range is age-dependent and may 
be shifted upward by exercise, female gender, smoking, or pregnancy. 
Decreases in the total WBC count range by 1000 to 1200 cells/mm3 
have been noted in the Black population.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: كل هاي العوامل فعلاً بتأثر بالـ normal WBC count. من المشاكل الخاصة باضطرابات الـ WBC هو التباين الكبير بالقيم الطبيعية، وإن فيه عدة عوامل بتأثر فيها. الـ normal range للـ WBC count بيعتمد على العمر، وبينزاح للأعلى مع exercise، ومع كون المريضة أنثى، ومع smoking، ومع pregnancy. وكمان في Black population لاحظوا انخفاض في الـ total WBC count بمقدار 1000 إلى 1200 cell/mm3.
الفخ: خريجي Exercise أو Smoking بيعتبروها مش مؤثرة لأنهم بيفكروا إن الـ normal range رقم ثابت. بس الـ range بيختلف بالعمر وبيتزح بالـ exercise والـ smoking والجنس والحمل، فما في عامل واحد ثابت.

question:
A 33-year-old juvenile-onset, insulin-dependent diabetic suddenly 
faints without prodrome or warning while walking through the ED. 
Relatives report that diabetes is his only past history. Which of the 
following findings is most likely?

options.text: Autonomic neuropathy on later orthostatic testing

englishExplanation:
Hypoglycemia without warning, or hypoglycemia 
unawareness, is a complication of type 1 diabetes caused by previous 
hypoglycemic episodes. A single hypoglycemic episode may blunt neurohormonal counterregulatory responses to later hypoglycemic episodes. Risk factors are overaggressive insulin therapy, longer history 
of diabetes, and autonomic neuropathy, which usually causes orthostasis on first standing or after being upright in a static position. These 
patients may become abruptly unarousable without warning.

1558.e2
   	 CH APT E R 1 1 5 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده type 1 diabetes وفجأة إغمى بدون أي prodrome أو إنذار، وهاد اسمه hypoglycemia without warning يعني hypoglycemia unawareness. هاد complication شائعة عند مرضى type 1 بسبب نوبات hypoglycemia سابقة، لأن نوبة وحدة ممكن تخلّي الـ neurohormonal counterregulatory responses تضعف مع النوبات اللي بعدها. ولما نزله نشوف sugar 27 mg/dL هاد بيفسّر كل شي.
الفخ: خريجي autonomic neuropathy بيعتمدوا إنه السبب، لأن الـ diabetes بيسبّب neuropathy. بس الـ autonomic neuropathy بتدي orthostasis عند أول وقوف، وهاد مش اللي صار. الـ sugar 27 mg/dL هو المحفّز الحقيقي لل unconsciousness.

question:
Which of the following statements regarding exertion (exercise)-
related rhabdomyolysis is true?

options.text: Eccentric (lengthening) muscle work is more damaging than
Hypocalcemia increases the risk for this syndrome.
It is the result of voluntary muscle exertion.
It is seen exclusively in untrained athletes.
The mechanism is different than after a crush injury.

correctAnswer: Eccentric (lengthening) muscle work is more damaging than
englishExplanation:
Exertional rhabdomyolysis is seen in trained and untrained 
individuals as well as after exercise or situations of involuntary muscle 
activity (e.g., psychoses, seizures, tetany, myoclonus). The mechanism 
(e.g., failure of energy supplies, sarcolemma breakdown, intracellular 
calcium accumulation, enzyme dysfunction, cellular swelling) is the 
same. Hypokalemia is a risk factor because a low potassium level limits 
microvascular dilation and muscle perfusion.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ exertional rhabdomyolysis بتصير عند الرياضيين وغير الرياضيين، إلخ بعد exercise أو بعد نشاط عضلي لاإرادي مثل psychoses وseizures وtetany وmyoclonus. والـ mechanism في كل الحالات واحد: فشل إمداد الطاقة، وتهريب الـ sarcolemma، وتراكم الكالسيوم داخل الخلية، واختلال الـ enzymes، وتورّم الخلية. الـ hypokalemia عامل خطر لأنه بيحدّ التوسع الـ microvascular وبيقلّل perfusion العضلة. والـ eccentric lengthening work أضر من الـ concentric.
الفخ: خريجي seen exclusively in untrained athletes بيختاروها لأنهم بيفكروا إن الـ rhabdomyolysis بيصير بالمبتدئين بس. بالعكس، بتصير بالمتدربين كمان، والـ mechanism واحد بالجميع، وhypokalemia هي عامل الخطر الحقيقي.

question:
A 37-year-old male presents to the ED with complaints of palpitations, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diaphoresis. He 
reports episodes similar to this that have been increasing in frequency and severity over several months. His vital signs are P 127, 
BP 174/90, RR 28, T 37.1°C, and Sao2 96%. Once stabilized, what is 
the most appropriate oral treatment for this patient?
englishExplanation:
This patient presents with episodic, or paroxysmal 
symptoms that are consistent with pheochromocytoma. Following initial stabilization and appropriate workup, the patient will require control of his vital sign abnormalities and symptoms leading up to surgery. 
The first-line treatment for pheochromocytoma is alpha-blockade, so 
in this question, phenoxybenzamine is correct. In patients with catecholamine excess, beta blockade alone can result in hypertensive crisis because of unopposed alpha-adrenergic receptor stimulation. Beta 
blockers can be used, but this should only be done following alphablockade; as such, propranolol and metoprolol are incorrect. Calcium 
channel blockers may be used in mild cases or in patients with undesirable alpha-blockade side effects, but are not considered first line; as 
such, amlodipine is also incorrect.
   	 CH APT E R 1 1 7 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d

References
1609.e2
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده أعراض متكررة وموجة من palpitations وألم بطن وnausea وvomiting وdiaphoresis، وهي بتطابق pheochromocytoma اللي بتسبب نوبات. بعد ما يستقر وفحص الـ workup، لازم تتحكم بالـ vital signs والأعراض قبل Surgery. أول خط علاج هو alpha-blockade، وهاد هو phenoxybenzamine. الـ beta blockade لوحدها ممكن تسبّب hypertensive crisis بسبب stimulation الـ alpha-adrenergic بلا مقابل.
الفخ: خريجي metoprolol أو propranolol بيروحوا على beta blocker لأنه الرقم عالي والضغط مرتفع. بس الـ beta blocker لوحده مع excess catecholamines بيسبّب hypertensive crisis، ولازم alpha-blockade أولاً. الـ amlodipine للحالات الخفيفة بس مش first line.

question: Which of the following statements regarding Lyme carditis is true?

options.text: Electrocardiographic changes are stable and persistent.
Onset time from initial illness is 2 or 3 months.
The most common manifestation is bundle branch block.

englishExplanation:
Cardiac involvement is uncommon. The most common 
manifestation is atrioventricular block, which may fluctuate significantly but often resolves as the cardiac inflammation recedes. Onset 
time from illness is an average of 3 to 5 weeks.
   
   	 C H A P T E R 1 2 3 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d

1710.e1
REFERENCES
arabicExplanation:
ليش: Cardiac involvement في Lyme carditis بيحصل بشكل نادر، يعني أكثر مرضى Lyme ما بيكسروا القلب. أكثر manifestation بيجي هو atrioventricular block، وهاد الـ block ممكن يتذبذب بشكل كبير ويختلف من درجة لأخرى. بس غالباً بيختفي من لحاله لما inflammation القلب يخف. الوقت المعدّل لبداية المشكلة من بداية المرض هو 3 ل5 أسابيع، وهاد الرقم مهم عشان تربط بين الـ symptoms والـ Lyme disease.
الفخ: أكثر إجابة غلط هي bundle branch block، لأن الناس بيفتكروا إن الـ block الدائم هو الشكل الشائع. تفرّق كذا: الـ manifestation الأكثر شيوعاً هو atrioventricular block، مش bundle branch block، والـ ECG changes بتتذبذب بدل ما تضل ثابتة.

question:
A 27-year-old woman presents with severe chest pain that began 
soon after use of a large amount of cocaine. She describes the pain 
as “tearing from my chest to my back.” Her vital signs are blood 
pressure (BP), 210/112 mm Hg; heart rate (HR), 142 bpm; respiratory rate (RR) 22 rpm; and temperature, 38.0°C. A BP measurement 
taken in the other arm is 147/86 mm Hg. An electrocardiogram 
(ECG) is normal. You are highly suspicious that the patient is 
suffering from an aortic dissection and order a transesophageal 
ultrasound examination while contacting the cardiothoracic surgeon. In the meantime, what should you use to lower her blood 
pressure?

options.text: Treatment should be withheld until a definitive diagnosis is

englishExplanation:
Phentolamine is a direct alpha-adrenergic antagonist and 
is the drug of choice for sympathomimetic-induced hypertension with 
end-organ damage. Labetalol and beta-blockers are not recommended, 
because they have little clinical benefit in this setting. Nitroprusside 
and nitroglycerine are acceptable agents if phentolamine is not available. Treatment should not be withheld because rapid blood pressure 
control could be lifesaving.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: Phentolamine هو alpha-adrenergic antagonist مباشر، وهو الـ drug of choice لما يكون عندك hypertension من sympathomimetics مع end-organ damage زي هاي المريضة. الـ BP عندها 210/112 مع اختلاف كبير بين الذراعين بسبب الـ cocaine، فهاد hypertensive emergency لازم ينزل بسرعة. العلاج لازم يبدأ فوراً حتى لو لسه ما تم تأكيد التشخيص، لأن ضبط الـ BP بسرعة ممكن ينقذ حياتها. Nitroprusside و nitroglycerine مقبولين بس هما بديل لو ما متوفر phentolamine.
الفخ: Labetalol هي الاختيار الغلط الشائع، لأن الناس بتختارها لأنها beta-blocker. المشكلة فيها إنها ما بتدي فايدة في هاي الحالة، وبديلها Nitroprusside أو nitroglycerine لو ما متوفر phentolamine. وكمان ما تنتظر التشخيص النهائي لتبدأ العلاج.

question:
A patient arrives at the emergency department (ED) after an intentional paraquat ingestion complaining of severe mouth, throat, and 
chest pain. What potentially fatal complication of paraquat ingestion should be suspected?
englishExplanation:
Paraquat is extremely corrosive and can cause severe burns 
to the oropharynx, as well as to the esophagus. Frequently, esophageal 
rupture occurs, leading to mediastinitis and death. None of the other 
listed conditions occurs with any frequency in paraquat poisoning.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: Paraquat مادة شديدة الكاوية، بتسبب حروق شديدة بالفم والحلق وكمان بالمريء. بكثرة بيحصل esophageal rupture بعد التسمم، وهاد بيوصل لـ mediastinitis وبيودي للوفاة. يعني هاي هي الـ complication القاتلة اللي لازم تفكر فيها عند أي حد عمل ingestion متعمد. والألم الشديد بالفم والحلق والصدر هو اللي بيرجّعك للاحتمال هذا. وأي حالة ثانية من الخيارات ما بتنشأ بشكل متكرر مع سمّية paraquat.
الفخ: Aortic dissection و myocardial infarction و pneumothorax و pulmonary embolism كلهم بيكوّنوا إجابات تجذب، بس ما بيصيروا بشكل متكرر مع paraquat. كيفما تفرّق: لو فيه ألم مفاجئ مع فرق بالضغط بين الذراعين فكر بالـ dissection، بس الـ paraquat ما بيأثر على الـ aorta.

question:
A 46-year-old man presents after waking in the night with headache 
and severe nausea and vomiting. For dinner the night before, he 
consumed some mushrooms that he had gathered from a nearby 
forest. He felt fine immediately after dinner. His vital signs are 
normal. While conducting your physical examination, he begins 
to seize. Benzodiazepines are administered without improvement. 
What treatment is indicated?
englishExplanation:
Most mushrooms do not cause seizures, but gyromitrincontaining mushrooms are an exception. They are commonly mistaken for edible morels because they look quite similar. They contain 
an isoniazid-like toxin that causes seizures. Traditional seizure medications can be used (because they are typically more readily available), 
but seizures can be intractable until pyridoxine is given.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: أغلب الفطر ما بيسبب seizures، بس فطر gyromitrin-containing هو الاستثناء. هاد الفطر بيتشابه كتير مع morels الصالحة، فالطلاب ممكن يغلطوا فيه. المكوّن السام فيه شبيه بـ isoniazid، وهو السبب في الـ seizures. الـ benzodiazepines ما بتكفي لحالها، والـ seizures ممكن تكون intractable لحد ما تعطي pyridoxine. والأدوية التانية المخصصة للـ seizures ممكن تُستخدم لأنها أسهل توفراً، بس الـ treatment الحقيقي والضروري هو pyridoxine.
الفخ: Phenobarbital و phenytoin و propofol بيوهنوا، لأن الناس بتوقع دوا الصرع بيكفي. كيفما تفرّق: هون المشكلة مش دواء عام للمشاكل، الـ toxin شبيه بـ isoniazid، والـ seizures مش بترد لحد ما تعطي pyridoxine.

question:
A 30-year-old man presents with anxiety and insomnia. He is agitated and has a tremor on physical examination. His vital signs are 
as follows: blood pressure, 200/124 mm Hg; heart rate, 123 beats/
min; respiratory rate, 22 breaths/min; and temperature, 37.5°C. On 
further questioning, he reports that he chronically uses gammahydroxybutyrate (GHB) for muscle building but has not been able 
to take any for approximately 24 hours. Lorazepam is given in two 
escalating doses without response. Which of the following should 
be given next?
englishExplanation:
GHB withdrawal is severe, and deaths have been reported. 
GHB acts as a central nervous system (CNS) depressant, so withdrawal 
causes CNS excitement and autonomic instability. Chronic GHB abuse 
can lead to GABA depletion in the CNS. Because benzodiazepines 
require the presence of GABA, they may not be effective. Barbiturates 
act independently of GABA and are therefore more effective in GHB 
withdrawal. Clonidine can be used in opioid withdrawal but is not 
useful in GHB withdrawal. Labetalol would improve the vital signs 
but would have no effect on the underlying cause of the autonomic 
instability.
   	 C H A P T E R 1 5 4 : Q U E S T I O N S AND ANS WERS —cont’d.

2004.e1
REFERENCES
arabicExplanation:
ليش: GHB بيعمل depressant للـ CNS، فما ينقطع فجأة بتطلع المضادة: CNS excitation و autonomic instability، وهاد الـ withdrawal شديد ومُبلّغ عن وفيات. استخدام GHB المزمن بيودي لاستنزاف GABA في الـ CNS، والـ benzodiazepines تحتاج GABA عشان تشتغل، فممكن تفشل. الـ barbiturates بتشتغل بشكل مستقل عن GABA، فهاد بتخليها أكثر فعالية. وهاي الحالة الـ lorazepam أعطي بجرعتين ولسه ما في أي رد.
الفخ: Clonidine و labetalol هما الإجابات الغلط الشائعة، لأنهم بيظبطوا الـ vital signs. بس clonidine بتنفع في opioid withdrawal مش GHB، وlabetalol ما عندها أي تأثير على السبب الأساسي للـ autonomic instability.

question:
A 6-year-old male with Trisomy 21 presents with decreased responsiveness and not eating. His temperature is 39°C, heart rate is 150, 
blood pressure is 80/55, respiratory rate is 24, oxygen saturation is 
98%, and glucose is 90 mg/dL. He receives cefepime and 20 mL/
kg of lactated Ringers but his vital sign abnormalities persist. On 
examination, he is lethargic with a neck that is supple, lungs that 
are clear to auscultation, cool extremities, and capillary refill of 3 
seconds. What is the next best step in the management?
englishExplanation:
This child is in septic shock. He received an initial fluid 
bolus but has ongoing signs of decreased perfusion. In the absence 
of signs of pulmonary edema, the next step should be to administer 
another bolus of isotonic fluids. He may benefit from epinephrine and 
vancomycin but after a second bolus is initiated.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الطفل عنده septic shock، مع علامات ضعف perfusion واضحة زي الأطراف الباردة و capillary refill 3 ثواني والخمول. خذ أول bolus من lactated Ringers 20 mL/kg بس الـ vital signs abnormalities ظلّت شوّة. ولأنه ما في علامات pulmonary edema، الخطوة الجاية هي bolus تاني من سوائل isotونية. الـ epinephrine و vancomycin ممكن يفيدوا، بس بعد ما تبدأ الـ bolus الثاني.
الفخ: epinephrine و vancomycin و hydrocortisone هما الإجابات اللي الناس بتتجاهلها. كيفما تفرّق: عندك bolus واحد لسه أعطيته والـ perfusion لسه ضعيف، فلازم تعطي سوائل قبل ما تضيف أي drug، خاصة إنه ما في علامات pulmonary edema.

question:
A 16-year-old boy presents with complaints of syncope during a 
basketball game. His mother reports a family history of sudden 
death in young adults, and you are concerned that the patient 
may have hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Which of the following 
increases the murmur associated with this condition?
englishExplanation:
During the Valsalva maneuver, the venous blood return to the 
heart is decreased, which in turn transiently reduces the left ventricular 
size. This transient reduction will increase the degree of obstruction and 
thus cause an increase in the intensity of the murmur. Hand grip, methoxamine, and squatting will increase return of blood to the heart and therefore decrease the murmur associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: وقت ما تعمل Valsalva، الدم الوريدي راجع للقلب بيقل، فحجم الـ left ventricle بيصغر مؤقتاً. هاد التصغير بيزوّد درجة الـ obstruction، وبنفس الوقت بيزوّد شدة الـ murmur اللي مصاحب لـ hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. يعني الـ murmur بيزيد مع Valsalva، مش مع أي حركة تانية. والمريض عنده تاريخ عائلي بموت مفاجئ في شباب، وبي-syncoped أثناء مباريات الـ basketball، فهاد كله بيوحي بـ HCM.
الفخ: Hand grip و methoxamine و squatting هما الخيارات التانية، وكلها بتزوّد الـ venous return للقلب. وبنفس السبب بتقلّل الـ LV size فبتقلّ شدة الـ murmur، عكس Valsalva تماماً.

question:
Which of the following is expected to be the least likely cause of 
death for adults in the United States?
englishExplanation:
According to the Center for Disease Control, accidents are 
the third leading cause of death in the United States. (http://www.cdc.
gov/nchs/fastats/leading-causes-of-death.htm.)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: السؤال بينسى عن أسباب الوفاة عند الكبار في الولايات المتحدة، والجواب هو Trauma لأنه أقل واحد. حسب CDC، الحوادث accidents هي ثالث أكثر سبب للوفاة في البلاد. ولما هي ثالث بالترتيب، يعني cancer و heart disease و cardiovascular disease كلهم فوقها، وهاد بيفسّر ليش Trauma هي الأقل احتمالاً. وإحصائيات أسباب الوفاة بتنزل من CDC لكل سنة، فالمقارنة بتكون على الأرقام مش على الحدس.
الفخ: خيار heart disease أو cardiovascular disease بيجذب لأن الناس بتحس إنهم أقوى من cancer. بس الـ CDC بتقول إن الحوادث ثالث سبب، فأي واحد فوقها بيكون أقل احتمالاً. انتبه لكلمة الأقل بالسؤال.

question:
Mr. Samuels is a 46-year-old man with severe breathlessness and anxiety due to advanced chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. His vital 
signs are temperature, 36.8°C (98.2°F); blood pressure, 110/60 mm 
Hg; heart rate, 115 beats/min; respiratory rate, 34 breaths/min; oxygen 
saturation, 98% on room air. He is visibly anxious and reports dizziness and dyspnea. Which of the following is the best initial treatment?
englishExplanation:
In the absence of hypoxia, morphine has been shown to 
relieve the sensation of breathlessness. Benzodiazepines have not been 
shown to relieve breathlessness and may increase side effects.

CHAPTER E6  Bioethics
2451.e63
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده COPD متقدم ومعه ضيق نفس شديد وقلق، بس الـ oxygen saturation عنده 98% على room air يعني ما في hypoxia. عند ما ما يكون في نقص أكسجين، morphine بيخفف الإحساس بضيق النفس. هاد السبب اللي بيخلّيه الخيار الأفضل كـ initial treatment، مش لأنه بيعالج COPD نفسه. ومع إن الـ respiratory rate عنده 34 والـ heart rate 115، فالموضوع مش بسيط.
الفخ: benzodiazepines زي lorazepam هي الاختيار الغلط الشائع، لأن الناس بتفكر إن القلق هو السبب. بس الأدلة ما بيّنت إنها بتخفف ضيق النفس، وممكن تزود الـ side effects. و oxygen مش هو الحل لأن الـ saturation طبيعي.

question:
Three patients arrive at triage simultaneously: One has received a 4 
Gy work-related irradiation exposure from a food sterilizer but no 
other injury; one is experiencing an acute ST elevation myocardial 
infarction (MI); and one likely has urosepsis but with a stable blood 
pressure and heart rate of 105 beats/min. Which of these actions is 
your first priority?

options.text: Decontaminate the irradiated victim before placing him in a
Initiate intravenous (IV) fluid bolus and prepare for intubation
Place a central venous catheter in the urosepsis patient.

englishExplanation:
Even patients who have received a lethal radiation 
dose do not die quickly as a consequence of the ionizing exposure. 
Patients should be triaged according to severity of the medical 
conditions and/or vital sign derangements. Here, the patient with 
the MI is most acute and should be the highest priority necessitating activation of the cardiac catheterization team. The radiationexposed patient was not contaminated, just irradiated. As such, 
decontamination and isolation are unnecessary. Although the victim has received the LD50 dose of ionizing radiation, no significant 
injury will result just after exposure, so this patient does not take 
priority over the MI patient at this point and intubation is not indicated. The septic patient is not critically ill and should not be treated 
ahead of the MI patient.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاي ثلاث حالات وصلوا بنفس الوقت، والترييج بيصير حسب خطورة المرض واضطراب الـ vital signs مش حسب من وصل أول. مريض الـ acute ST elevation myocardial infarction هو الأكثر إلحاحاً، وعليه لازم تنادي cardiac catheterization team فوراً. أما مريض الـ radiation exposure فحتى لو وصل جرعة قاتلة من الأشعة ما بيموت بسرعة من التعرض نفسه. ومريض الـ urosepsis ضغطه مستقر وما هو critically ill، فما لازم يسبق مريض الـ MI.
الفخ: الناس بينخدعوا بمريض الأشعة ويفتكروا إنه لازم decontamination أو isolation. بس هاد الشخص كان متعرض فقط مش ملوث، فما في داعي decontamination. وحتى بعد جرعة LD50 ما في إصابة فورية، فما تأخّر مريض الـ MI.

question:
A malnourished man with a long history of chronic obstruc -
tive pulmonary disease is brought to the emergency depart -
ment (ED) in respiratory distress. He receives bronchodilators,
intravenous (IV) dextrose, and thiamine. He improves significantly, but then begins to complain of severe muscle aches, diffuse weakness, and the feeling that he cannot breathe deeply.
Supplementation with which of the following might have pre -
vented his new symptoms?
englishExplanation:
Patients with hypophosphatemia may present with non -
specific complaints, including joint pain, myalgias, irritability, and
depression. Severe hypophosphatemia can be manifested as seizures,
arrhythmias, cardiomyopathy, insulin resistance, acute tubular necrosis, rhabdomyolysis, and acute respiratory failure. Because hypophos -
phatemia often presents with hypokalemia, phosphate repletion should
be considered in conjunction with potassium administration.
