![Study-FRCEM-2025-01405 source page 2420](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01405-frcem-p2420.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ ECG بتبيّن complete heart block مع ventricular rate بطيء جداً و QRS complexes عريضة و انفصال بين الـ P waves والـ QRS. والمريض عنده symptomatic bradycardia مع hemodynamic compromise واضح، يعني HR 32 و BP 88/50 مع syncope، وهاد بيحتاج تدخل فوري. الخيار A هو غير المناسب لأن الـ atropine بتاخد بجرعة 500mcg وتكرر، بس الحد الأقصى الصحيح هو 3mg مو 2mg.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار isoprenaline أو adrenaline أو transcutaneous pacing، لأنو هاي كلها مناسبة حسب bradycardia guidelines. الغلط الحقيقي هو حد الـ atropine نفسه؛ الـ maximum dose هو 3mg مو 2mg.

question:
A 72-year-old female presents to the Emergency Department with acute onset right-sided weakness and slurred
speech. Her past medical history includes hypertension and type 2 diabetes. Which risk stratification score would
be most appropriate to assess her risk of stroke if she is found to have atrial fibrillation?
englishExplanation:
CHA₂DS₂-VASc score

Explanation
The CHA₂DS₂-VASc score is the most appropriate tool for assessing stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation. This
patient would score points for age (1 point), hypertension (1 point), and if stroke is confirmed (2 points).
Why other answers are incorrect:
ORBIT score - This is primarily used to assess bleeding risk in AF patients on anticoagulation, not stroke risk
HAS-BLED score - This evaluates bleeding risk in patients on anticoagulation, not stroke risk
ATRIA score - While this can be used for stroke risk assessment, CHA₂DS₂-VASc is superior and is recommended by
current guidelines
HEMORR₂HAGES score - This is another bleeding risk assessment tool, not appropriate for stroke risk stratification
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها 72 سنة و عندها hypertension و type 2 diabetes، ولو تأكد عندها atrial fibrillation فبحسب الـ CHA₂DS₂-VASc بتاخد نقطة للعمر ونقطة للـ hypertension، ونقطتين لو في stroke. هاي هي الأداة الموصى بها في الـ guidelines لتقييم خطر الـ stroke عند مرضى الـ AF. أما باقي السكورات فبتقيس خطر النزف مو خطر السكتة، أو مو هاد الغرض منها.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط HAS-BLED أو ORBIT أو HEMORR₂HAGES، لأن هاي كلها أدوات لتقييم خطر النزف عند اللي عم ياخدوا anticoagulation. افرق: إنت عم تقيس خطر السكتة، ومو خطر النزف.

question:
A 67-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with chest pain and dizziness for 2 hours. ECG shows
inferior wall ST-elevation MI with complete heart block. Heart rate is 35/min, BP 80/35, RR18, Saturations 94%
on air. After 3mg IV atropine, the heart rate remains unchanged. The defibrillator he is attached to does not have a
pacing function. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
englishExplanation:
Administer theophylline 200mg IV slow bolus
Explanation
In inferior wall MI complicated by complete heart block and bradycardia unresponsive to atropine, consider using
theophylline (100- 200 mg by slow intravenous injection). 
https://lms.resus.org.uk/modules/m10-v2-cardiac-arrest/10346/resources/chapter_11.pdf
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هون عندنا inferior wall ST-elevation MI مع complete heart block و bradycardia شديد، يعني HR 35 و BP 80/35، والـ atropine بجرعة 3mg ما أثّر في خالص. في هاي الحالة بالذات، لما الـ bradycardia ما تستجيب للـ atropine، التوصيات بتقول نستخدم theophylline بجرعة 100 إلى 200 mg حقن وريدي بطيء، وهاد بيساعد على رفع الـ heart rate بشكل أسرع وفعّال.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار transcutaneous pacing أو percussion pacing أو calcium gluconate. الـ defibrillator عنده ما فيه pacing function، فعلياً ما عندك transvenous pacing جاهز، وهاد بالضبط بيخلّي theophylline هو الحل.

question:
A 65-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with chest pain and bradycardia (HR 45).
Which of the following is the correct maximum dose of atropine that can be given?
englishExplanation:
3mg
Explanation
The maximum dose of atropine for bradycardia is 3mg. This is given in 500mcg increments, with reassessment between doses.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الحد الأقصى لجرعة atropine في الـ bradycardia هو 3mg. بتدّوها على شكل جرعات صغيرة كل واحدة 500mcg، مع إعادة تقييم للمريض بين كل جرعة والثانية، عشان تشوف إذا الـ rate رجع ولا لأ قبل ما تكمّل. يعني الجواب 3mg مش 1mg ولا 2mg ولا 4mg. وهالطريقة بتخلّيك تتعامل بجرعة صغيرة مرقابة بدل ما تعطي جرعة كبيرة مرة وحدة.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار 1mg أو 2mg لأنك فاكر إن الـ atropine بجرعة أقل بتكفي، أو تختار 4mg أو 5mg لأنك فاكر إن زيادة الجرعة بتزيد الفعالية. الحد الأقصى المعروف هو 3mg فقط.

question:
A 45-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with chest pain that worsens when lying flat and improves when leaning forward. He has a recent history of upper respiratory tract infection. His ECG and troponins
are normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line treatment?
englishExplanation:
Colchicine and NSAIDs
Explanation
Colchicine combined with NSAIDs is the first-line treatment for acute pericarditis. This combination has been shown
to rapidly improve symptoms and reduce the risk of recurrence. NSAIDs help manage inflammation and pain, while
colchicine has specific anti-inflammatory properties that are effective in pericardial disease.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض 45 سنة، ألمه بيزيد لما يستلقي وبتحسن لما يميل للأمام، وعنده recent upper respiratory tract infection، والـ ECG والـ troponins طبيعية. هاي acute pericarditis، والـ first line فيها هو colchicine مع NSAIDs. هاي التركيبة بتتحسن الأعراض بسرعة وبتقلل خطر تكرار النوبة، لأن الـ NSAIDs بتdeal مع الـ inflammation والألم، والـ colchicine عنده خصائص مضادة للالتهاب فعّالة في أمراض الـ pericardium.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار prednisolone أو morphine أو beta-blockers. الـ steroids مو first line، والـ morphine ما بتعالج الـ inflammation، والـ beta-blockers ما إلها دور بعلاج الـ pericarditis. Colchicine مع الـ NSAIDs هو الترسيم الصح.

question:
An 82-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with dizziness and fatigue. His ECG shows complete
heart block with broad QRS complexes and occasional ventricular pauses. Which of the following best indicates
this patient's risk for progression to asystole?

options.text: Complete heart block with broad QRS

correctAnswer: Complete heart block with broad QRS
englishExplanation:
Complete heart block with broad QRS
Explanation
Complete heart block with broad QRS is one of the high-risk factors for progression to asystole, along with recent
asystole, Mobitz II AV block, and ventricular pauses >3 seconds.

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01419 source page 1002](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01419-study-p1002.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01419 source page 2437](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01419-frcem-p2437.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01419 source page 2438](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01419-frcem-p2438.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ ECG عند هذا المريض بيبيّن complete heart block مع QRS complexes عريضة، وفيه أحياناً ventricular pauses. هاي بالضبط من علامات الخطر العالي للتقدم إلى asystole. المقارنة مع عوامل الخطر التانية، وهي recent asystole، و Mobitz II AV block، و ventricular pauses أكثر من 3 ثواني. كل هاي بتخلي المريض معرّض لتوقف القلب الكامل.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط first-degree AV block أو Mobitz I (Wenckebach) أو junctional rhythm، لأن هاي ما بتعرّض لتطور asystole. افرق: conduction سليم أو block ناقص ما بيساوي complete block مع QRS عريض اللي بيعتبر عامل خطر عالي.

question:
A 45-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Department following an episode of transient loss of consciousness while shopping. Her husband, who witnessed the event, reports that she suddenly collapsed without any
warning. The episode lasted approximately 30 seconds, after which she regained consciousness spontaneously. On
examination, her vital signs are stable, but you note a systolic ejection murmur best heard at the right upper sternal border.
Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.text: Discharge with GP follow-up in 1 week

englishExplanation:
Urgent cardiology referral
Explanation
This patient requires an urgent cardiology referral based on the NICE guidelines for transient loss of consciousness
(TLOC). She has a heart murmur on examination, which is one of the red flag signs requiring further specialist assessment. The murmur location suggests possible aortic stenosis, which can cause syncope and requires prompt
evaluation.
NICE guidelines recommend that for patients presenting with transient loss of consciousness, refer anyone with the
following for further assessment:
An abnormal ECG
TLOC during exercise
Family history of sudden death (in a person <40 years old or with an inherited cardiac condition)
New or unexplained breathlessness
Heart murmur
https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg109
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها transient loss of consciousness وهي تسوق، وزوجها وصف إنها انهارت فجأة بدون أي تحذير، ورجعت لوعيها لوحدها بعد 30 ثانية تقريباً. وأهم شي إنو عندها systolic ejection murmur مسموع بأفضل شكل عند الـ right upper sternal border، ومكانه بيخلي نتفكر بـ aortic stenosis اللي ممكن يسبب syncope. حسب إرشادات NICE لعميلة TLOC، أي murmur قلب هو من علامات الخطر اللي بتستدعي تحويل للمتخصص.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تصرفها مع GP أو تحجز Holter outpatient أو تعمل carotid sinus massage أو CT head اعتيادي. هون في murmur، فـ NICE بتوصي بإحالة عاجلة للـ cardiology على أساس هالعلامة من علامات الخطر.

question: A 65-year-old man presents to the emergency department with palpitations and shortness of breath. His JVP examination reveals the absence of 'a' waves. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation:
Atrial fibrillation
Explanation
The absence of 'a' waves in JVP examination is a characteristic finding in atrial fibrillation. The 'a' wave represents
atrial contraction, and in atrial fibrillation, there is no organised atrial contraction due to chaotic electrical activity in
the atria. This results in the loss of the 'a' wave in the JVP waveform.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض 65 سنة راح على الـ ED مع palpitations وضيق نفس، وأهم ملاحظة عند الفحص إنو الـ JVP waveform ما فيها a wave. هاي علامة مميزة لـ atrial fibrillation، لأن الـ a wave بمثل انقباض الأذين، وفي الـ AF ما في انقباض أذيني منتظم بسبب النشاط الكهربائي العشوائي في الأذين، فبتختفي من الـ JVP waveform. ومع palpitations و shortness of breath هالصورة بتتماشى مع الـ AF.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار complete heart block أو ventricular tachycardia أو sinus tachycardia. افرق: في الـ AF الـ pulse بيبقى irregular، والـ a wave بتختفي من الـ JVP. أما complete heart block فبتكون فيه P waves منفصلة عن QRS، و sinus tachycardia بتبقى منتظمة.

question:
A 67-year-old female presents with collapse. 
A set of observations were done:
HR: 30 bpm

BP: 75/45 mmHg
RR: 22/min
SpO2: 94% on room air
Temp: 36.8°C
The ECG showed complete heart block. She received 3mg of atropine without response, and external pacing was
initiated at 70mA, resulting in the ECG shown.
What is the next step?
englishExplanation:
Check for mechanical capture
Explanation
The ECG demonstrates pacing rhythm with electrical capture, shown by pacing spikes consistently followed by wide
QRS complexes.
The next step is to confirm mechanical capture through assessment of central pulses→ then blood pressure → then
GCS.
This assessment is vital to ensure that electrical activity generates effective mechanical capture and cardiac output. If
it is not, increase the voltage until it is.
“If the highest current setting is reached and electrical capture has not occurred, try changing the electrode positions.
Continued failure to achieve electrical capture may indicate non-viable myocardium, but other conditions (e.g. hyperkalaemia) may prevent successful pacing.”
https://lms.resus.org.uk/modules/m10-v2-cardiac-arrest/10346/resources/chapter_10.pdf

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01448 source page 1017](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01448-study-p1017.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01448 source page 1018](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01448-study-p1018.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01448 source page 2480](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01448-frcem-p2480.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01448 source page 2481](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01448-frcem-p2481.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01448 source page 2482](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01448-frcem-p2482.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ ECG مبين pacing rhythm مع electrical capture واضح، يعني pacing spikes بتتبعها QRS complexes عريضة بشكل ثابت. بس الـ electrical capture لحاله ما بكفي، فالخطوة الجاية هي التأكد من الـ mechanical capture عبر فحص الـ central pulses وبعدها الـ blood pressure وبعدها الـ GCS. لازم تتأكد إن النشاط الكهربائي عم ينتج capture ميكانيكي فعّال و output للقلب، وإذا ما في، ترفع الـ voltage لحد ما يحصل.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط إنك تختار check for electrical capture، لأنها هي أصلاً اللي شفتها على الـ ECG. أو تروح فوراً لإعطاء isoprenaline أو adrenaline. الأول خطوة التأكد من pulse و blood pressure، أما الـ electrical capture فبإشارة الـ spikes بس.

question:
A 56-year-old female presents to the Emergency Department with generalised weakness and tingling in her hands
and feet.
Which ECG finding is most consistent with hypocalcaemia?
englishExplanation:
Prolonged QT interval

Explanation
Hypocalcaemia characteristically prolongs the QT interval on ECG. This occurs due to lengthening of the ST segment
and delayed ventricular repolarisation.
Other ECG findings in hypocalcaemia may include T wave changes and QRS interval prolongation, but QT interval
prolongation is the most characteristic finding.
https://lms.resus.org.uk/modules/m10-v2-cardiac-arrest/10346/resources/chapter_12.pdf

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01450 source page 1019](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01450-study-p1019.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01450 source page 1020](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01450-study-p1020.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها generalized weakness و tingling باليدين والقدمين، والسؤال عن الـ ECG. في الـ hypocalcaemia الـ QT interval بيطول بشكل مميز، والسبب إن الـ ST segment بيطول وبتأخر الـ repolarisation للبطين. ممكن كمان تلاقي تغييرات بـ T wave وإطالة في الـ QRS، بس إطالة الـ QT هي أكثر نتيجة مميزة للـ hypocalcaemia وهي اللي بتفرقها عن باقي الاضطرابات.
الفخ: الخيار الغلط shortened QT interval أو ST-segment depression أو T wave inversion، لأن هما زي بعض ما بيوافقوا على hypocalcaemia. افرق: hypocalcaemia بيطوّل الـ QT، أما الـ hypercalcaemia هو اللي بيقصّره.

question:
A 42-year-old female presents to the Emergency Department with
chest discomfort that is exacerbated by lying supine and improves on
sitting forward. She reports having had an upper respiratory tract
infection two weeks ago.
Vital signs:
• Temperature 38.2°C
• Heart rate 102/min
• Blood pressure 128/76 mmHg
• Respiratory rate 18/min
• SpO2 98% on room air

Examination:
• Alert and oriented
• Mild distress, most comfortable sitting forward
• Heart sounds present with no obvious murmur
• Chest clear to auscultation
Which of the following is not a treatment option for this patient?
englishExplanation:
Fondaparinux
Explanation
This clinical presentation suggests acute pericarditis, likely post-viral,
given the recent upper respiratory tract infection. The characteristic
chest pain that worsens when supine and improves with sitting forward, along with fever and tachycardia, supports this diagnosis. While
colchicine, NSAIDs, aspirin, and corticosteroids are all valid treatment
options for acute pericarditis, anticoagulation is not indicated.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة 42 سنة، ألم الصدر بيزيد لما تستلقي supine وبتحسن لما تجلس للأمام، ومعها حرارة 38.2 و tachycardia 102، وقبل أسبوعين كان عندها upper respiratory tract infection. هاي acute pericarditis بعد عدوى فيروسية، وألمها الموضعي مع الحرارة هي اللي بتأكد التشخيص. الـ colchicine و NSAIDs و aspirin والـ corticosteroids كلها خيارات علاجية صحيحة لهالحالة، أما الـ anticoagulation فمبينش له داعي فيها.
الفخ: الخيار الخطأ إنك تختار colchicine أو ibuprofen أو aspirin أو prednisone كأنها مو صالحة، بينما هي كلها علاجات صالحة لـ acute pericarditis. اللي ما بينفع هو anticoagulation زي Fondaparinux، لأن ما في indication لتخثير الدم بحد ذاته.

question:
A 45-year-old male presents to the Emergency Department with progressive shortness of breath and chest discomfort for the past week. 
His vital signs are as follows: 
BP 100/60 mmHg
HR 150/min
RR 24/min
SpO2 95% on room air
His ECG is below. 

Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation:
Cardiac tamponade
Explanation
Electrical alternans is a highly specific finding (specificity >90%) for
pericardial effusion and cardiac tamponade. It represents an alternating pattern of QRS complex amplitude on the ECG, caused by the heart
swinging within a fluid-filled pericardial sac.

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01479 source page 1037](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01479-study-p1037.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01479 source page 1038](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01479-study-p1038.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01479 source page 2532](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01479-frcem-p2532.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01479 source page 2533](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01479-frcem-p2533.jpg)

![Study-FRCEM-2025-01479 source page 2534](images/Study-FRCEM-2025-01479-frcem-p2534.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ electrical alternans على الـ ECG يعني إن سعة الـ QRS بتبدّل بالتناوب، وهاد بيحصل لأن القلب بيتأرجح جوّا كيس الـ pericardium المملوء بسائل. هاي العلامة بتعتبر highly specific (أكتر من 90%) للـ pericardial effusion وللـ cardiac tamponade مع بعض. يعني لمّا تشوف هاي الحالة مع ضيق نفس متدرّج وتسرع قلب، لازم تفكر بـ cardiac tamponade من أول خاطرة.
الفخ: اللي بيوقع بالطلاب إنه يختاروا acute myocardial infarction لأن فيه chest discomfort وتسرع قلب، بس الـ electrical alternans بتدل على قلب بيتأرجح في سائل. وكمان فرّق بين effusion وtamponade: الـ effusion ممكن بدون أي ضغط على القلب.

question: What is the BEST predictor of syncope recurrence?

options.text: Chest pain prior to syncopal event

englishExplanation:
1.  The answer is D. (Chapter 52) A history of any previous syncope in the preceding year was associated with a 
1-year probability of 46% for syncope recurrence, compared to 7% syncope recurrence for patients without a 
previous history.

![Tintinalli-2023-00083 source page 48](images/Tintinalli-2023-00083-Tintinalli-2023-p0048.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00083 source page 60](images/Tintinalli-2023-00083-Tintinalli-2023-p0060.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: أحسن predictor لتكرار الـ syncope هو وجود تاريخ أي episode سابقة من الـ syncope خلال السنة اللي قبلها. عند أولئك patients اللي عندهم هاد التاريخ، احتمال التكرار خلال سنة وصل 46%. وبالمقارنة، اللي ما عندهم أي تاريخ previous، احتمال التكرار كان 7% بس. يعني إذا سألت متى آخر مرة صار عنده إغماء، هاي هي المعلومة الأهم اللي بتفرق مع كل شي تاني.
الفخ: معظم الناس بتروح على age >65 أو chest pain قبل الإغماء أو إن الإغماء lasted أكثر من دقيقة، وهاد كله بينعطي clues بدون ما يوصل لنفس القوة التنبؤية. الفرق: syncopes سابقة خلال سنة هادي هي اللي بتميّز.

question:
Which of the following patients has the highest likelihood of a major adverse cardiac event in the next 
30 days?

options.text: A 32-year-old man with a history of diabetes,
A 50-year-old woman with no past medical history and no family history presents to the emergency department with pressure-like chest pain
A 67-year-old man with a history of diabetes,

correctAnswer: A 67-year-old man with a history of diabetes,
englishExplanation:
9.  The answer is C. (Chapter 51) The question is based 
on the HEART score for cardiac risk stratification of 
patients presenting with chest pain. A has a HEART score 
of 2 with slightly suspicious history (0), normal ECG (0), 
age <45 (0), three or more risk factors (2), and normal 
troponin (0). B has a HEART score of 4 with highly suspicious history (2), nonspecific ECG (1), age between 45 
and 65 (1), no risk factors (0), and normal troponin (0). 
Choice C has a HEART score of 7 with moderately suspicious history (1), significant ST depression (2), age >65 
(2), three or more risk factors (2), normal troponin (0). 
D has a HEART score of 5 with moderately suspicious history (1), nonspecific ECG (1), age >65 (2), 2 risk factors 
(1), normal troponin (0).
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الـ HEART score بتاعه 7، وهو أعلى score بين الخيارات. الـ history عنده moderately suspicious يعطي 1، والـ ECG فيه ST depression واضح يعطي 2، وعمره >65 يعطي 2، وعنده 3 risk factors أو أكثر (diabetes، hypertension، hypercholesterolemia، وfamily history of early myocardial infarction) بيقسموا 2، والـ troponin طبيعي 0. مجموع النقاط 7 يعني أعلى احتمال لـ major adverse cardiac event خلال 30 يوم، فهاد هو الجواب.
الفخ: الـ troponin الطبيعي ما بيطمنك، لأن الـ troponin ممكن يطلع طبيعي مع NSTEMI. الترتيب بين الخيارات مهم: A عنده score 2، وB عنده 4، وD عنده 5، وكلهم أقل من C.

question:
Which of the following correctly lists the mortality 
risk associated with syncope etiology from highest to 
lowest?
englishExplanation:
10.  The answer is A.  (Chapter 52) The Framingham 
study showed that cardiac syncope doubled the risk of 
death, neurologic syncope increased the risk of death by 
50%, and unknown cause of syncope increased the risk of 
death by 30%. Vasovagal syncope carried no increase in 
risk of death when compared to the general population.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: حسب دراسة Framingham، الـ syncope اللي سببها cardiac ضاعفت خطر الموت مقارنة مع عامة الناس. والـ neurologic syncope زاد خطر الموت 50%، والـ unknown cause زاده 30% بس. أما الـ vasovagal syncope فماحيش زيادة أبداً مقارنة مع عامة السكان. فترتيب الخطورة من أعلى لأقل بيكون: cardiac، ثم neurologic، ثم unknown، وأخيراً vasovagal. يعني إذا الـ syncope سببها cardiac، هاد أخطر شي عليك تستنتبه وتتعامل معه على أساسه.
الفخ: الخيار التاني بيبدّل ترتيب neurologic مع unknown، فبيخلّي الترتيب كله غلط. حافظ على إن vasovagal هو آخر واحد، لأنه الوحيد اللي ما زاد فيه خطر الموت مقارنة مع عامة السكان.

question:
Which statement regarding physical examination 
findings in patients with acute myocardial infarction 
is correct?

options.text: Patient who present with acute coronary syndrome are almost always tachycardic and
Reproducible chest pain, tenderness to the chest

englishExplanation:
12.  The answer is C.  (Chapter 49) The most common 
physical examination findings associated with acute myocardial infarction (MI) are hypotension, S3 gallop, and 
diaphoresis. Distant low-pitched rattling breath sounds 
are often heard with patient’s presenting with chronic 
obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Reproducible 
chest pain, tenderness to the chest wall, has been reported 
with the diagnosis of acute MI in 15% of patients.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: أكتر الـ physical examination findings اللي بتلاقيها مع acute myocardial infarction هي hypotension، وS3 gallop، وdiaphoresis. يعني المريض اللي بيجي بألم صدر بعد ما يكون عنده MI غالباً بيشوف drop واضح بالضغط، وربو ثالث بالصدر، وتعرّق لزوق. هاي الثلاثي هي اللي لازم تتذكرها للامتحان، ولاحظ إن الـ reproducible chest pain مع tenderness للصدر بيطلع مع 15% بس من مرضى acute MI، فمو用它 كـ basis للقرار.
الفخ: الخيار D (reproducible chest pain) وA (distant low-pitched rattling breath sounds) بيخليوك تفكر إنو chest wall ولا COPD. الـ distant رنين بيطلع مع COPD، والـ reproducible pain موجود بـ 15% بس، أما الـ S3 gallop وdiaphoresis فهما الدايم مع الـ MI.

question:
Heart failure has a poor prognosis with approximately 
50% of patients diagnosed dying within what period 
of time?
englishExplanation:
13.  The answer is B.  (Chapter 53) According to the 
American Heart Association 2014 Heart Disease statistics, survival after heart failure diagnosis has improved 
over time. However, the death rate remains high; approximately 50% of people diagnosed with heart failure will die 
within 5 years.

![Tintinalli-2023-00095 source page 50](images/Tintinalli-2023-00095-Tintinalli-2023-p0050.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00095 source page 51](images/Tintinalli-2023-00095-Tintinalli-2023-p0051.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00095 source page 61](images/Tintinalli-2023-00095-Tintinalli-2023-p0061.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: حسب إحصائيات American Heart Association لعام 2014، البقاء بعد تشخيص heart failure تحسّن مع الوقت، بس نسبة الوفاة ل زالت عالية. حوالي 50% من الناس اللي بيتشخص عندهم heart failure بيموتوا خلال 5 سنوات من وقت التشخيص. يعني الـ prognosis دي بتاعة الـ heart failure سيئة، ومهما كانت الخبرة عندك الـ mortality rate بعد التشخيص ل زالت من أعلى المعدلات.
الفخ: الخيار 10 و20 سنة بيبانوا أطول منطقياً، بس الأرقام اللي بالمصدر بتقول 5 سنوات. وكمان ما تفكر إن البقاء تحسّن لدرجة إن الـ prognosis بقا كويس، لأن الـ mortality rate ل زالت عالية.

question: Which of the following statements regarding CT coronary angiography is TRUE?

options.text: Approximately 20% of patients will have a nondiagnostic CT coronary angiography and thus
Patients undergoing cardiac evaluation with CT
The cost of cardiac evaluation with CT coronary

correctAnswer: Approximately 20% of patients will have a nondiagnostic CT coronary angiography and thus
englishExplanation:
15.  The answer is A. (Chapter 51) CT coronary angiography allows for rapid evaluation of the coronary arteries 
with the use of peripheral IV contrast. Images are improved 
with a heart rate <65 and more advanced CT scanner 
equipment. Studies have shown that no significant disease 
was missed on CT coronary testing, but approximately 
20% of patients have a nondiagnostic result and thus are 
required to complete traditional stress testing. The test 
provides very limited assessment of cardiac function and 
is not as valuable for patients with known coronary artery 
disease. Studies have shown that CT coronary angiography can decrease length of stay for emergency department 
patients but does result in significant radiation exposure 
for the patient. Overall cost of CT coronary angiography 
is similar to traditional coronary artery testing.

![Tintinalli-2023-00097 source page 51](images/Tintinalli-2023-00097-Tintinalli-2023-p0051.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00097 source page 61](images/Tintinalli-2023-00097-Tintinalli-2023-p0061.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ CT coronary angiography بيعطيك تقييم سريع للشرايين التاجية مع IV contrast، بس حوالي 20% من المرضى بتطلع النتيجة عندهم nondiagnostic، وهاد معناه إنهم لازم يكملوا stress testing تقليدي. الصور بتتحسّن لما الـ heart rate يكون أقل من 65 ومع جهاز CT متطوّر، والدراسات ما لقت إن أي significant disease اتفوت. الاختبار كمان بيعطي تقييم محدود جداً لـ cardiac function.
الفخ: الخيار B بيقول إن الـ CT لحاله كافي، وهاد غلط لأن 20% nondiagnostic وبيحتاجوا additional testing. وكمان الخيار D بيحكي عن تقليل التكلفة، بس التكلفة الكلية للـ CT coronary angiography مش مختلفة بشكل واضح عن traditional coronary artery testing.

question: Which of the following is considered first-line treatment for nitroglycerin-associated headache?
englishExplanation:
21.  The answer is A. (Chapter 53) Headache is a common side effect following administration of nitroglycerin 
due to vasodilation in cerebral circulation. The first-line 
treatment is acetaminophen that has been shown to usually be adequate as monotherapy. Caffeine is often used 
for post lumbar puncture headaches or tension headaches, 
but in the setting of heart failure or ischemic chest pain 
will increase oxygen demand and thus not be an appropriate choice. Opiates are not considered first-line treatment 
for headaches. Prochlorperazine is used to treat nausea, 
vomiting, and off-label treatment of migraines.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ headache من أكثر الـ side effects شي بعد ما تعطي nitroglycerin، والسبب إنه بيصير vasodilation في الـ cerebral circulation. أول خط علاجي هو acetaminophen، وهو بعد بينت الدراسات إنه بيكفي كـ monotherapy وبيكون adequate في أغلب الحالات. فالسؤال سهل: بعد الـ nitro إذا اشتكى من صداع، ابدأ بـ acetaminophen وما تفكر بالخيارات التانية، وهاد السبب اللي يخليك تختار acetaminophen.
الفخ: الـ caffeine بتنفع مع post lumbar puncture headache و tension headache، بس في heart failure أو ischemic chest pain بيزود oxygen demand فمش مناسب. والـ opiates والـ prochlorperazine (للـ nausea والـ vomiting وmigraine off-label) مو first-line للصداع.

question:
You are examining a 74-year-old man in the emergency department who tells you he has a cardiac 
valve that was replaced several years ago. On chest 
auscultation you hear a loud, clicking metallic sound 
associated with S1. Which of the following is TRUE 
regarding mechanical valves when compared to bioprosthetic valves?

options.text: Mechanical valves are more frequently rejected
Mechanical valves carry an increased risk of

correctAnswer: Mechanical valves carry an increased risk of
englishExplanation:
25.  The answer is B. (Chapter 54) Mechanical valves are 
more durable with lower failure rates, but they do carry a 
higher risk for thromboembolic complications. Antiplatelet therapy is recommended for all patients with prosthetic 
valves; however, for patients with mechanical valves lifelong anticoagulation is recommended. The risk of valve 
thrombosis or thromboembolism is about 8% and falls to 
1% to 2% per year with anticoagulation.

50
TINTINALLI’S EMERGENCY MEDICINE EXAMINATION AND BOARD REVIEW, 9TH EDITION
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ mechanical valves أكتر durability وأقل failure من الـ bioprosthetic، بس هي بتعمل risk أعلى للـ thromboembolic complications ومنهم stroke. عشان كده، كل مريض عنده prosthetic valve لازم ياخد antiplatelet therapy، واللي عنده mechanical valve لازم يكون على lifelong anticoagulation. خطر الـ valve thrombosis أو الـ thromboembolism حوالي 8%، وينزل لـ 1% لـ 2% سنوياً مع الـ anticoagulation.
الفخ: الخيار C بيقول إن الـ mechanical valves بتفشل أكتر، وهاد غلط لأنها أكتر durability. والعكس من كده، الخيار D بيحكي عن surgical replacement، بس الـ issue الحقيقي هو الـ anticoagulation مدى الحياة مش الاستبدال.

question:
Emergency medical services (EMS) responds to a call 
for a 75-year-old man with no known past medical 
history who is prescribed no medications. He complains of chest pain and mild shortness of breath. 
The patient’s vital signs are BP 75/45, HR 102, RR 22, 
SpO2 97% on RA, and T 37°C. The patient has clear 
lung sounds and faint equal radial and femoral pulses. 
EMS established an IV and obtained an ECG that 
demonstrates ST elevation in the inferior leads with 
ST depression in leads I and aVL. You are contacted 
to provide medical command. Which of the following 
is the BEST prehospital advice for this patient?
englishExplanation:
31.  The answer is B. (Chapter 50) The patient presents 
with cardiogenic shock due to ischemia. The most important intervention for ischemic-related cardiogenic shock is 
emergent revascularization. Stabilization in the emergency 
department is temporizing, and the ultimate goal is definitive therapy as fast as possible. In the prehospital setting, 
Emergency Medical Services should direct any suspected 
cardiogenic shock to a facility that has 24-hour emergency 
cardiac revascularization capability. Therefore, answers A 
and C are incorrect because the 10 minutes saved in transport do not make up for the patient benefit of presenting 
to the facility that can manage his specific disease. Answer 
D is incorrect because metoprolol is contraindicated in a 
patient presenting with cardiogenic shock.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده cardiogenic shock بسبب ischemia، وأهم تدخل في هاد الموقف هو emergent revascularization. الـ stabilization في الـ ED هو temporizing بس، والهدف النهائي هو definitive therapy بأسرع وقت. في الـ prehospital setting لازم EMS يوجّه أي suspected cardiogenic shock لمركز عنده 24-hour emergency cardiac revascularization capability، يعني عنده PCI capability. فتعطي 324 mg chewable aspirin و bolus من 500-mL normal saline IV وبتوجّه للمركز اللي بعده 15 دقيقة.
الفخ: الخيارين A وC بيوجّهوا للمركز الأقرب اللي ما عنده PCI، والـ 10 دقائق اللي بتوفّرها بالـ transport ما بتغطي فايدة إنك توصل لمركز يقدر يتعامل مع هاد المرض. والخيار D غلط كمان لأن metoprolol contraindicated في مريض عنده cardiogenic shock.

question: Which of the following cardiomyopathies is the leading cause of sudden death in competitive athletes?
englishExplanation:
34.  The answer is D. (Chapter 55) Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is the second most common cause of sudden 
cardiac death in the adolescent population and the leading 
cause of sudden death in competitive athletes. Common 
clinical features include chest pain, dyspnea on exertion, 
syncope, and a systolic ejection murmur. Overall, dilated 
cardiomyopathy is the most common cardiomyopathy. It 
can present with systolic and diastolic dysfunction and 
regurgitant murmurs. Brugada syndrome and arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy can predispose to 
arrhythmias and have specific findings on the ECG.

CHAPTER 5  •  Cardiovascular Disorders
51
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ hypertrophic cardiomyopathy هي السبب الأول لموت المفاجئ عند الرياضيين المنافسين، وهي تاني أكثر سبب لموت القلب المفاجئ عند المراهقين. علاماتها السريرية الشائعة: chest pain، وdyspnea on exertion، وsyncope، وsystolic ejection murmur. فالرياضي اللي بي.syncope مع ألم صدر وقت الجري لازم تفكر فيها من أول شي، لأن هاي أقوى indication لازم تعمل فيها evaluation.
الفخ: الخيار C (dilated cardiomyopathy) هي الأكثر شي بشكل عام، بس مش هي اللي بتقتل الرياضيين فجأة. وBrugada وarrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy إلهم ECG findings خاصة، بس نسبتهم أقل من HCM عند الرياضيين.

question:
You are considering ordering a d-dimer on a patient. 
However, you remember there are conditions that can 
falsely elevate or lower the test. Which of the following factors could cause a false negative test?
englishExplanation:
40.  The answer is C. (Chapter 56) Multiple factors can 
cause a false-negative as well as a false-positive d-dimer. 
Age >70, pregnancy, active malignancy, surgical procedure in the last week, liver disease, infections, and trauma 
can all cause a false positive. Warfarin, symptoms lasting 
over 5 days, small clots, a small isolated pulmonary infarction, and lipemia can cause false negatives.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ d-dimer عندو مواقف بتطلع فيها نتيجة غلط، وهاد اللي بيلخبطك. الـ lipemia من高分子 الـ lipid بالدم بتخلي الـ assay يعطي false negative، يعني نتيجة طبيعية مع إن في thrombotic disease. كماني warfarin، والأعراض اللي استمرت أكثر من 5 أيام، والـ small clots، والـ small isolated pulmonary infarction، كلهم بيسببوا false negative. والمعنى إن نتيجة الـ d-dimer الطبيعية ما بتستثني الـ thrombotic disease خالص.
الفخ: الخيارات A (age >70) وB (pregnancy) وD (liver disease) كلها بسببوا false positive مش false negative. يعني العكس تام: إنت عم تلاقي إن الـ test عالي بدون سبب، مش إنه طبيعي مع إن في جلطة.

question:
A 70-year-old man presents with chest pain and 
shortness of breath. A d-dimer is ordered and results 
at 750 ng/mL. Which of the following formulas can be 
used to age adjust the d-dimer to determine if further 
diagnostic testing is necessary?
englishExplanation:
41.  The answer is A.  (Chapter 56) d-dimer increases 
with age. The most common formula studied is age × 
10 ng/mL. When used with a Well’s score of ≤4 or a simplified Geneva score <5, this resulted in a false-negative 
rate of 0.3% in one large study. This assumes the d-dimer 
is adjusted from a conventional cutoff of 500 ng/mL. In 
this patient’s case, the age adjusted d-dimer cutoff would 
have been 700 ng/mL (70 × 10 ng/mL).
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ d-dimer بيطلع مع العمر، وأشهر formula للـ age adjustment هي Age × 10 ng/mL. لمريض بعمر 70 سنة، الـ cutoff بيكون 700 ng/mL (70 × 10 ng/mL). هاي الطريقة بتستخدم مع Well’s score ≤4 أو simplified Geneva score <5، وبدراسة كبيرة طلّع false-negative rate 0.3% بس، مع افتراض إن الـ cutoff الأصلي 500 ng/mL.
الفخ: الـ cutoff الـ age-adjusted أعلى من 500، بس لسا تحت قيمة الـ d-dimer عند المريض، فالنتيجة 750 ng/mL ما بتخليه negative. والقيم التانية (نص العمر، أو قسمة على العمر) مو الـ formula المعتمدة.

question:
Which of the following is the BEST initial diagnostic 
test to assess pulmonary hypertension in the emergency department?
englishExplanation:
48.  The answer is C. (Chapter 58) Transthoracic echocardiography allows estimation of the pulmonary artery 
systolic pressure and detection of decreased right ventricular function, right atrial and ventricular hypertrophy, 
and leftward deviation of the intraventricular septum that 
are indicative of more severe disease. The other diagnostics can all be abnormal with pulmonary hypertension 
but do not necessarily assess the degree of severity of the 
disease, although troponin elevations are associated with 
increased morbidity and mortality.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ transthoracic echocardiography هي أحسن اختبار أولي في الـ ED لتقييم pulmonary hypertension. بتقدر منها تقدّر systolic pressure للـ pulmonary artery، وتكشف decreased right ventricular function، والـ hypertrophy للـ right atrium والـ right ventricle، وleftward deviation للـ intraventricular septum، وكل هاي علامات بتشير لمرض أشد. الاختبارات التانية ممكن تتغير، بس ما بتقيس severity. وهاد بيخليها الاختبار اللي بيعطيك صورة كاملة عن شدة المرض عند الـ bedside.
الفخ: BNP وchest x-ray وtroponin كلهم ممكن يطلعوا abnormal مع pulmonary hypertension، بس ما بيعطوك degree of disease. وكمان troponin مرتبط ب increased morbidity and mortality، بس هاد مش معناه إنه أحسن test لتقييم الـ pulmonary hypertension نفسه.

question:
Which of the following classification systems is NOT 
paired correctly?

options.text: DeBakey type 1: Dissection involving the ascending aorta, the arch, and the descending aorta
DeBakey type 2: Dissection involving only the
Stanford A: Aortic dissection involving the
Stanford B: Aortic dissection only involving the

correctAnswer: DeBakey type 2: Dissection involving only the
englishExplanation:
54.  The answer is B. (Chapter 59) There are two common classification schemes used to characterize aortic 
dissection, Stanford and DeBakey. Stanford divides dissections into types A and B. Type A includes dissections 
that involve the ascending aorta while type B only involves 
the descending aorta. DeBakey is divided into three types. 
Type 1 involves the ascending aorta, descending aorta, 
and the arch; type 2 only involves the ascending aorta; and 
type 3 only involves the descending aorta.

![Tintinalli-2023-00136 source page 57](images/Tintinalli-2023-00136-Tintinalli-2023-p0057.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00136 source page 58](images/Tintinalli-2023-00136-Tintinalli-2023-p0058.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00136 source page 66](images/Tintinalli-2023-00136-Tintinalli-2023-p0066.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: في تصنيفين شغلتين لـ aortic dissection، هم Stanford وDeBakey. الـ DeBakey type 2 بيصير في الـ ascending aorta بس، مو الـ descending aorta، يعني الاقتران اللي كاتب في الخيار B غلط. صح: DeBakey type 1 بيشمل الـ ascending aorta والـ arch والـ descending aorta، وtype 3 بيشمل الـ descending aorta بس. أما Stanford: type A فيه الـ ascending aorta، وtype B فيه الـ descending aorta بس.
الفخ: دايماً اعرف الفرقي بين التصنيفين: Stanford بيقسم بنوعين، وDeBakey بثلاثة. الخيار A (DeBakey type 1) مو غلط لأن فيه الـ arch كمان، والخيار C وD عن Stanford وصحيحين. الغلط الوحيد هو B.

question: While rare, aortic dissection can occur during pregnancy. Which of the following statements about aortic dissection in pregnancy is CORRECT?

options.text: A bicuspid aortic valve is not a risk factor for aortic dissection.
A CT scan should not be used to make the
It usually occurs in the third trimester or postpartum period.
Nitroglycerin should not be administered in

correctAnswer: It usually occurs in the third trimester or postpartum period.
englishExplanation:
56.  The answer is C.  (Chapter 59) Aortic dissection 
normally occurs in the third trimester or postpartum 
period. A bicuspid aortic valve, connective tissue disorders, hypertension, and family history are all risk factors 
for aortic dissection. Nitroglycerin can be safely administered in pregnant patients. While radiation exposure to 
the fetus should be minimized, aortic dissection is a lifethreatening disease and a CT scan may be appropriate to 

54
TINTINALLI’S EMERGENCY MEDICINE EXAMINATION AND BOARD REVIEW, 9TH EDITION
exclude the diagnosis, especially if the patient is not stable 
to go to MRI.

![Tintinalli-2023-00138 source page 58](images/Tintinalli-2023-00138-Tintinalli-2023-p0058.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00138 source page 66](images/Tintinalli-2023-00138-Tintinalli-2023-p0066.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00138 source page 67](images/Tintinalli-2023-00138-Tintinalli-2023-p0067.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ aortic dissection بشكل نادر بصير أثناء الحمل، بسهاد للمريضة، بيصير عادةً بالـ third trimester أو بعد الولادة (postpartum). لازم تعرف إن الـ bicuspid aortic valve، واضطرابات connective tissue، وhypertension، وfamily history كلها risk factors. وحتى مع الحمل، الـ CT scan ممكن يكون مناسب لاستبعاد التشخيص، خاصة إذا المريضة مو stable enough إنك تاخدها على MRI.
الفخ: الخيار A غلط لأن الـ bicuspid aortic valve هو risk factor، والخيار D غلط لأن الـ nitroglycerin ممكن يُعطى بأمان للمريضة الحامل. والخيار B غلط لأن الـ CT مسموح به إذا المريضة مو stable، لأن التشخيص life-threatening.

question: What is Cullen’s sign?

options.text: Pain upon extension of the hip

englishExplanation:
59.  The answer is D. (Chapter 60) Periumbilical ecchymosis from retroperitoneal or intra-abdominal bleeding 
is known as Cullen’s sign. It is not specific for a ruptured 
abdominal aortic aneurysm. It can also occur in pancreatitis or ruptured ectopic pregnancy. Grey Turner’s sign is 
flank ecchymosis. An iliopsoas sign is pain upon extension of the hip, which can occur due to retroperitoneal 
blood irritating the psoas muscle. While blood can compress the femoral nerve causing a neuropathy, abdominal 
aortic aneurysms do not typically alter femoral arterial 
pulsations. It is important to note that external signs of 
an acute rupture of an abdominal aortic aneurysm are 
not reliably found and their absence does not exclude the 
disease.

![Tintinalli-2023-00141 source page 58](images/Tintinalli-2023-00141-Tintinalli-2023-p0058.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00141 source page 67](images/Tintinalli-2023-00141-Tintinalli-2023-p0067.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ Cullen’s sign هو ecchymosis حول السرة (periumbilical) وبيجي من نزيف retroperitoneal أو داخل البطن. هو مش specific للـ ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm، لأنه كمان ممكن يظهر مع pancreatitis أو ruptured ectopic pregnancy. يعني هو sign على نزيف داخلي، مو تشخيص لحاله، وكمان العلامات الخارجية ما بتلاقيها دائماً بالـ AAA rupture. ولما تشوف هاي العلامة، لازم تفكر إن في نزيف retroperitoneal أو داخل البطن حتى لو ما عندك symptoms تانية واضحة.
الفخ: الخيار B (flank ecchymosis) هو Grey Turner's sign، والخيار C (pain upon extension of the hip) هو iliopsoas sign. والخيار A (biphasic femoral artery pulsations) ما بيحصل مع AAA عادة. وكمان انتبه: غياب العلامات الخارجية ما بينفي rupture.

question:
A 45-year-old man with a past history of abdominal 
aortic aneurysm with an aortic graft presents with 
abdominal pain. He denies a history of peptic ulcer 
disease, liver disease, hepatitis B or C, intravenous 
drug use, or alcoholism. He denies burning pain or 
pain that is worse with eating. While evaluating him, 
he develops a sudden and large upper gastrointestinal 
bleed. What is the MOST LIKELY diagnosis?
englishExplanation:
60.  The answer is A. (Chapter 60) This patient has a history of an aortic graft placement with sudden, massive 
upper gastrointestinal bleeding that should worry the provider for the development of an aortoenteric fistula. These 
fistulas frequently involve the duodenum. Mild bleeding 
may be the first sign but massive, life-threatening bleeding is common. Aortic aneurysms can erode into vasculature forming an arteriovenous fistula. These patients 
present with high-output cardiac failure and decreased 
arterial blood flow distal to the fistula. This patient does 
not have liver disease or a history of peptic ulcer disease. 
While both are still possible, given this patient’s history 
and the high mortality associated with it, aortoenteric fistula needs to be ruled out first.

![Tintinalli-2023-00142 source page 58](images/Tintinalli-2023-00142-Tintinalli-2023-p0058.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00142 source page 67](images/Tintinalli-2023-00142-Tintinalli-2023-p0067.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: مريض عنده history من abdominal aortic aneurysm مع aortic graft وبيجي بألم بطن، وبعدين فجأة صار عنده نزيف upper gastrointestinal كبير. هاي بالذات بتخلّيك تفكر بـ aortoenteric fistula، وهاي الـ fistulas غالباً بتinvolve الـ duodenum. النزف الخفيف ممكن يكون أول علامة، بس النزف الضخم المميت شائع. ومع إنو ما عنده liver disease ولا peptic ulcer disease، لازم تستبعد الـ fistula الأول بسبب الـ high mortality.
الفخ: الـ arteriovenous fistula بتدي high-output cardiac failure مع decreased arterial blood flow distal للـ fistula، مش نزيف GI. أما الـ esophageal varices وgastric ulcer فاللي عنده تاريخ graft وbleeding مفاجئ هو اللي بيميل للـ fistula.

question:
A patient presents with abdominal pain. An abdominal ultrasound is obtained (Figure 5.5). What landmark shown on the ultrasound can help to distinguish 
between the aorta and inferior vena cava?
englishExplanation:
61.  The answer is C.  (Chapter 60) The patient has an 
abdominal aortic aneurysm as defined as an aneurysm 
≥3.0 cm in diameter when measured from the outside 
margin of one wall to the outside margin of the opposite 
wall. A technically adequate ultrasound has >90% sensitivity for demonstrating an aneurysm. This ultrasound 
also demonstrates the superior mesenteric artery, which 
can distinguish the aorta from the vena cava. The other 
three answer choices would not be useful to distinguish 
between the two and are not demonstrated in the picture.

![Tintinalli-2023-00143 source page 58](images/Tintinalli-2023-00143-Tintinalli-2023-p0058.jpg)

![Tintinalli-2023-00143 source page 67](images/Tintinalli-2023-00143-Tintinalli-2023-p0067.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: على الـ abdominal ultrasound، الـ superior mesenteric artery هي landmark بتميّز الـ aorta عن الـ inferior vena cava. وكمان الـ abdominal aortic aneurysm بيتعرّف إذا كان قطره 3.0 cm أو أكثر، بمقياس من الحافة الخارجية لحيط واحد لحد الحافة الخارجية للحيط المقابل. والـ technically adequate ultrasound حساسيته أكثر من 90% لعرض الـ aneurysm، وهاي الـ superior mesenteric artery موجودة بالصورة.
الفخ: الخيارات التانية (liver، proper hepatic artery، uterus) ما بتظهر بالصورة وما بتفيد تمييز الـ aorta عن الـ vena cava. فإذا ما لقيت الـ superior mesenteric artery الـ landmark، رجع اعتمد على anatomic landmarks التانية.

question:
A patient presents with progressive pain in his legs 
while walking that improves with rest. His examination is notable for delayed capillary refill. An 
ankle-brachial index is ordered due to concerns for 
peripheral arterial disease. What is the normal value 
for an ankle-brachial index?
englishExplanation:
63.  The answer is C.  (Chapter 61) The ankle-brachial 
index is the ratio of the systolic blood pressure with the cuff 
just above the malleolus to the highest brachial pressure in 
either arm. Patients with peripheral arterial disease have 
an ankle-brachial ratio <0.9. Values <0.25 are concerning for limb-threatening vascular disease. Normal values 
are between 0.91 and 1.3. An index >1.3 is likely from a 
noncompressible vessel, which may be seen in patients 
with severe vascular calcifications. Segmental blood pressures can also be obtained to determine if the patient has 
peripheral arterial disease. A difference of 30 mm Hg or 
more between two adjacent areas on the leg (e.g., below 
the knee and above the knee) suggest obstructing disease.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ ankle-brachial index هو نسبة الـ systolic blood pressure مع الكUFF فوق الـ malleolus، لأعلى brachial pressure بأي من الإيدين. القيمة الطبيعية بين 0.91 و1.3، فالـ 1.2 داخل المدى الطبيعي. المرضى اللي عندهم peripheral arterial disease بيكون عندهم ratio أقل من 0.9، والقيم أقل من 0.25 مقلقة من disease مهدّد للطرف. وبما إن 1.2 هو الرقم الوحيد من الخيارات اللي داخل المدى الطبيعي، فهاد هو الجواب.
الفخ: الرقم 0.4 يعني مرض severe مهدّد للطرف مو قيمة طبيعية، والخيار 1.4 (أكبر من 1.3) غالباً بيكون من vessel غير قابل للعصر، وهاد بيصير مع calcification شديدة. وكمان الـ 0.8 أقل من 0.9 فكلا disease.

question:
A 56-year-old man with diabetes presents with pain 
and swelling in his legs. His symptoms improve with 
hanging his foot over his bed. On examination he is 
noted to have an irregular heart rhythm with pallor 
and diminished pulses to his leg. He is diagnosed with 
acute embolic limb ischemia from atrial fibrillation. 
Atrial fibrillation is the most common cause of acute 
embolic limb ischemia, but what is the second most 
common cause?
englishExplanation:
64.  The answer is B. (Chapter 61) Acute limb ischemia 
due to embolism is less common than occlusion from 
thrombosis. This is in part due to the decline in rheumatic 
heart disease and the improvement in the management of 
patients with atrial fibrillation. Even with this improvement, atrial fibrillation is still the leading cause of embolic 
ischemic disease. The second most common source is 
from a mural thrombus that forms in the ventricle after 
a recent myocardial infarction (MI). This accounts for 
approximately 20% of all limb emboli. Heart valves, myxomas, and vegetations are rare causes of embolic disease.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ atrial fibrillation هي السبب الأول لـ acute embolic limb ischemia، بس السبب التاني هو الـ mural thrombus اللي بيتكوّن في الـ ventricle بعد MI حديثة. هاد بيمثّل حوالي 20% من كل الـ limb emboli. وسبب إن الـ AF بقيت الأولى هو إن rheumatic heart disease قلّت وتحسّن management بتاع مرضى الـ AF، بس لسا هي الأكثر شي.
الفخ: الـ heart valves والـ myxomas والـ vegetations من valve leaflet أسباب نادرة للـ embolic disease. وكمان الـ embolic ischemia أقل شي من thrombosis الحاصل، بس هاد ما بيغيّر إن الـ mural thrombus هو السبب التاني.

question:
A 43-year-old woman with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation on warfarin presents with pain to her feet in 
the middle of summer. Physical examination reveals 
a regular cardiac rhythm with warm feet and palpable pulses. A few toes are noticed to be dusky, cool, 
and tender with delayed cap refill. She has a normal 
ankle-brachial index and an unremarkable cardiac 
echocardiogram. What is the cause of her abnormal 
examination finding?
englishExplanation:
65.  The answer is A. (Chapter 61) The patient has blue 
toe syndrome, which is also known as trash foot or purple 

CHAPTER 5  •  Cardiovascular Disorders
55
toe syndrome. It is most commonly caused by atheroemboli formed by plaque fragmentation causing obstruction of the microcirculation. The atheroemboli consist of 
cholesterol-laden debris and platelet aggregates. In addition to thrombi, blue toe syndrome is associated with 
warfarin. Embolic cardiac disease generally causes limb 
ischemia, although if the embolus fragments, it is possible to cause obstruction in the microcirculation. With a 
normal cardiac examination and normal echocardiogram, 
this would be less likely. Vasospasm such as occurs in 
Raynaud’s disease would be expected to cause the skin to 
turn white or pale prior to turning blue or purple. It normally occurs in response to cold temperatures and stress. 
Treatment generally includes warming the extremity.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاي الـ blue toe syndrome، يعني toe لونه أزرق أو بنفسجي ومؤلم، والسبب الأكثر شي هو atheroembolic disease. بتتكوّن من fragmentation للـ plaque وبتعمل obstruction للـ microcirculation، وهي عبارة عن cholesterol-laden debris مع platelet aggregates. الـ patient عندها warfarin على الـ background، والـ blue toe syndrome مرتبط كمان بالـ warfarin. الـ ABI عندها طبيعي والـ echocardiogram عندها عادي.
الفخ: الـ vasospasm مثل Raynaud’s بيخلّي الجلد يصير أبيض أو شاحب قبل ما يصير أزرق، وبيصير عادة بالبرد أو ضغط نفسي. والـ embolic cardiac disease أقل احتمالاً لأن الـ echocardiogram عادي.

question: Which of the following is true regarding the role of ipratropium in asthma management?

options.text: The main benefit of ipratropium, instead of atropine or other anticholinergic drugs, is
Ipratropium is useful as a sole bronchodilator in the treatment of acute asthma
Ipratropium is most useful as an adjunct for patients with severe asthma exacerbations.
Ipratropium has never been proven to be of benefit in patients with acute asthma

correctAnswer: Ipratropium is most useful as an adjunct for patients with severe asthma exacerbations.
englishExplanation:
Ipratropium is primarily useful as a second-line adjunctive agent in the treatment of 
patients with acute asthma exacerbations. Multiple trials in the late 1990s as well as a few 
metaanalyses have demonstrated benefit in patients treated with a combination of albuterol 
and ipratropium versus albuterol alone. In pediatric populations, combination therapy decreases 
treatment time in the ED, albuterol dose requirements before discharge, as well as 
hospitalization rates. In adults, combination therapy has been shown to increase peak 
expiratory flow rate more than albuterol alone. However, there are conflicting data regarding 
ipratropium, and some studies have failed to demonstrate benefit. Owing to this conflicting 
data, ipratropium has been relegated to use as a second-line agent. As it appears to be safe and 
well tolerated, most experts advice using it as an adjunctive agent in severe asthma 
exacerbations. It is not recommended for use as a single agent primarily because of its slower 
onset of action and because it only alleviates cholinergically mediated bronchoconstriction. The 
main benefit of ipratropium over atropine is its superior side effect profile.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ ipratropium بيعمل أساساً كـ second-line adjunctive agent في acute asthma exacerbations. عدة trials من أواخر التسعينات وكمان meta-analyses أثبتت فايدة الـ combination بين albuterol وipratropium مقارنة بـ albuterol لحاله. عند الأطفال الـ combination بيقلّل وقت العلاج بالـ ED، وحاجة الـ albuterol قبل الخروج، ومعدل الـ hospitalization. والـ data متعارضة شوي، عشان كده نزلوه لـ second-line agent وهو safe وwell tolerated.
الفخ: الخيار B غلط لأنه مو للـ monotherapy لأن الـ onset أبطأ وهو بيخفف بس bronchoconstriction cholinergic. والخيار A بيحكي إن فضلته إنه better side effect profile من atropine، بس هاد مش السبب الرئيسي للاستعمال، والخيار E غلط طبعاً.

question:
A 26-year-old female presents with dyspnea and pleuritic chest pain and is subsequently 
diagnosed with a PE. She is not pregnant, takes no oral contraceptive therapy, and is a 
nonsmoker, but she notes that her mother has had two PEs. Which of the following is the most 
likely cause of this patient’s PE?
englishExplanation:
There are numerous risk factors for PE, which can be divided into inherited and 
acquired disorders. Inherited hypercoagulable disorders should be suspected in patients with a 
documented PE who are younger than 40 years old, or in similar patients who have a positive 
family history or who have recurrent PEs. Of the inherited disorders, factor V Leiden is the most 
common, and may be present in as many as 20% of patients with venous thromboembolic 
disease. In normal individuals, factor V is normally inactivated (along with factor VIII) by protein 
C, thereby disrupting the normal clotting cascade. Patients with factor V Leiden have a factor V 
protein that is resistant to inactivation by protein C, which allows the coagulation cascade to 
continue in an unregulated manner, resulting in a thrombophilic state. Plasminogen deficiency 
and protein S deficiency are also inherited disorders that increase the risk of thromboembolic 
disease, but they are far less common. Nephrotic syndrome is also associated with an increased 
risk of PE due to a relative deficiency of coagulation cascade regulatory proteins, which are lost 
in the urine. Cancer in any form is a well-described risk factor for PE.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عمرها 26 سنة وعندها PE بدون حمل ولا oral contraceptive therapy وغير مدخنة، وأمها عندها PE مرتين. هاد بيرجّعنا لـ inherited hypercoagulable disorder، وأشهر واحد هو Factor V Leiden، وبيكون موجود بـ 20% من مرضى venous thromboembolic disease. طبيعياً factor V بينقص بواسطة protein C مع factor VIII، أما بهاد الـ mutation فيصير factor V resistant للـ inactivation، والـ cascade بيكمل بدون ضبط فتصير thrombophilic state.
الفخ: الـ plasminogen deficiency وprotein S deficiency كمان inherited وبيرفعوا الخطر، بس هما أقل شي بكثير. والـ nephrotic syndrome والـ cancer أسباب مكتسبة، وهنا عندنا تاريخ عائلي واضح بعمر صغير، فهاد بيميل للـ inherited cause.

question: Which of the following is the most frequently affected structure in thoracic outlet syndrome?
englishExplanation:
The thoracic outlet syndrome comprises a group of pathologic conditions associated 
with compression of the structures at the junction of the upper extremity and trunk. The 
findings are neurologic (95%), venous (4%), and arterial (1%). The most commonly affected 
structure is the ulnar nerve.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ thoracic outlet syndrome مجموعة حالات بتحصل فيها compression للـ structures عند تقاطع الـ upper extremity مع الـ trunk. التوزيع بيحكي إن الـ neurologic findings موجودة بـ 95% من الحالات، والـ venous بـ 4%، والـ arterial بـ 1%. والـ structure اللي بيصيب أكتر من غيره هو الـ ulnar nerve. يعني الشكل الشائع هو اللي فيه أعراض عصبية، والـ venous والـ arterial نادرين بالمقارنة.
الفخ: الـ subclavian artery والـ subclavian vein هم الـ structures اللي اسم الـ syndrome بيوصلهم، بس الـ involvement الفعلي عندهم 1% و4% بس. الـ ulnar nerve هو اللي بيفصل جوابك، والـ median nerve وradial nerve أقل إصابة.

question: Which of the following is true regarding lung abscesses?

options.text: The most common pathogen is Streptococcus pneumococcus.
Patients with anaerobic lung abscesses typically present with acute-onset chest pain, cough,
Lung abscess occurs most commonly in patients with poor oral hygiene.
Thoracotomy with abscess excision is the cornerstone of therapy.
Lung abscesses most commonly develop as a complication of pediatric pneumonia.

correctAnswer: Lung abscess occurs most commonly in patients with poor oral hygiene.
englishExplanation:
The development of a lung abscess is most commonly a consequence of aspiration in 
patients with poor oral hygiene. Less commonly, it may occur as a result of necrotizing 
pneumonia. Classically it has been thought that anaerobic bacteria are responsible for the great 
majority of lung abscesses. However, recent studies have revealed that the microbiology may 
differ between immunocompetent and immunocompromised patients. Although anaerobes are 
predominant in immunocompetent patients, patients with depressed immune systems are more 
frequently infected with aerobic bacteria such as S. aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella 
pneumoniae, and H. influenzae. Frequently, however, infections are polymicrobial. Nonbacterial 
organisms such as fungi and parasites may also cause lung abscesses. S. pneumococcus is not a 
common cause. Patients with anaerobic or fungal lung abscesses typically experience an 
indolent course of fever, productive cough, night sweats, anorexia, and weight loss. The sputum 
is classically malodorous, which should be a clue to the diagnosis. Immunocompromised 
patients presenting with a lung abscess as a result of aerobic necrotizing pneumonia present 
with acute symptoms of pneumonia and may be quite ill. Chest radiography typically reveals a 
cavitary lesion with an air–fluid level. Antibiotics remain the cornerstone of therapy although 
surgical management may ultimately be necessary. Typical surgical indications are medical 
treatment failure, suspected cancer, or congenital lung malformation. Lung abscesses very 
rarely develop in the setting of pediatric community acquired pneumonia and only occur 
typically in patients who are immunocompromised because of acquired immune deficiencies, 
malignancy or chemotherapy, and in patients who are predisposed to aspiration (children with 
neurologic disorders, decreased mental status, impaired cough, or swallowing dysfunction).
arabicExplanation:
ليش: تكوّن خُراج الرئة صار في معظم الحالات نتيجة لاستنشاق محتويات الفم عند المرضى اللي عندهم نظافة فم سيئة، والبكتيريا اللاهوائية هي السبب الغالب عندهم. المرضى منخفضي المناعة بيجيهم المرض أكثر من البكتيريا الهوائية مثل S. aureus وPseudomonas aeruginosa. العلاج الأساسي هو المضادات الحيوية، والبلغم بيجي برائحة كريهة وهي إشارة تساعد على التشخيص، والأشعة بتبيّن كتلة فيها مستوى سائل-هوائي.
الفخ: الطلبة بيفكروا إنه لازم نعمل جراحة ونشيل الخُراج مباشرة، بس الحقيقة المضادات الحيوية هي الأساس في العلاج والجراحة تبقى خيار أخير لما العلاج الدوائي ما ينجح.

question:
Which of the following is the most common cardiac rhythm in patients with pulmonary 
embolism (PE)?
englishExplanation:
Although sinus tachycardia is the most common arrhythmia in patients with PE, 
normal sinus rhythm remains the most common cardiac rhythm. A recent study demonstrated 
that roughly two-third of patients with PE have normal sinus rhythm (there was no significant 
difference from control patients). That doesn’t suggest, however, that most patients with PE 
have normal EKGs, as rhythm is only one aspect of EKG analysis. In fact, most patients with PEs 
have been found to have abnormal EKGs, but no single abnormality has been shown to have 
sufficient sensitivity or specificity to aid in the diagnosis. Therefore, the role of EKG in the 
evaluation of PE is to rule out the presence of alternative diagnoses, such as cardiac ischemia or 
pericarditis.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: بالرغم إنه تسرّع القلب الجيبي هو اضطراب النبض الأكثر شيوعاً بين مرضى PE، بس الإيقاع الجيبي الطبيعي بيبقى هو إيقاع القلب الأكثر شيوعاً لأن تقريباً ثلثي المرضى عندهم إيقاع طبيعي بدون فرق يذكر عن الأصحاء. تخطيط القلب عند أغلب مرضى PE بيكون غير طبيعي، بس ما في علامة وحدة حساسة ودقيقة تكفي لتشخيص PE. عشان هيك دور تخطيط القلب هو استبعاد تشخيصات ثانية مثل احتشاء القلب أو التهاب التامور.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا تسرّع القلب الجيبي لأنه مرتبط بـ PE، بس هو اضطراب نبض مش الإيقاع الأكثر شيوعاً، والإجابات الثانية مثل الرجفان الأذيني أو الرفرفة غير شائعة وما بتكون الصورة الأساسية.

question:
You are consulting the thoracic surgery service after having recently placed a chest tube in a 
22-yearold male for a 25% spontaneous pneumothorax. The consultant asks you whether there 
is still an “air leak” present. Assuming the patient’s lung re-expanded appropriately, what is the 
most likely significance of an air leak?

options.text: All patients will have an air leak after chest tube insertion.
The chest tube was inserted into a branch of the patient’s tracheobronchial tree.
The suction holes on the chest tube are not completely inserted into the chest cavity.
The water seal chamber does not have enough water in it.
There is still an unhealed defect in the patient’s bronchial tree.

correctAnswer: There is still an unhealed defect in the patient’s bronchial tree.
englishExplanation:
Tube thoracostomy is the most common procedure performed in the setting of 
thoracic trauma. It is also the primary means by which a primary or secondary spontaneous 
pneumothorax is treated (a small pneumothorax may be observed without intervention). The 
presence of a pneumothorax must have been caused by a defect in the patient’s bronchial tree 
resulting in communication between the bronchioles and the pleural space. The chest tube is 
placed within the pleural space such that when suction is applied to the chest tube the 
accumulated pleural air will be removed allowing the lung to expand. However, because the 
original lesion does not heal instantaneously, the application of suction to the pleural space may 
also remove air directly from the bronchial system through the original defect that caused the 
pneumothorax. The expectation is that the rate of air accumulation in the pleural space through 
the defect is slower than the rate of air removal, thereby allowing the lung to expand. The 
vacuum is maintained until there is no longer any evidence of a leak (therefore signifying that 
the defect has healed). The easiest way to test for the presence of a leak is to ask the patient to 
cough and then examine the water seal chamber for air bubbling up through the column of 
water. Coughing increases intrathoracic pressure which forces air through the defect, if one is 
still present. In the case of a very small defect, there may not be a detectable leak after correct 
tube placement. Leaks can also be due to inadequate insertion of the chest tube such that some 
of the suction holes lie outside the pleural cavity. Alternatively, there may simply be a leak in the 
vacuum tubing or connectors. In these cases, however, the lungs will frequently fail to expand as 
the suction capacity is “wasted” by continuously removing air from the limitless ambient 
environment instead of the pleural space. This will be evident by virtue of a constant bubbling in 
the water seal chamber. The amount of water in the water seal chamber has no effect on the 
amount of air escaping from the system.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ pneumothorax لازم يكون صار بسبب خلل بسيط بشجرة القصبات، يعني في تواصل بين القصيبات والتجويف الجنبي. الأنبوبة انحطت داخل التجويف الجنبي لتشيل الهواء المتجمّع، بس المشكلة الأصلية ما بتلتأم لحظياً، فالشفط بيسحب هواء كمان من الجهاز القصبي عبر الخلل القديم. العلاج بيكمل لحد ما يختفي أي تسريب، وأسهل طريقة نكشف فيها هي إن نطلب من المريض يسعل ونشوف الفقاعات بخزان الماء.
الفخ: الطلبة بيظنوا إن التسريب بيعني إن الأنبوبة انحطت غلط أو إن خزان الماء ناقص، بس هدول مشاكل تقنية سريعة، بينما التسريب المستمر مع توسع الرئة معناه إنه في خلل لسه ما التأم بشجرة القصبات.

question:
Which of the following are common findings in patients diagnosed with Pneumocystis carinii 
pneumonia (PCP)?

options.text: Respiratory acidosis due to CO2 retention

englishExplanation:
Because PCP cannot be cultured, and the gold standard in making the diagnosis 
remains invasive (bronchoscopy and subsequent staining), there has been much interest in 
trying to find surrogate serum markers to indicate the presence of P. jirovecii. Most of this 
interest has focused on LDH. Unfortunately, although it is true that LDH levels are elevated in 
the setting of PCP, this finding is not specific for PCP. However, the level of LDH appears to 
correlate with the degree of radiographic severity. This supports the idea that elevated LDH 
levels are more a reflection of generalized lung inflammation than a marker of any particular 
organism. Lactate levels and liver transaminases have no role in the diagnosis of PCP. Most 
patients with PCP and hypoxia have a respiratory alkalosis, as their respiratory rate (and depth) 
increases with the severity of their hypoxia. Finally, patients with CD4 counts <200 are most 
susceptible to PCP, and it is this population who should be on chemical prophylaxis. Pleural 
effusions are not common in PCP.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: التشخيص الذهبي لـ PCP بيبقى تشخيص جراحي، عشان هيك بنتفتّق بحث على مؤشرات دم تدل على المرض، وأكثرها اهتمام كان مع LDH. مستويات LDH بترتفع فعلاً مع PCP وبتتناسب مع شدة الظاهرة على الأشعة، يعني بتعكس التهاب الرئة العام. عدد خلايا CD4 أقل من 200 هم الأكتر عرضة للإصابة ولازم ياخذوا الوقاية الدوائية، ومستويات اللاكتات والكبد ما عندها دور بالتشخيص.
الفخ: الطلبة بيفكروا إن ارتفاع اللاكتات أو تسرّع التنفس الحمضي هو الجواب، بس اللاكتات ما عندها دور بتشخيص PCP، والتسرّع التنفسي مع نقص الأكسجين بيسبب قلّة قاعدة مش احتباس ثاني أكسجين الكربون.

question:
A 26-year-old previously healthy man is brought to the ED after being found unconscious 
outside a bar after having vomited on himself. He is drunk and afebrile, and his pulse oximetry 
reveals a saturation of 96%. His chest x-ray reveals a minimal right-sided streaky infiltrate (Fig. 
below). Which of the following is true?

options.text: The patient likely has a developing bacterial pneumonia and requires broad-spectrum
The patient likely has a chemical pneumonitis caused by the aspiration of acidic gastric
Antibiotics should be started early in chemical pneumonitis to prevent the subsequent
Corticosteroids have been proven to be beneficial in patients such as these.
This patient is probably suffering from a combination of chemical pneumonitis and bacterial

correctAnswer: The patient likely has a chemical pneumonitis caused by the aspiration of acidic gastric
englishExplanation:
This patient has aspiration pneumonitis, which is a chemical pneumonitis caused by 
the aspiration of acidic gastric contents. The severity of lung injury increases as the pH drops, 
and most studies agree that the pH must be <2.5 to cause significant injury. Chemical aspiration 
most commonly occurs in patients who have depressed levels of consciousness, as in this 
patient, and in young persons. Aspiration is otherwise a common problem among elderly 
persons in nursing homes after strokes. Though they are widely used, antibiotics and 
corticosteroids are not routinely recommended in patients with aspiration pneumonitis. Gastric 
acid inhibits bacterial growth, so gastric contents are sterile under normal conditions. Unless the 
patient has a coexisting condition promoting gastric bacterial growth, antibiotics should not be 
used. Such conditions include patients on antacid therapy, patients receiving enteral feeding, 
and patients with known gastroparesis or small bowel obstruction. Corticosteroids are also 
widely used in patients with chemical aspiration, although they have not been proven to be 
beneficial.

![subjects1200-695c3bc2950e79d1 source page 89](images/subjects1200-695c3bc2950e79d1-p0089.jpg)
