ment. She is somnolent but able to answer simple questions, and she awakens to
voice. She has some transmitted upper airway sounds but no wheezing, rales, or
increased work of breathing. Her vital signs are BP 130/70, P 90, R 20, and T
37.2°C (99°F); SpO  is 84%. A chest x-ray shows no focal consolidation. Her
pulse oximetry is unresponsive to supplemental oxygen.
Which diagnostic test will help differentiate the cause of the patient's
hypoxemia?
englishExplanation: Topical anesthetics are frequently used on the posterior oropharynx prior during procedures such as esophagogastroduodenoscopy and TEE. Benzocaine is a fre- quently used agent that has been associated with the development of methemoglobinemia. An ABG would show an increased PaO  despite a low oxygen saturation, which is consistent with methemoglobinemia. Methemoglobinemia results when Fe  in a Hgb tetramer is oxidized to Fe . Oxidation results in inability of the Fe  heme to bind oxygen, which in turn leads to increased oxygen affinity of the remaining normal heme moieties and decreased oxygen delivery to tissues. The PaO  reflects oxygen dissolved in blood, not oxygen bound to hemoglobin. Thus, it will not reflect iron oxidation. Methemoglobin ab- sorbs the light wavelengths emitted by pulse oximeters, which leads to an error in estimation of the oxygen saturation of Hgb molecules.

question: A 25-year-old woman with pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, clear lungs, tachycardia. A D-dimer test is ordered. What further piece of history would raise suspicion for a falsely elevated D-dimer level?
englishExplanation: D-dimer is one of the protein fragments created when blood clots break down. In liver disease, there is decreased clearance of these protein fragments, leading to elevated D-dimer levels. D-dimer levels can also be elevated in the following circumstances: pregnancy, kidney disease, malignancy, trauma, surgical procedure in the previous week, rheumatoid arthritis, infection, and age older than 70 years. Warfarin can actually cause D-dimer levels to be falsely lowered.

الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار Current warfarin treatment، بس Warfarin بيعمل العكس تماماً، يعني بيخلي الـ D-dimer falsely low مو high. وHistory of hypertension وsymptoms lasting 7 days ما بيعدّوا من أسباب ارتفاعه.

question: A 60-year-old man with NSTEMI is to receive clopidogrel. What information must be obtained from the cardiologist before giving clopidogrel?

options.text: Possibility of coronary artery bypass graft

correctAnswer: Possibility of coronary artery bypass graft
englishExplanation: It is important to know if this patient may require a coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) prior to giving clopidogrel. Clopidogrel has been proven to improve mortality in acute myocardial ischemia. However, clopidogrel increases bleeding risk and should not be given if there is a possibility of the patient undergoing a CABG. The loading dose of clopidogrel is 300 mg.

الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار Anticoagulation recommendations أو Preferred dosing of clopidogrel، لأنهم أسئلة مهمة بس مش هي. والـ Suspected timeline for cardiac catheterization برضو مش السبب اللي بيمنع الـ clopidogrel، فاللي بيمنعه هو احتمال CABG لأن الـ bleeding risk عندها أعلى.

question: A 60-year-old man with NSTEMI on aspirin, clopidogrel, heparin drip develops BP 80/40, P 180, wide-complex regular tachycardia. What is the best next step?
englishExplanation: This patient is in unstable ventricular tachycardia. The rhythm is wide-complex, regular, and fast. Because the patient's blood pressure is 80/40, he is considered unstable. The treatment for unstable ventricular tachycardia is synchronized cardioversion at 100 J. Defibrillation should only be done in pulseless VT or VF.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده BP 80/40 وP 180 ومعاه wide-complex regular tachycardia، فهاد ventricular tachycardia مش أي rhythm تاني. ولأن الضغط واطي والـ patient غير مستقر، فـ treatment هو synchronized cardioversion عند 100 J فوراً، بدون تأخير لحد ما تجي استشارة أو الـ workup. والـ Defibrillation بتعملها بس في pulseless VT أو VF، وهون في pulse وBP.
الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار Defibrillate at 200 J لأن الـ rhythm واسع وwide-complex وبيخلّي الناس تفكر VF. بس هون في pulse وضغط واطي، فهاد VT غير مستقر وبيتعالج بـ synchronized cardioversion. وتاني trap تاخد ECG 12-lead أو تستنى cardiology consult، وأنت لازم cardiovert على طول.

question: An 8-year-old girl with viral infection, ECG diffuse PR depressions and ST elevations, CXR pulmonary fluid overload and dilated cardiac silhouette, BP 62/32. What is the best combination of medications?
englishExplanation: This patient is suffering from cardiogenic shock in the setting of viral myocarditis. Vasopressor support will need to address two issues: inotropic support for cardiac output (CO) and systemic vascular resistance (SVR). Dobutamine has strong beta-1 receptor activity, which increases CO. Norepinephrine's strong alpha activity will increase the SVR.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: البنت عندها viral infection، ومعها diffuse PR depressions وST elevations وهاد myocarditis. والـ CXR بتبيّن pulmonary fluid overload وdilated cardiac silhouette، والـ BP 62/32، فهاد cardiogenic shock. والـ vasopressor support لازم يعالج مشكلتين مع بعض: inotropic support للـ cardiac output، وsystemic vascular resistance. وDobutamine عندها نشاط قوي على beta-1 receptors وبيرفع الـ CO، وNorepinephrine بنشاط alpha قوي وبيرفع الـ SVR.
الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار أي تركيبة تانية لأن الـ drugs بتبدوا قوية. بس أنت محتاج beat أقوى يرفع الـ CO مع vasoconstriction يرفع الـ SVR بنفس الوقت، وهاد بالظبط شغل Dobutamine مع Norepinephrine.

question: A 34-year-old man with chest pressure, syncope, HR 32 with no P-QRS association, BP 85/42, recent camping in New England, annular rash. What is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation: This patient is showing signs of acute cardiogenic shock from myocarditis with an associated third-degree heart block. The most likely diagnosis is Lyme disease, caused by Borrelia burgdorferi, transmitted via Ixodes ticks. Cardiac complications occur in 10% of patients and typically occur 2-4 weeks after infection. The rash noted was most likely erythema migrans, which occurs in 90% of patients. Treatment is doxycycline.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الراجل عنده chest pressure وsyncope، وHR 32 مع انفصال بين الـ P والـ QRS يعني third-degree heart block، ومعاه BP 85/42. ومع الـ camping بـ New England والـ annular rash، فهاد Lyme disease اللي سببها Borrelia burgdorferi وتنتقل بـ Ixodes ticks. والـ cardiac complications بتحصل عند 10% من المرضى، عادةً 2 لـ 4 أسابيع بعد العدوى. والـ rash هاد هو erythema migrans اللي بتشوفه عند 90% من المرضى. والـ treatment بـ doxycycline.
الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار Rickettsia rickettsii أو Yersinia pestis أو Franciscella tularensis لأنهم كلهم tick-borne وبيبدوا أعراض جلدية. بس الـ third-degree heart block مع annular rash بعد الـ camping هي Lyme بعينها، والـ carditis بياخد من Lyme.

question: A 72-year-old woman with coxsackievirus infection in cardiogenic shock despite excellent critical care. Which intervention would be potentially the most beneficial?
englishExplanation: Venoarterial ECMO (VA-ECMO) has shown promise in studies for patients with cardiogenic shock. It effectively replaces the functions of the failing heart and lungs. The intra-aortic balloon pump has shown some success but randomized controlled trials have repeatedly failed to show improvement in patient-centered outcomes, including 30-day mortality.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الست عندها coxsackievirus infection وهلأ في cardiogenic shock رغم إن كل الـ critical care اللي بتاخده ممتاز. والـ Venoarterial ECMO أثبتت promising results في دراسات الـ cardiogenic shock، لأنها بفعّل بشكل مؤقت وظيفة القلب والرئة اللي فشلت. وفالـ virus-related myocarditis هاد ممكن يكون أكثر تدخل فايدة من أي جهاز تاني لأن الـ support بياخد مكان القلب والرئة مع بعض.
الفخ: الخطر إنك تختار Intra-aortic balloon pump لأنه known intervention في cardiogenic shock. بس عنده بعض النجاح، إلا إن عدة RCTs متكررة فشلت تبّن تحسّن في الـ patient-centered outcomes ومن ضمنها 30-day mortality. أما ICD وpacemaker بيعالجوا الـ rhythm بس ما بيدعموا القلب اللي فاشل.

question: A 57-year-old man with COPD and hypertension presents with left pleuritic chest pain, no air movement on left, decreased excursion, BP 93/60. What would be a late finding of the cause?
englishExplanation: This patient has a tension pneumothorax. Although tracheal deviation is commonly taught as a finding in tension pneumothorax, it is extremely rare; when it does occur, it is a very late finding. Treatment is needle decompression followed by tube thoracostomy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده tension pneumothorax، والـ tracheal deviation بتّرا كتير معاه، بس هاي بتبقى نادرة جداً. يعني حتى لما بتظهر، بتكون late finding بعد ما الحالة تفشل وتزداد. ولأن الـ treatment هون هو needle decompression وبعدها tube thoracostomy، فلازم تتدخل بسرعة بدون تأخير. وهاد بيخليك تفهم إن هاد الـ sign بيجي متأخر، فمش لازم تستنّاه أصلاً وقت التشخيص.
الفخ: أكثر شي بيجي في بال الطلبة هو Hypoxia أو Tachycardia لأنهم متوقعين علامات عامة، بس هدول بتيجي قبل الـ tracheal deviation. افرق بينهم إن انحراف الـ trachea بيحكي عن موقع الـ trachea نفسه، وبيجي نادر جداً بعد ما الجهاز cardiovascular يبدا يتهاوى.

question: A 52-year-old man with alcohol use disorder, sudden pleuritic chest pain after forceful emesis, BP 98/62, P 133, T 38.6°C, CXR subcutaneous emphysema, mediastinal widening, bilateral pleural effusions. What is the best next step?

options.text: Consult cardiothoracic surgery for operative repair
Obtain a CT with contrast to confirm diagnosis

correctAnswer: Consult cardiothoracic surgery for operative repair
englishExplanation: This patient has mediastinitis secondary to Boerhaave syndrome. Given the patient's clinical condition, history of symptoms occurring after forceful emesis, and chest x-ray findings, it is most reasonable to consult cardiothoracic surgery for emergent operative repair. Mortality is time dependent and nearly doubles within the first 12 hours.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده mediastinitis بسبب Boerhaave syndrome، لأن الأعراض جت بعد forceful emesis وCXR بتظهر subcutaneous emphysema وmediastinal widening وbilateral pleural effusions. واللي بيخلّي استشارة cardiothoracic surgery للـ emergent operative repair هي إن الـ mortality بتكون time dependent وبتضاعف تقريباً خلال أول 12 ساعة. يعني تأخير التدخل بيخسّر فرصة النجاة، فالمشكلة مو إنك تستنى confirmation.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على CT with contrast أو water-soluble contrast esophagography لأنهم فاكرين إنهم لازم يتأكدوا من التشخيص أول شي. بس هاد الفحوصات بتأخّر، والمريض واضح عنده Boerhaave syndrome، والـ mortality بتضاعف خلال أول 12 ساعة، فالـ operative repair هو اللي بيعالج.

question: A 43-year-old man with sudden chest pain, diastolic murmur, partial Horner syndrome, CXR widened mediastinum. What intervention is the most appropriate next step?

options.text: Administer a nicardipine bolus and drip
Consult cardiothoracic surgery for surgical management

correctAnswer: Consult cardiothoracic surgery for surgical management
englishExplanation: This patient has an ascending aortic dissection. Dissections involving the ascending aorta are managed with surgical and/or endovascular therapy in addition to pharmacologic agents. Definitive treatment is surgical. Pharmacologic management includes lowering the heart rate to approximately 60 bpm and systolic BP between 100 to 120; beta-blockers should be started before vasodilators.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده ascending aortic dissection، لأن عنده chest pain فجأة مع diastolic murmur وpartial Horner syndrome وCXR بتظهر widened mediastinum. والـ dissection اللي بيشمل الـ ascending aorta بيتعامل معاه بالجراحة و/أو endovascular therapy مع أدوية، والعلاج النهائي هو surgical. يعني لازم تستدعي cardiothoracic surgery للتدبير الجراحي. وبالإضافة للأدوية، الهدف إنك تنزّل الـ heart rate حوالي 60 bpm والـ systolic BP بين 100 و120، وتبدأ بـ beta-blockers قبل الـ vasodilators.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا nicardipine bolus أو hydralazine لأنهم شايفين إن الـ BP عنده high. بس الأدوية لوحدها مو العلاج النهائي، وإنت لازم تبدأ بـ beta-blockers قبل الـ vasodilators، والقرار النهائي هو surgical management مع cardiothoracic surgery.

question: A 53-year-old man with hypertension and hyperlipidemia, 10 days of nonproductive cough. Started lisinopril 2 weeks ago. What is the appropriate next step?
englishExplanation: ACE inhibitors are a well-known cause of nonproductive cough. The cough typically begins within a week of starting the medication but may begin up to 6 months later. Treatment is discontinuation of the ACE inhibitor. The cough generally resolves within 4 days of discontinuing the ACE inhibitor but may take up to a month.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده cough بدون بلغم بسبب ACE inhibitor، لأنه بدأ lisinopril قبل أسبوعين. الـ ACE inhibitors سبب معروف للكحة الجافة، والـ cough عادةً بتبدأ خلال أسبوع من بدء الدواء، بس ممكن تبتدي حتى بعد 6 أشهر. والـ treatment هو discontinuation للـ ACE inhibitor. وبعد ما توقّف الدواء، الـ cough بتتحسن عادةً خلال 4 أيام، بس ممكن تاخد لحد شهر.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على amoxicillin أو doxycycline لأنهم فاكرين إنه عدوى تنفسية أو التهاب جيوب، والـ CXR طبيعي. افرق بينهم إن الـ ACE inhibitors بتسبب الـ cough، والعلاج مو antibiotic بل إيقاف الدواء.

question: A 53-year-old man with productive cough, body aches, chills, wheezing. CXR normal. Discharged with primary care follow-up. What is the best treatment plan?

options.text: Instruct the patient to stop taking lisinopril
Prescribe an albuterol inhaler plus 5 days of steroids

englishExplanation: This patient has acute bronchitis based on the clinical picture. Although there is no evidence to support routine use of beta-agonists for acute bronchitis, they have been shown to lower symptom scores and lead to faster cough resolution in patients with evidence of airflow obstruction on examination (wheezing). Antibiotics and steroids are not beneficial.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده acute bronchitis، لأن عنده cough مع بلغم وbody aches وchills وwheezing والـ CXR طبيعي. وبالعادة ما في دلائل على فايدة الـ beta-agonists بشكل روتيني في acute bronchitis، بس هاد أثبتوا إنه بيخففوا symptom scores وبيرجّعوا الـ cough أسرع عند المرضى اللي في عندهم دليل على airflow obstruction بالفحص، وهاد المريض عنده wheezing. يعني بتوصف albuterol inhaler، والـ antibiotics والـ steroids ما بيفيدوا.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا amoxicillin أو albuterol مع steroids لأنهم شايفين إنه cough مع حرارة. بس الـ antibiotics والـ steroids ما عندهم فايدة في acute bronchitis، والـ CXR طبيعي. افرق بينهم إن الـ wheezing هاد هو الدليل على airflow obstruction اللي بيخلّيك تستفيد من albuterol.

question: A 63-year-old woman with dry cough for 20 days, congestion, myalgias, babysitting a 3-month-old grandchild with cough. Subconjunctival hemorrhage. What other diagnostic test would be helpful?
englishExplanation: This patient's presentation is concerning for Bordetella pertussis infection. The patient has had a cough for longer than 2 weeks and has had contact with someone who is not fully vaccinated. The subconjunctival hemorrhage serves as evidence of a vigorous cough. Nasopharyngeal PCR remains useful for up to 4 weeks.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها Bordetella pertussis infection، لأن الـ cough عندهاcontinued أكتر من أسبوعين، وكانت بت babysit حفيد عمره 3 شهور عنده cough ولسه مو مكتمل التطعيم. والـ subconjunctival hemorrhage بتدل على إن الـ cough كان قوي. والـ nasopharyngeal PCR بيضل مفيد لحد 4 أسابيع من بداية الـ symptoms، فهاد هو الفحص اللي بيساعد في تأكيد التشخيص.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا coagulation studies أو metabolic panel أو ما بيعملوا أي فحص لأنهم شايفين إنه عادية. بس الـ cough أكتر من أسبوعين والـ subconjunctival hemorrhage بتدل على سعال قوي، والـ nasopharyngeal PCR بيضل مفيد لأربع أسابيع، فبدون فحص بتضيع.

question: A 63-year-old woman with pertussis (PCR positive), QTc 500 ms. What is the best next step in management?

options.text: Provide supportive care with intravenous fluids

englishExplanation: This patient should be prescribed trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX), dosed at one double-strength tablet twice a day for 14 days. Although azithromycin is the recommended antibiotic regimen for pertussis infection, it is contraindicated in patients with QTc prolongation. In patients unable to take macrolides, TMP-SMX can be used.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها pertussis والـ PCR عندها positive. وazithromycin هو الـ antibiotic regimen الموصى به عادةً للـ pertussis، بس هاد المريض عندها QTc 500 ms، والـ macrolides بتكون contraindicated عند مرضى QTc prolongation. وبالنسبة للـ patients اللي ما بيقدروا ياخدوا macrolides، بنقدر نستخدم trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. وهاد بجرعة one double-strength tablet مرتين باليوم لمدة 14 يوم.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا azithromycin لأنهم شايفين إنه الـ antibiotic الموصى به للـ pertussis. بس مع QTc 500 ms الـ macrolides contraindicated، والبديل هو TMP-SMX بجرعة double-strength مرتين باليوم لـ 14 يوم، والـ IV fluids لوحدها ما بتكفي.

question: A 47-year-old man with BMI 40, persistent cough 2 months, substernal chest pain, epigastric burning worse at night with bad taste. Symptoms improve with antacid. What should be included as part of discharge instructions?

options.text: Discontinue diclofenac; diagnosis of pill-induced esophagitis
No change to medications; diagnosis of peptic ulcer disease
Prescribe a daily proton pump inhibitor; diagnosis of GERD and elevate head of bed
Prescribe triple therapy; diagnosis of Helicobacter pylori

correctAnswer: Prescribe a daily proton pump inhibitor; diagnosis of GERD and elevate head of bed
englishExplanation: The patient has GERD, which is most commonly caused by lower esophageal sphincter dysfunction. Treatment includes lifestyle modifications, including weight loss and elevating the head of the bed while sleeping. Treatment includes an 8-week course of a daily proton pump inhibitor (PPI) as initial therapy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده GERD، لأن الـ burning epigastric بيتحسن مع antacid وبيزيد بالليل، وعنده BMI 40 وكحة دائمة مع chest pain تحت الـ sternum. والـ GERD الأكثر شيوعاً سببه dysfunction بالـ lower esophageal sphincter. والـ treatment بيبدأ بتعديلات نمط الحياة، منها نزول الوزن ورفع رأس السرير أثناء النوم. وبالإضافة لذلك، الـ treatment الأوّلي هو PPI يومي لمدة 8 أسابيع.
الفخ: الطلبة بيوقفوا diclofenac أو بيكتبوا peptic ulcer disease أو triple therapy للـ H. pylori. بس الـ burning اللي بيخف بـ antacid والـ symptoms اللي بتزيد بالليل مع BMI 40 بتوجّهك على GERD، والـ PPI مع رفع رأس السرير هو اللي بيعالج.

question: A 47-year-old man with GERD, persistent cough despite PPI. Aside from continuing PPI, what other medication can improve symptoms?
englishExplanation: Gabapentin has been shown to improve symptoms of chronic cough related to GERD. Although the first-line treatment remains a proton pump inhibitor, gabapentin, used in doses of 100 mg to 300 mg each night, has been shown to be effective. Typically, chronic cough related to GERD takes about 3 months to improve.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده GERD وكحة مزمنة despite PPI، واللي بيعطي نتيجة هنا هو gabapentin، لأنه أثبت إنه بيحسن أعراض الـ chronic cough المرتبط بالـ GERD. وalthough الـ first-line treatment بضل الـ proton pump inhibitor، بس gabapentin بجرعة 100 mg لـ 300 mg كل ليلة أثبت فعاليته. وكمان لازم تعرف إن الـ chronic cough المرتبط بالـ GERD بياخد حوالي 3 أشهر حتى يتحسن، فبدون صبر ممكن تنسى الموضوع.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا albuterol أو benzonatate لأنهم فاكرين إنه cough عادي يبي دوا للسعال. بس الـ first-line بضل الـ PPI، والـ gabapentin هو اللي إله دور مثبت في الـ chronic cough المرتبط بالـ GERD، والـ loratadine أصلاً ما إله دور بهالـ case.

question: A 47-year-old man with chronic cough, nasal congestion, facial pressure, CT confirms chronic sinusitis. What is the next step?

options.text: Prescribe daily intranasal steroids and nasal saline irrigation

correctAnswer: Prescribe daily intranasal steroids and nasal saline irrigation
englishExplanation: The first-line treatment for chronic sinusitis (or rhinosinusitis) is nasal saline irrigation and intranasal steroids. Daily, low-pressure, high-volume nasal saline irrigation improves mucociliary clearance. Intranasal corticosteroids have anti-inflammatory effects and work in conjunction with irrigation to provide symptom improvement.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده chronic sinusitis والـ CT أكدها، ومعه cough مزمن وnasal congestion وfacial pressure. والـ first-line treatment للـ chronic sinusitis أو rhinosinusitis هي nasal saline irrigation مع intranasal steroids. الـ irrigation اليومي، يعني low-pressure وhigh-volume، بيحسّن الـ mucociliary clearance، والـ intranasal corticosteroids إلها تأثير anti-inflammatory وبتعمل مع الـ irrigation عشان تحسّن الأعراض. وهاد الخيار هو step التاني بعد الـ CT، والـ endoscopy مش مطلوبة كأول خطوة بهيك حالة.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على 21 يوم amoxicillin-clavulanate أو 30 يوم oral steroid taper أو endoscopy عاجلة، لأنهم شايفين إنه inflammation. بس الـ first-line للـ chronic rhinosinusitis هي الـ nasal saline irrigation مع الـ intranasal steroids يومياً، والـ antibiotics والـ steroids الفموية مو الترتيب الصح.

question: A 57-year-old woman with pulmonary hypertension travels to Colorado mountains, develops weakness, dyspnea, dry cough with pink frothy sputum. What intervention is most likely to improve her condition?

options.text: Taking an extra dose of furosemide

englishExplanation: The patient likely has high-altitude pulmonary edema (HAPE), exacerbated by her underlying pulmonary hypertension. It occurs when people ascend above 2,500 m. The initial intervention is to descend from altitude. Providing supplemental oxygen is also first-line. BiPAP should be avoided in pulmonary hypertension.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها high-altitude pulmonary edema أو HAPE، واللي زاد الخطورة هو pulmonary hypertension اللي عندها من زمان. والـ HAPE بيصير لما الناس يصعدوا فوق 2500 m. وأول intervention لازم تعملي هو إنك تنزل من الـ altitude. وكمان إعطاء supplemental oxygen بيعتبر من الـ first-line. والـ BiPAP لازم تتجنّبه في pulmonary hypertension.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا cooling blankets أو furosemide أو BiPAP لأنهم فاكرين إنه مشكلة سيولة أو ضربة شمس. بس أول intervention هي النزول من الـ altitude مع supplemental oxygen، والـ BiPAP يتجنّب في pulmonary hypertension، والـ cooling blankets ما بتعمل شي.

question: A 13-year-old boy with peritonsillar abscess, after benzocaine spray becomes hypoxic and cyanotic, ABG chocolate-brown. What ABG analysis results are expected?
englishExplanation: This clinical scenario is consistent with methemoglobinemia, likely secondary to overuse of the topical anesthetic agent (benzocaine spray). PaO2 levels on ABG in these patients will be normal or very high in the setting of cyanosis. The problem is not a lack of oxygen; rather, the oxidation of iron causes an increased binding affinity and decreased delivery of oxygen to the tissues. Treatment is with methylene blue.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده methemoglobinemia بعد ما استعمل benzocaine spray زيادة. ولما يصير كذا، الـ PaO2 بالـ ABG بتبقى normal أو high جداً حتى مع وجود cyanosis. والمشكلة مو إن فيه نقص بالأكسجين، المشكلة إن أكسدة الحديد بتزود الـ binding affinity وبتنقص توصيل الأكسجين للأنسجة. والـ treatment هون هو methylene blue.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا Low PaO2 أو High PaCO2 لأنهم شايفين cyanosis ويفكروا إنه نقص أكسجين. بس الـ ABG هنا بتظهر PaO2 طبيعية أو عالية، والدم chocolate-brown مع cyanosis بعد benzocaine هو اللي بيوجّهك على methemoglobinemia.

question: A 10-day-old infant with cyanosis and increased respiratory rate, no improvement with oxygen. What is the best initial medication choice?
englishExplanation: This baby presents within the first month of life with poor circulation and oxygenation. The most likely cause is closure of the ductus arteriosus in the setting of a ductal-dependent congenital heart lesion. Prostaglandin E1 will help keep the ductus arteriosus patent and allow oxygenated blood to circulate to the peripheral circulation.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الطفل عمره 10 أيام وعنده cyanosis مع increased respiratory rate، والأكسجين ما حسّن حالته. وهاد بيوحي على poor circulation وoxygenation عند baby عمره أقل من شهر. والسبب المرجّح هو closure للـ ductus arteriosus في حالة congenital heart lesion معتمدة على الـ duct. وهون Prostaglandin E1 بيساعد على إبقاء الـ ductus arteriosus patent وبيخلّي الدم المُؤكسج يوصل للـ peripheral circulation.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا albuterol أو epinephrine أو furosemide لأنهم شايفين إنه ضيق نفس أو وذمة. بس المشكلة مو بالرئين، المشكلة إن الـ ductus arteriosus انسدّ، وPGE1 هو اللي بيفتح الطريق للدم. افرق بينهم إن الـ cyanosis اللي ما بيستجيب للأكسجين بهالعمر يعني ductal-dependent lesion.

question: A 33-year-old woman with dysphagia, fatigue, blurred vision, dysarthria, worse at end of day, ptosis. What would help confirm a diagnosis?

options.text: Applying an ice bag to the eyelid for 2 minutes
Obtaining an MRI scan of the brain with contrast

correctAnswer: Applying an ice bag to the eyelid for 2 minutes
englishExplanation: This patient presents with myasthenia gravis, an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder that results from antibodies against nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. Neuromuscular transmission is improved at lower temperatures. Thus, applying ice to the eyelid can improve ptosis. If there is at least 2 mm of improvement in ptosis, the test is positive.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها myasthenia gravis، لأن عندها dysphagia وfatigue وblurred vision وdysarthria وptosis وكلها بتزيد آخر اليوم. وmyasthenia gravis مرض autoimmune neuromuscular بيصير بسبب antibodies ضد nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. والـ neuromuscular transmission بيتحسن عند temperatures أقل. يعني لو حطيت ice على الـ eyelid ممكن الـ ptosis يتحسن، وإذا تحسن 2 mm أو أكثر فالـ test positive.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على edrophonium أو MRI مع contrast أو thyroid function tests لأنهم فاكرين إنهم لازم ascertain الـ diagnosis. بس أسهل فحص بيأكد هو وضع ice على الـ eyelid لمدة دقيقتين، وإذا تحسن الـ ptosis 2 mm أو أكثر فالـ test positive، ومفيش داعي تستنى تحاليل.

question: A 33-year-old woman with dysphagia after eating steak, chest pain for 2 hours, unable to tolerate oral secretions, spitting into a cup. What is the best next step in management?

options.text: Observe briefly to allow for spontaneous resolution
Obtain a CT scan of the chest with contrast

englishExplanation: This patient has a food impaction (food bolus). In a patient with a suspected esophageal food bolus, it is reasonable to proceed directly to endoscopy for definitive diagnosis and management. Patients with complete obstructions (inability to handle oral secretions, drooling) require emergent endoscopy (within 2 to 6 hours).
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها food impaction يعني food bolus في الـ esophagus، لأن الـ dysphagia جت بعد ما أكلت steak وهي unable تتعامل مع الـ oral secretions وبتطلع لعابها بال cup. ومع suspected esophageal food bolus، منطقي تروح مباشرة على endoscopy عشان تشخّص وتعالج. والمرضى عنده complete obstruction، يعني مش قادر يتعامل مع الـ oral secretions وبيسيل لعابه، وهاد بيستدعي emergent endoscopy خلال 2 لـ 6 ساعات.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا observe briefly أو barium study أو CT مع contrast لأنهم فاكرين إنه ممكن يطلع لوحده. بس هاد complete obstruction لأن المريض ما بيقدر يتعامل مع الـ oral secretions، والـ emergent endoscopy لازم تكون خلال 2 لـ 6 ساعات، والـ observation هون خطر.

question: A 3-year-old child with poor feeding, fever, neck pain, drooling. Neck x-ray shows prevertebral soft-tissue swelling. What is the number-one cause of death in children with this presentation?
englishExplanation: This patient's presentation is consistent with retropharyngeal abscess. A systematic review found that upper airway obstruction caused by the edema and inflammation of a retropharyngeal abscess poses the greatest risk to pediatric patients. Treatment includes IV antibiotics plus incision and drainage.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الطفل عنده retropharyngeal abscess، لأن عنده poor feeding وحرارة وألم بالعنق وسيلان لعاب، والـ neck x-ray بتظهر prevertebral soft-tissue swelling. وreview منهجي لقى إن upper airway obstruction اللي بيصير من الـ edema والـ inflammation للـ retropharyngeal abscess هو أكبر خطر عند الأطفال. والـ treatment بيجمع IV antibiotics مع incision and drainage.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا bacterial meningitis أو central venous thrombosis أو fulminant sepsis لأنهم شايفين إن فيه حرارة وألم. بس الـ prevertebral swelling مع سيلان اللعاب عند طفل بيفكّر بـ retropharyngeal abscess، واللي بيقتله هون هو انسداد المجرى الهواي.

question: A 3-year-old child with retropharyngeal abscess. What treatment should be started immediately in the ED?
englishExplanation: Retropharyngeal abscess is considered a polymicrobial infection, with Streptococcus pyogenes, Staphylococcus aureus, and respiratory anaerobes. Initial antibiotic therapy should include either ampicillin-sulbactam (50 mg/kg every 6 hours) or clindamycin (15 mg/kg every 8 hours). If septic, add vancomycin or linezolid.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الطفل عنده retropharyngeal abscess، وهاد الـ infection بعتبر polymicrobial، وفيه Streptococcus pyogenes وStaphylococcus aureus والـ respiratory anaerobes. والـ initial antibiotic therapy لازم تكون ampicillin-sulbactam بجرعة 50 mg/kg كل 6 ساعات أو clindamycin 15 mg/kg كل 8 ساعات. وإذا الطفل عنده septic، بنضيف vancomycin أو linezolid.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا Azithromycin أو Decadron أو immediate incision and drainage لحالها. بس الـ abscess هاد polymicrobial، فأول خطوة antibiotics تغطي الـ anaerobes مع streptococcus وstaphylococcus، والـ drainage بييجي معاها مش بدالها.

question: A 33-year-old man with tobacco use presents with odynophagia and retrosternal chest discomfort. Oral lesions can be scraped off with a tongue blade, revealing underlying mucosal bleeding. What is the best treatment regimen?
englishExplanation: This patient has esophageal candidiasis, as evidenced by intraoral lesions consistent with candidiasis in addition to odynophagia and retrosternal chest pain. Oral candidiasis consists of pseudomembranous plaques that can be scraped off. The treatment of choice for esophageal candidiasis is systemic treatment with oral fluconazole 200 to 400 mg per day for 14 to 21 days.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده esophageal candidiasis، لأن عنده odynophagia وretrosternal chest discomfort ومعه lesions بالفم ممكن تنشال بتongue blade وتكشف تحتها mucosal bleeding. والـ oral candidiasis عبارة عن pseudomembranous plaques ممكن تنشال. والـ treatment of choice للـ esophageal candidiasis هو systemic treatment بـ oral fluconazole بجرعة 200 لـ 400 mg باليوم لمدة 14 لـ 21 يوم.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا oral valacyclovir أو reassurance أو topical nystatin. بس الـ lesions هاد pseudomembranous plaques بتنشال، وهذا شكل candidiasis، والـ esophageal candidiasis بتحتاج systemic therapy مش topical، والـ topical nystatin مش بيعالج الـ esophagus.

question: A 5-year-old boy with croup, after racemic epinephrine and dexamethasone, develops biphasic stridor at rest, paradoxical abdominal breathing, SpO2 91%. What is the best next step in management?

options.text: Give intramuscular epinephrine (1:1,000) and continuous albuterol nebulization and admit to the pediatric ICU
Give racemic epinephrine q15 mins, antibiotics, and HFNC; admit to the pediatric ICU
Give racemic epinephrine q15 mins, HFNC, and heliox; admit to the pediatric ICU
Intubate immediately in the operating room, avoid placing an IV in the emergency department, and admit to the pediatric ICU

correctAnswer: Give racemic epinephrine q15 mins, HFNC, and heliox; admit to the pediatric ICU
englishExplanation: The patient has severe croup not improved after initial treatment. Another dose of racemic epinephrine should be administered, and the patient should be admitted to the pediatric ICU. Given SpO2 <92%, humidified oxygen and heliox should be considered.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الطفل عنده severe croup ما تحسّن بعد racemic epinephrine وdexamethasone، لأن عنده biphasic stridor حتى وهو ساكن، وparadoxical abdominal breathing وSpO2 91%. فأول شي بتعمله هو جرعة تانية من racemic epinephrine كل 15 دقيقة، وبتـوكله إلى pediatric ICU. ولأن الـ SpO2 أقل من 92%، بنـconsider humidified oxygen مع heliox.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على intubation فوري بالـ operating room أو IM epinephrine مع continuous albuterol nebulization. بس هاد child عنده severe croup محتاج جرعة تانية من racemic epinephrine كل 15 دقيقة مع HFNC وheliox، وبعدها admission للـ pediatric ICU، والـ intubation مش أول خطوة.

question: A 57-year-old woman with metastatic breast cancer presents with shortness of breath and chest pain. BP 78/42, P 135, R 33, muffled heart sounds, JVD. Which imaging modality is preferred to make the diagnosis?
englishExplanation: The triad of hypotension, jugular venous distention, and muffled heart sounds is Beck triad, concerning for pericardial effusion complicated by tamponade. This is a medical emergency and should be evaluated with a bedside ultrasound.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها hypotension مع jugular venous distention ومع muffled heart sounds، وهاد triad اسمه Beck triad وبيشير على pericardial effusion معقدة بـ tamponade. وهاي حالة medical emergency، فالطريقة المفضلة للتشخيص هي bedside ultrasound عند السرير لأنه سريع وبيأكد التشخيص من غير ما تستنى. لازم تعمله فوراً بدون تأخير.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على chest CT أو chest x-ray أو nuclear stress لأنهم فاكرين إنه لازم أشعة مفصّلة. بس المريضة غير مستقرة والوقت ضيق، والـ bedside ultrasound بيعمل التشخيص عند السرير بدون تأخير، وCT أو nuclear stress ما إلها داعي لهالحالة.

question: A 57-year-old man with LVAD presents with nausea, vomiting, diffuse abdominal pain. BP unattainable by EMS. How should the blood pressure be obtained?

options.text: Insert an arterial line in the right radial artery
Obtain an Ankle-Brachial Index (ABI) in each extremity
Use a manual sphygmomanometer with doppler
Use an automatic sphygmomanometer with doppler

correctAnswer: Use a manual sphygmomanometer with doppler
englishExplanation: An LVAD produces continuous flow, eliminating the pulse pressure differential needed for automatic BP. Use a manual sphygmomanometer with doppler over the brachial or radial artery; the MAP is identified when a constant doppler sound is heard.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده LVAD، والـ LVAD بيعمل continuous flow، وهاد بيلغي الـ pulse pressure differential اللي بيعتمد عليه الـ automatic BP cuff. يعني ما في داعي تستنى automatic device أبداً. لازم تستخدم manual sphygmomanometer مع doppler فوق الـ brachial أو الـ radial artery. والـ MAP بتعرفه لمّا تسمع صوت doppler constant.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا arterial line أو automatic cuff أو ABI. بس الـ automatic cuff ما إله أساس مع continuous flow، والـ ABI ما بتدّيك الـ MAP، والـ arterial line مش لازمة لهالموقف. افرق بينهم إن الـ manual cuff مع doppler هو اللي بيطلعلك الـ MAP.

question: A 57-year-old man with LVAD decompensates to PEA arrest. What is the best next step in management?

options.text: Call coordinator to evaluate the LVAD
Remove the driveline and give antibiotics

englishExplanation: This patient has decompensated to PEA arrest. ACLS protocol should be followed with chest compressions, defibrillation when appropriate, and intubation. Patients with an LVAD often do not have a palpable pulse; pulse checks should be done with a doppler.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده LVAD وdecompensate لـ PEA arrest، فأول شي لازم تعمله هو ACLS protocol يعني chest compressions مع defibrillation لمّا يكون مناسب ومع intubation. وكمان لازم تعرف إن مرضى الـ LVAD غالباً ما عندهم pulse palpable، ففحص الـ pulse لازم يكون بالـ doppler. يعني ما تستنّى pulse عشان تقرر تبدأ أو لا.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا tPA أو ينادوا coordinator يفحص الـ LVAD أو يشيلوا الـ driveline ويعطوا antibiotics. بس هالمريض واقف، والـ ACLS protocol لازم يبدأ فوراً، والـ coordinator بياخد وقت، والبحث عن pulse بالـ listener العادي بيزود التأخير.

question: A 51-year-old woman with HIV and iron-deficiency anemia presents with fevers, night sweats, weight loss. CXR shows unilateral hilar lymphadenopathy. Which type of isolation is needed?
englishExplanation: This patient's presentation is consistent with tuberculosis (TB). Pulmonary tuberculosis is highly contagious and requires airborne precautions. The droplets of Mycobacterium tuberculosis can remain suspended in the air for hours.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها tuberculosis أو TB، لأن عندها fever وnight sweats وweight loss مع HIV وiron-deficiency anemia، والـ CXR بتظهر unilateral hilar lymphadenopathy. والـ pulmonary tuberculosis معروف إنه شديد العدوى، فبيحتاج airborne precautions. والسبب إن قطيرات Mycobacterium tuberculosis ممكن تفضل معلّقة بالهوا لساعات.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا droplet أو contact أو standard precautions لأنهم شايفين إنه أي عدوى تنفسية. بس قطيرات Mycobacterium tuberculosis بتبقى معلّقة بالهوا لساعات، وهاد بالضبط اللي بيخلّي airborne هي الإجراء الصح.

question: A 51-year-old woman with HIV and active TB on RIPE regimen for 3 weeks presents with nausea, vomiting, jaundice, transaminitis, and coagulopathy. What is most likely the cause of her new-onset liver disease?
englishExplanation: Treatment of active TB is a combination of rifampin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol (RIPE). Commonly known side effects are hepatitis, peripheral neuropathy, thrombocytopenia, and GI symptoms.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها active TB وعمّلت RIPE regimen من 3 أسابيع، واللي صار إنه ظهر عندها nausea وvomiting وjaundice وtransaminitis وcoagulopathy. والـ treatment للـ TB النشط هو rifampin مع isoniazid مع pyrazinamide ومع ethambutol. والـ side effects المعروفة هي hepatitis وperipheral neuropathy وthrombocytopenia وأعراض GI. يعني الـ liver disease الجديدة هاي side effect من العلاج، مو من المرض نفسه.
الفخ: الطلبة بيختاروا disease progression إلى miliary tuberculosis أو multidrug resistant tuberculosis أو إنه expected disease course. بس هالأعراض نزلت بعد 3 أسابيع من بدء الـ RIPE، والـ transaminitis مع jaundice وcoagulopathy بتدل على hepatitis من الدواء، مو على مقاومة أو انتشار.

question: A 43-year-old woman with no medical history presents with fatigue, arthralgias, and facial rash (lupus pernio). What further workup is required to confirm the most likely diagnosis?
englishExplanation: Sarcoidosis is a noncaseating granulomatous disorder. Lupus pernio (violaceous, indurated plaques/nodules on face and ears) is highly specific for sarcoidosis, and a presumptive diagnosis can be made based on its presence.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عندها sarcoidosis، لأن عندها fatigue وarthralgias وlupus pernio، وهي plaques وnodules لونها بنفسجي ومتيبّسة على الوجه والأذنين. والـ sarcoidosis مرض granulomatous من نوع noncaseating. والـ lupus pernio معروف إنه highly specific للـ sarcoidosis، وبإمكانية نعمل presumptive diagnosis بس وجوده. يعني ما في داعي نعمل فحوصات إضافية لهيك حالة.
الفخ: الطلبة بيروحوا على CT scan of the chest أو Quantiferon gold assay أو serum angiotensin enzyme level لأنهم فاكرين إنه لازم تأكيد. بس الـ lupus pernio لحالو بيعطي presumptive diagnosis، والـ CT والـ Quantiferon مش لازم يزنوه تأخير.

question: A 43-year-old woman with sarcoidosis presents 1 month later with declining mental status. CT head normal. What is the next best intervention?
englishExplanation: This patient has symptoms concerning for neurosarcoidosis. Severe presentations (encephalitis, aseptic meningitis) should be treated with intravenous steroids. Steroids are the mainstay in addition to supportive care.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها sarcoidosis، وتراجع حالتها العقلية بعد شهر بيرجّعها على تشخيص neurosarcoidosis، وهاد من أخطر أشكال هاد المرض. الحالات الشديدة مثل encephalitis و aseptic meningitis لازم تنعالج بـ intravenous steroids، والستيرويدات هاد حجر الأساس في العلاج مع supportive care. يعني أول خطوة لازم تعملها هي steroids مش antibiotics، والـ IVIG مع plasma exchange مش هما الإجابة.
الفخ: أشهر غلطة بيعملوها الطلاب هو يختاروا broad-spectrum antibiotics لأنهم شافوا حمى وتعب، بس هاد ما بيعالج neurosarcoidosis. افرّق بينهم وبين الـ steroids إن المرض نفسه inflammatory بالمخ، والجرعة بتكون steroids مع supportive care.

question: A 3-month-old infant presents after a period of reduced responsiveness lasting 30-45 seconds. What would place the patient at higher risk for adverse health events?
englishExplanation: A brief resolved unexplained event (BRUE). A similar episode >30 days ago is a high-risk feature. Any recurrence, no matter when it occurs, places the patient in a higher risk category. Duration <1 minute, age >60 days, and CPR by parent are low-risk features.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الرضيع عمل BRUE، يعني حدث قصير وخلص لوحده من غير سبب واضح. أي تكرار لنفس الحادثة، حتى لو صار قبل 30 يوم أو بعده، بيخلي الخطر أعلى ويصنّفه high-risk. الخيارات التانية كلها features منخفضة الخطورة: المدة أقل من دقيقة، والعمر أكبر من 60 يوم، وCPR من الوالد. يعني الخيار الصح هو وجود episode مشابه أكثر من 30 يوم، لأنه بالزبط هو اللي بينقل الحالة لتصنيف الخطورة العالية.
الفخ: الطلاب بيسقطوا على duration of event أكثر من 30 ثانية، لأنهم فاكرين إن أي تسعون ثانية كافية تستاهلوا admission. لكن بالبروتوكول الحد اللي بيفرق هو الدقيقة الواحدة، وكل ما كان الحدث أقل من دقيقة بيعتبر low-risk.

question: A 3-month-old infant with BRUE, born full term, first episode, well-appearing, vitals normal. What is the most appropriate next step?

options.text: Obtain screening chest x-ray and ECG

englishExplanation: This patient has experienced a low-risk BRUE (full term, >60 days, lasted <1 minute, first occurrence, no other concerning features). The patient can be discharged home without further workup.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد الرضيع عنده BRUE منخفض الخطورة بكل المعايير: وُلد full term، وعمره أكثر من 60 يوم، والحادثة استمرت أقل من دقيقة، وهي أول مرة تحصل، وما في features مقلقة ثانية. لأنه low-risk، بتنزّله عالمستشفى بدون أي work-up إضافي. التطمّن مع الأهل جزء أساسي من هال الخطوة، لأنه الـ BRUE لحاله ما بيعني إن في مرض خطير ورا الكواليس.
الفخ: أحسن إغراء للطلاب إنه يطلبوا chest x-ray و ECG أو basic labs خوفاً من إنه فاته شي. الفرق إن هال الحالة ما فيها أي concerning features، فما في داعي لعمل فحوصات إضافية. Admission أو observation بتبقى overkill مع baby مستقر.

question: A 25-year-old man visiting from Colombia presents with cough, night sweats, hemoptysis. What type of isolation precautions should be taken?
englishExplanation: The patient has symptoms of cough, blood-tinged sputum, and night sweats after arriving from a country with endemic tuberculosis. TB is spread via airborne transmission; airborne precautions should be initiated.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض وصل من بلد endemic tuberculosis، ومعه cough و blood-tinged sputum و night sweats، وهي symptoms كلاسيكية عند TB. البكتيريا بتنقل airborne، يعني عبر الهوا، مش بالتماس المباشر ولا بالقطيرات. ولأنها بتنتشر بالهوا مع كل سعال، العزل بالـ airborne هو اللي بيحمي الفريق والزبائن التانية في نفس الوحدة. هاد كله بيخلي airborne precautions هي الـ precaution الصحيحة، وما في داعي تستنى شي تاني قبل ما تبدأها.
الفخ: أكثر خطأ بيوقع فيه الطلاب هو إنهم بيختاروا droplet لأنهم شافوا cough و sputum فيه دم، وحاسسوا إن أي عدوى تنفسية droplet. الفرق إن انتقال TB بيتم بالهوا، فالـ droplet لوحدها ما بتكفي حمايتك من الرذاذ المعلّق بالهوا.

question: A 45-year-old African American woman with lupus presents with fever, cough with blood-tinged sputum, chest pain, bibasilar consolidations. Which diagnosis has the highest morbidity and mortality?
englishExplanation: Acute lupus pneumonitis can be the initial manifestation of SLE. It is uncommon (<2%) but has high morbidity and mortality up to 50%. Treatment consists of systemic corticosteroids or other immunosuppressive medications.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: pneumonitis الحادة المرتبطة بـ lupus ممكن تكون أول manifestation بتظهر فيها SLE، يعني المرض ممكن يبدأ بأول شي طلّعوا. بس هاي نادرة، أقل من 2%، ومع ذلك morbidity و mortality فيها بيوصلوا لـ 50% وهي أعلى من باقي أشكال الـ lupus involvement. العلاج بيكون systemic corticosteroids أو غيرها من immunosuppressive medications. اللي بيخلي الإجابة واضحة هو إن السؤال بيدور على diagnosis اللي أعلى morbidity و mortality، مو على الأكثر شيوعاً.
الفخ: الطلاب بيروحوا على acute lupus pleuritis أو على acute bacterial pneumonia لأن الـ fever والكحة مع الدم بتوحي بعدوى. لكن pneumonitis هي اللي بتدي complication rates عالية، بينما الـ pleuritis والـ pneumonia مش diagnosis الخطورة اللي بالسؤال.

question: A 42-year-old woman with tracheostomy presents 1 year later with lethargy, fever, purulent drainage at site. After suctioning, SpO2 improves. What is the best disposition?

options.text: Admit to floor bed with broad-spectrum antibiotics
Admit to the ICU with broad-spectrum antibiotics and tracheostomy suctioning
Discharge back to nursing home with antibiotics
Intubate orally in the emergency department and admit to the ICU

correctAnswer: Admit to the ICU with broad-spectrum antibiotics and tracheostomy suctioning
englishExplanation: The patient presents with signs of sepsis from bacterial tracheitis. After initial airway management with oxygen, suctioning, and possible tracheostomy replacement, the infection should be treated with antibiotics. Because of the potential for airway compromise, the patient should be admitted to the ICU.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة مع symptoms واضحة من bacterial tracheitis، يعني حمى و drainage قيحي من موقع الـ tracheostomy، وهاد كله Bezos sepsis. بعد ما تعمل airway management بـ oxygen و suctioning، وممكن تستبدل الـ tracheostomy، لازم تعالج العدوى بمضادات حيوية broad-spectrum. ولأن في احتمال كبير إن الـ airway يتأثر أو ينسد، لازم تنقلها للـ ICU مش بس تديها antibiotics وتنزّلها على جناح.
الفخ: أحسن إغراء للطلاب هو يختاروا discharge back to nursing home مع antibiotics، لأن المريضة كانت stable بعد الـ suctioning وتحسن الـ SpO2. الفرق إن airway compromise ممكن يصير فجأة، والـ ICU هي المكان اللي بيقدروا يعملوا suctioning متى ما اشتكوا.

question: A 17-year-old boy smoked synthetic marijuana 4 hours ago, mild bilateral conjunctival injection, mild anxiety, ECG sinus tachycardia. What is the best course of action?
englishExplanation: Most synthetic cannabinoid presentations are mild and self-limited, including agitation, anxiety, psychosis, tachycardia, and conjunctival injection. This patient with mild symptoms >4 hours after ingestion is appropriate for discharge.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: أغلب حالات synthetic cannabinoids بتيجي خفيفة وبتخلص لحالها، والأعراض المعروفة منها زي agitation و anxiety و psychosis و tachycardia و conjunctival injection. هاد الصبي عنده أعراض بسيطة وعمرو 4 ساعات بعد ما دخّن، يعني هاي presentation من الـ mild side. للذلك يطلع من الـ ED مع reassurance بدون admission أو فحوصات، واختيار admission أو urine drug screen مش مناسب مع حالة خفيفة هاي.
الفخ: الطلاب بيسقطوا على admit for observation لأنهم شافوا tachycardia و anxiety، وبيحسوا لازم نراقب بالـ hospital. الفرق إن أغلب الـ presentations بتكون خفيفة و self-limited، و4 ساعات بعد الـ ingestion الأعراض خفيفة، فالـ observation مش ضرورية.

question: A 17-year-old boy with SVT that converted with 6 mg adenosine. HR now 78 bpm. What is the best disposition?
englishExplanation: For a first-time episode of SVT without evidence of underlying structural disease or preexcitation, discharge home with primary care follow-up is a reasonable disposition. Advise to avoid precipitants such as caffeine.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد أول episode من SVT طلع عند الصبي، وحconvert بـ 6 mg adenosine ورجع الـ HR لـ 78. وبما ما في أي دليل على structural disease في القلب ولا على preexcitation، فالـ disposition الافتراضي هو يطلع عالمستشفى مع primary care follow-up. وبيُنصح يتجنب الـ precipitants زي caffeine لأنها بتفتح نوبات SVT. وهاي هي السبب اللي بيخلي cardiology follow-up مش الخيار الأفضل.
الفخ: أحسن خطأ هو تختار admit for telemetry monitoring أو cardiology consultation، لأن الصبي عنده episode من SVT وبيحسوا لازم نراقبه بالـ hospital. الفرق إن هاي أول مرة وما في structural disease ولا preexcitation، فـ primary care follow-up يكفّي وننصحه يتجنب caffeine.

question: A 24-year-old man with HCM confirmed by echo. What is the correct disposition?

options.text: Admit to telemetry and cardiology consultation
Discharge home with a Holter monitor
Observe in the emergency department for 6 hours
Transfer to the nearest STEMI center

correctAnswer: Admit to telemetry and cardiology consultation
englishExplanation: This patient has a new diagnosis of HCM and is symptomatic. He should be admitted to telemetry, and cardiology consultation should be obtained to discuss definitive treatment options. HCM is the leading cardiovascular cause of sudden cardiac arrest in young athletes.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده تشخيص جديد بـ HCM وهو symptomatic، فهاد بيعني حالة جديدة لازم نتعامل معها بجدية. لازم ين admit للـ telemetry مع cardiology consultation، والـ consultation هاد بنحكي فيه خيارات العلاج النهائية للمريض. وكمان لازم تفتكر إن HCM هي السبب الأول للـ sudden cardiac arrest عند الـ young athletes، وهاد بيفسّر ليش مش بنفّر فيه ونتعامل معاه على إنه عادي.
الفخ: أحسن إغراء للطلاب هو discharge home مع Holter monitor أو observe في الـ ED 6 ساعات، لأنهم شافوا إن المريض شاب ومافيهم symptoms واضحة. الفرق إن HCM مع symptoms هو diagnosis جديد ومحتاج متابعة متخصصة وخيارات علاج، فالـ observation السريعة بتخسر كل شي.

question: A 67-year-old man with history of MRSA, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, productive cough for 3 days. Which laboratory test should be obtained to tailor empiric therapy?
englishExplanation: IDSA/ATS recommend MRSA nasal PCR or culture for any patient with history of MRSA or when MRSA treatment is being started empirically. The HCAP category no longer exists. If empiric coverage for MRSA is given, PCR or culture data should be obtained.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: موضوع MRSA مش option ثانوي، لأن الـ IDSA/ATS بتوصي بـ MRSA nasal PCR أو culture لأي مريض عنده history of MRSA، أو إذا رح تبدأ empiric therapy تغطي MRSA. هاد المريض عنده تاريخ MRSA وكحة مع بلغم، فالـ PCR أو culture هاد هو اللي بيوجّه العلاج. ولاحظ إن تصنيف HCAP صار مش موجود، فما تتعتمد عليه.
الفخ: الطلاب بيسقطوا على CRP level أو LDH level لأنهم فاكرين أي inflammation marker بيساعد. الفرق إن CRP و LDH بيساعدوا يقيّموا شدة الـ inflammation، ما بيقولوا إيش Organism ولا هل MRSA present.

question:
Shared scenario:


52.   Which of the following laboratory abnormalities is most likely based
on his disease process?
englishExplanation:
52.  The answer is e. BNP can be used to aid in the diagnosis of the
dyspneic patient. Congestive heart failure is characterized by a lack of
adequate forward flow of blood due to impaired cardiac function. Poor
forward flow leads to increased end-diastolic volumes in the left atria and
ventricle. These increased volumes stretch the cardiac myocytes and
increase tension on the chamber walls. In response to this stress, the heart
releases BNP. Natriuretic peptides regulate the sympathetic nervous system
to decrease afterload and increases natural diuresis by the kidney to
decrease preload. Elevations in BNP can also be seen in pulmonary
hypertension, PE, pneumonia, sepsis, and renal failure, so this test should
be used in combination with history and physical exam findings. BNP can
be falsely lowered by obesity and should be used with caution in patients
with a high BMI.
A positive D-dimer (a) may be seen in PE, disseminated intravascular
coagulopathy, or sepsis. A negative D-dimer can be useful in excluding a PE

when there is a low pretest probability. Leukocytosis (b) may be present if
the patient is suffering from an infectious, inflammatory, or malignant
process. Troponin (c) is a biomarker released by cardiac myocytes during
ischemia. This is seen during acute coronary syndrome or septic shock. This
patient is not experiencing chest pain and it is more likely they are suffering
from fluid overload than acute cardiac ischemia. Anemia (d) is not
frequently associated with congestive heart failure exacerbations.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض وصل بـ respiratory distress ومعه حمى وفيfiltrates، بس الـ BNP من أهم التحاليل اللي بتساعد في تقييم الـ dyspnea. السبب إنه في congestive heart failure القلب ما يقدر يدفع blood بشكل كافي، فبتزاد الـ end-diastolic volume في الأذين الأيسر والبطين، والخلايا بتتمدد وبيزداد الـ tension على جدران الغرف، فالقلب بيبدأ يفرز BNP. هاد ال peptide بتنظم الـ sympathetic nervous system وبتنقص الـ afterload وبتزود الـ diuresis الطبيعي من الكلى فتنقص الـ preload.
الفخ: الطلاب بيسقطوا على elevated troponin أو leukocytosis لأنهم شافوا المريض تعبان مع حمى والـ infiltrates. الفرق إن الـ troponin بيتعامل مع injury والـ leukocytosis مع inflammation، والـ BNP هاد بيساعد تمييز cardiac cause عن غيرها من أسباب الـ dyspnea.

question:
Shared scenario:
A 32-year-old woman presents to the ED with a 1-month history of general
malaise, mild cough, and subjective fevers. She is HIV positive and 6
months ago her CD4 count was 220. She is not on antiretroviral therapy or
any other medications. Initial vitals include a BP of 130/60 mm Hg, HR of
88 beats/minute, RR of 12 breaths/minute, and oxygen saturation of 91% on
room air. Her chest radiograph shows bilateral diffuse interstitial infiltrates
as shown in the illustration. Subsequent laboratory tests are unremarkable
except for leukopenia and an elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level.

(Reproduced with permission from Adam J. Rosh, MD, and Rosh Review.)

55.   Which of the following is the most likely organism responsible for her
clinical presentation?
englishExplanation:
55.  The answer is c. PJP is a common opportunistic infection in the
HIV/AIDS population. It typically presents with mild subjective symptoms
of cough and general malaise and is considered an AIDS defining illness
along with diseases like cryptococcosis and histoplasmosis. Objectively,
patients are hypoxic and have a chest radiograph with a bilateral interstitial
process. Risk factors include a CD4 count less than 200. Serum LDH is
also elevated in AIDS patients with PJP pneumonia and a negative test
leads to a very low predictive value of active PJP. In fact, the greater the
elevation in LDH, the worse the prognosis. Despite the classic PJP
radiograph demonstrating bilateral diffuse interstitial infiltrates beginning in
the perihilar region and extending into a “bat-wing” pattern, the chest
radiograph may be normal in up to 30% of patients. In addition to Kaposi
sarcoma involvement in the lungs, pulmonary infections, such as
tuberculosis (TB), cytomegalovirus, and other fungal infections, should also
be considered.
Coccidioidomycosis (a) is caused by the fungus C. immitis. The fungus
is endemic in the southwestern United States. Confirmation of the diagnosis
is made through direct observation of the fungus in smear or culture, or
through the detection of serum antibodies. The chest radiograph generally
reveals mediastinal or hilar adenopathy, pleural effusions, nodules,
cavitations, or infiltrates. M. tuberculosis (b) is the causative organism of
TB. Patients can present with chronic cough, hemoptysis, and constitutional
symptoms. Because TB can present in a clinically similar fashion as PJP in
immunocompromised individuals, it should also be ruled out in this patient.
In classic reactivation TB, pulmonary lesions are located in the posterior
segment of the right-upper lobe, apicoposterior segment of the left-upper
lobe, and apical segments of the lower lobes. In the presence of HIV or
other immunosuppressant disease, lesions are often atypical. Up to 20% of
patients who are HIV positive with active TB disease have normal chest X-

ray findings. M. pneumoniae (d) is a common cause of community-acquired
pneumonia in patients younger than the age of 40. Radiographic findings
are variable, but abnormalities are usually more striking than the findings
on physical examination. H. influenzae (e) is common among patients with
COPD, alcoholism, malnutrition, or malignancy.

![PreTest-5e-00055 source page 68](images/PreTest-5e-00055-PreTest-5e-p0068.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00055 source page 69](images/PreTest-5e-00055-PreTest-5e-p0069.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00055 source page 86](images/PreTest-5e-00055-PreTest-5e-p0086.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00055 source page 87](images/PreTest-5e-00055-PreTest-5e-p0087.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: PJP من أشهر الـ opportunistic infections عند مرضى HIV/AIDS، وبيظهر بشكل نموذجي كـ cough خفيف و malaise عام مع نقص أكسجين، والـ CXR بتطلع infiltrates ثنائية interstitial. كمان الـ PJP بيعتبَر disease تعريف AIDS مثل cryptococcosis و histoplasmosis، وأهم risk factor هو CD4 تحت 200. وكمان الـ LDH serum مرتفع عند مرضى PJP، وكل ما زاد مقداره كل ما الـ prognosis صار أسوأ، حتى إنه أحياناً الـ CXR بتكون طبيعية عند 30% من الحالات.
الفخ: الطلاب بيروحوا على Coccidioides immitis لأن الـ CXR فيها infiltrates، بس الـ coccidioidomycosis endemic في جنوب غرب أمريكا وبتدي adenopathy mediastinal أو hilar مع pleural effusions و nodules و cavitation. افرّق: ما في تاريخ سفر أو مكان endemic، والـ LDH مرفوعة بتماشي مع PJP.

question:
A 27-year-old woman presents to the ED complaining of an intensely
pruritic rash all over her body, abdominal cramping, and chest tightness.
She states that 1 hour ago she was at dinner and accidentally ate soup
containing seafood. She has a known anaphylactic allergy to shrimp. Her
BP is 115/75 mm Hg, HR is 95 beats/minute, RR is 20 breaths/minute,
temperature is 98.9°F, and oxygen saturation is 97% on room air. She
appears anxious and her skin is flushed with scattered urticarial lesions.
Auscultation of her lungs reveals scattered wheezes with decreased air
entry. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in
management?

options.text: Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV
Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV
Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV
Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV
Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV

correctAnswer: Administer oxygen via nonrebreather, place a large-bore IV, begin IV
englishExplanation:
57.  The answer is c. The patient is having an anaphylactic reaction to the
soup she ate which likely contained shrimp. Anaphylaxis refers to a severe
systemic allergic reaction with variable features such as respiratory
difficulty, cardiovascular collapse, pruritic skin rash, and abdominal
cramping. Anaphylaxis is a hypersensitivity reaction caused by a type I
hypersensitivity IgE-mediated reaction. Foods are the major cause in
cases of anaphylaxis in which a source can be determined. Common foods
that incite anaphylaxis include nuts, shellfish, and eggs. In the ED,

attention is focused on reversing cardiovascular and respiratory
disturbances. Epinephrine is the first drug of choice for patients with
anaphylaxis and can often be lifesaving. The route of administration is
chosen by the severity of the patient’s presentation. In a patient with severe
upper airway obstruction or worsening hypotension, IV epinephrine should
be administered. Patients with relatively stable vital signs can receive
intramuscular epinephrine. Many patients with known allergies carry
epinephrine autoinjectors that they can self-administer in the outpatient
setting. Antihistamines, both H1 antagonists (diphenhydramine) and H2
antagonists (famotidine), should be used in all cases. These drugs block the
action of circulating histamines at target tissue receptors. Corticosteroids,
such as methylprednisolone, have an onset of action approximately 4 to 6
hours after administration and are of limited value in the acute setting.
Giving steroids early may, however, blunt the biphasic reaction of
anaphylaxis and should be administered initially along with antihistamines.
Nebulized albuterol (d) is appropriate for treatment of anaphylaxis.
Racemic epinephrine (e) is more commonly used for croup. They are both
adjunctive therapies to assist with dilatation of the pulmonary tree but
should never be given alone to treat anaphylaxis or prior to IM/IV
epinephrine. Both diphenhydramine and methylprednisolone (a and b)
should be given; however, the patient requires treatment with epinephrine
first and foremost.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد عنده anaphylactic reaction واضحة بعد أكل شوربة فيها seafood، ومعه known allergy للـ shrimp، والأعراض بتطابق: حكة وتوهج جلدي، ومغص بطن، وضيق صدر، وأزيز مع دخول هواء أقل. الأساس بهاد الـ treatment إنه epinephrine هو أول دواء وخياره الأول وبيقدر ينقذ الحياة. ومع vital signs مستقرة، الـ IM epinephrine هو الطريق المناسب، ومعه fluids و IV methylprednisolone و IV diphenhydramine، و antihistamines H2 مثل famotidine بكل الحالات.
الفخ: أحسن خطأ للطلاب إنه يختاروا الخيار اللي بيبدأ بـ IV epinephrine، لأنهم شايفين إن المريض عنده ضيق صدر وأزيز. الفرق إن IV epinephrine محجوزة للحالات اللي فيها upper airway obstruction شديد أو hypotension بيتزاد، أما هاي حالته vital signs مستقرة فالـ IM epinephrine هو الصح.

question:
Shared scenario:
A 32-year-old man is brought into the ED by EMS with fever, shortness of
breath, and stridor. The patient was treated the previous day in the ED for a
viral syndrome and discharged home. His BP is 90/50 mm Hg, HR is 110
beats/minute, RR is 28 breaths/minute, and temperature is 101.2°F. A chest
radiograph reveals a widened mediastinum. The patient is endotracheally
intubated, given a 2 L bolus of normal saline, and started on antibiotics. His
BP improves to 110/70 mm Hg and he is transferred to the intensive care
unit (ICU). The patient’s friend accompanied him to the hospital and

discloses that the patient is a drum maker and frequently works with animal
hides.

60.   What is the most likely organism that is responsible for this patient’s
presentation?
englishExplanation:
60.  The answer is e. Inhalation anthrax is a rare but life-threatening
disease caused by inhalation of B. anthracis spores. Initially, the patient
develops flu-like symptoms; however, within 24 to 48 hours, the clinical
course may abruptly deteriorate to septic shock, respiratory failure, and
mediastinitis. Chest X-ray may reveal a widened mediastinum due to
hilar lymphadenopathy. Death usually results within 3 days and mortality
rates exceed 90%. Anthrax is normally a disease of sheep, cattle, and
horses. Working with untreated animal hides or raw wool increases the
risk for anthrax exposure. There is no evidence for human-to-human
transmission, but spores can be inhaled from a powdered form which was
used in bioterrorism attacks in the early 2000s.

Though S. pneumoniae and H. influenzae (a and d) can cause
respiratory failure, it is unlikely to occur in a healthy 32-year-old patient.
Diphtheria (b) is a potentially life-threatening disease that is characterized
by a gray-green pseudomembrane covering the tonsils and pharyngeal
mucosa. C. burnetii (c) is the organism that causes Q fever. It is similar to
B. anthracis in that sheep, cattle, and goats are the primary reservoirs. It can
cause, hepatitis, headaches, and cardiac manifestation such as endocarditis
and pericarditis. Deterioration due to Q fever is not as rapid as that seen in
anthrax.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض كان يشتغل في صنع الطبول وبيشتغل مع جلود الحيوانات، وهاد exposure معروف لـ B. anthracis. بدأ الأمر كأنه syndrome فيروسي، بس بعد 24 لـ 48 ساعة بينهار بسرعة لـ septic shock و respiratory failure و mediastinitis، والـ CXR بتبيّن mediastinum متوسع بسبب hilar lymphadenopathy. والـ mortality بتوصل فوق 90% وبيموت خلال 3 أيام. وليس فيه transmission من إنسان لإنسان، بس الـ spores ممكن تتنفس.
الفخ: أكثر إغراء للطلاب هو S. pneumoniae أو H. influenzae لأنهم شافوا pneumonia مع stridor، أو C. burnetii لأن Q fever إلها نفس الـ reservoirs. الفرق إن تدهور Q fever مو بهالسرعة، والـ deterioration السريع مع widened mediastinum بعد التعرض للجلود هو signature الـ anthrax.

question:
Which of the following statements is true regarding pertussis
infection?

options.text: Infection is more severe in adults than children
The organism is typically identified on routine sputum culture
Treatment is with a macrolide antibiotic
Antibiotics do not alter the course of illness
The first phase of illness involves paroxysms of cough

correctAnswer: Treatment is with a macrolide antibiotic
englishExplanation:
64.  The answer is c. Bordetella pertussis is a gram-negative bacillus that
causes a respiratory illness most commonly in the summer and fall months.
Classically, the disease infects unvaccinated infants (<1-year-old). Over
time, immunity conferred by the pediatric vaccine loses its effectiveness
and as a result we have seen a resurgence of this infection, but overall

incidence has decreased over the last 20 years. There are three stages of
illness: (1) Catarrhal—characterized by sneezing, rhinorrhea, and coughing;
(2) Paroxysmal—frequent coughing episodes followed by an inspiratory
“whoop” and posttussive emesis; (3) Convalescent—chronic cough lasting
several months. First-line treatment is with macrolides, preferably
azithromycin, for 5 days. Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole for 14 days may
also be used in the case of allergy.
Pertussis infections in the adult population (a) are less severe than that
in infants and children and they can act as asymptomatic carriers. The
organism is not easily identified on routine sputum culture (b) and
definitive diagnosis usually requires polymerase chain reaction (PCR) via
nasopharyngeal swabs or serologic detection of antibodies. Antibiotics (d)
impact the course of illness but only when they are prescribed early.
Treatment is most effective when started within the first week of symptoms.
After 2 weeks of infection, the role of antibiotics is primarily to decrease
transmission to others. Antitussives have not shown to be effective in
reducing the cough symptoms. As mentioned earlier, the first phase of
illness (e) is the catarrhal phase. The paroxysms of cough occur in phase 2.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ pertussis بيسببها Bordetella pertussis، وهي bacillus gram-negative بتصيب respiratory illness، وأشيع شي لغاية الآن صغار تحت سنة اللي ما vaccineوا. بس مع الوقت ضعفت المناعة اللي بتكسبها لقاح الأطفال، وبدأت الحالات ترجع عند الكبار. العلاج الخط الأول هو macrolide antibiotic، والأفضل azithromycin لمدة 5 أيام، وبنستخدم TMP/SMX لمدة 14 يوم في حالة الحساسية. ومهم إن الـ antibiotics بتأثر بمسار المرض لما تعطى من أول أسبوع.
الفخ: أحسن خطأ هو تختار إن الـ antibiotics ما بتأثر بمسار المرض، لأنك بتفكر إنها بتhalt symptoms بس. الفرق إن الـ antibiotics بتأثر فعلاً بس لما تعطى بدري، أي خلال أول أسبوع من ظهور الـ symptoms. والـ paroxysms هي المرحلة الثانية مو الأولى.

question:
Shared scenario:
A 68-year-old man is brought in by EMS after being found sleeping
underneath a nearby bridge. The patient frequently sleeps in shelters or
outdoors. He complains of a cough that is productive of blood-streaked
sputum which has been present for 2 months. Patient also endorses weight
loss, night sweats, and general malaise over the same period of time. He
does not know of any active medical problems; however, he has not sought
medical treatment for many years. On exam, the patient appears cachectic,
but in no acute distress. His BP is 115/63 mm Hg, HR is 82 beats/minute,
RR 22 breaths/minute, temperature oxygen saturation is 93% on room air,
and his temperature is 99.7°F. A chest X-ray is performed and demonstrates
bilateral cavitary lesions located in the upper lobes.

65.   Which of the following is true regarding this patient’s diagnosis?

options.text: The initial infection usually causes severe symptoms
Active disease is diagnosed via an intradermal injection of purified
The disease is typically treated with a 5-day course of antibiotics
Nursing home residents are considered a low-risk population
The most common site of extra-pulmonary disease is the lymphatic

correctAnswer: The most common site of extra-pulmonary disease is the lymphatic
englishExplanation:
65.  The answer is e. This patient is suffering from active reactivation TB
caused by the slow growing anaerobic rod M. tuberculosis. This bacterium
settles in areas of high oxygen concentrations, so preferentially infects the
lungs and more specifically the apices. More than one-third of the world’s
population is infected with the bacteria, and it is the second leading
infectious cause of death worldwide. Risk factors include immigration from
a high-risk area, HIV, residents and staff of prisons or shelters, alcoholics
and IV drug users, and elderly and nursing home patients. When a patient is
first infected, they enter the primary TB phase. This stage is usually
asymptomatic, although some may experience symptoms of a common
cold. Radiographic findings consistent with active primary TB are similar to
those of lobar pneumonia with ipsilateral hilar adenopathy. Following the
initial infection, the disease progresses to the latent infection phase. Here
the bacteria lie dormant, many times for years, in granulomas called
tubercles. Only 13% of those infected will go on to develop reactivation
TB. Reactivation is most common in those with compromised immune
systems. This phase is classically characterized by constitutional symptoms,
cough, hemoptysis, pleuritic chest pain, and dyspnea as the infection

spreads through the lungs. Findings on chest X-ray include cavitary or
noncavitary lesions in the upper lobes or superior segment of the lower
lobes. Twenty percent of cases will have extrapulmonary manifestations and
the most common site is the lymphatic system where it causes painless
lymphadenopathy commonly referred to as scrofula.
After initial infection, most patients are asymptomatic and those with
symptoms are usually very mild (a). Twenty percent of patients with active
TB have a negative test after injection of PPD making it an unreliable test
(b). PPD placement is best used for the diagnosis of latent TB. Active TB is
often diagnosed via cultures and/or nucleic acid amplification (NAAT) tests
of induced sputum. Due to the fact that M. tuberculosis is a very slow
growing organism, treatment for TB includes a long course of
antituberculous medications, often lasting 26 to 31 weeks (c). Multiple
drugs, including pyrazinamide, rifampin, isoniazid, and ethambutol are
administered concurrently to overcome resistance. Nursing home residents
(d) and the elderly are considered a high-risk population.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده reactivation TB، وعنده cavitary lesions في الـ upper lobes مع constitutional symptoms وكحة فيها دم و night sweats و weight loss. البكتيريا M. tuberculosis بتستقر بالأماكن الغنية بالأكسجين، يعني الـ apices، وهاد اللي طلع بالـ CXR. والstatement الصح إن أكثر موقع بياخد فيه TB خارج الرئة هو الـ lymphatic system، وهاي هي الإجابة.
الفخ: الطلاب بيروحوا على intradermal injection of purified protein derivative لأنهم سمعوا إن الـ diagnosis بتعمل بـ skin test. الفرق إن هاد الـ test مش بيكشف active disease، والمريض عنده reactivation مع cavitary lesions وأعراض constitutional واضحة.

question:
A 45-year-old man with history of acquired immunodeficiency
syndrome (AIDS) previously complicated by esophageal candidiasis
presents to the ED with complaint of fatigue, fever, dry cough, and dyspnea.
He does not always remember to take his antiretroviral medications due to a
constantly changing work schedule. His most recent CD4+ T-cell count 2
weeks ago was 150 cells/mm3. His symptoms have developed over the past
few weeks and have been progressively worsening. He denies any other
associated symptoms such as rhinorrhea, nasal congestion, headache,
vomiting, or diarrhea. BP is 115/75 mm Hg, HR is 95 beats/minute, RR is
24 breaths/minute, pulse oximetry is 88% on room air, and temperature is
101°F. His lungs are diffusely coarse to auscultation. His CXR is shown
below. What is the most likely cause of the patient’s symptoms?
englishExplanation:
189.  The answer is b. A CD4+ T-cell count less than 200 cells/mm3 puts a
patient with HIV at risk for opportunistic infections and is also a diagnostic
criterion for AIDS. This patient’s presentation and CXR are most consistent
with a diagnosis of pneumocystis pneumonia caused by P. jirovecii
pneumonia (PCP). PCP is often the opportunistic infection that leads to a
diagnosis of AIDS and about 70% of patients with HIV will develop this
infection during the course of their disease. Although diffuse interstitial
infiltrates are often described as a “bat wing” pattern are typical, normal
radiographic findings can exist in 15% to 25% of patients. Initial treatment
is with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. Oral prednisone should be added
if there is partial pressure of arterial oxygenation less than 70 mm Hg or
alveolar-arterial gradient less than 35 mm Hg.
Although bacteria are still the most common causes of respiratory
infections in patients with AIDS, the insidious onset of the patient’s
symptoms, CXR findings, and previously diagnosed opportunistic
infections and low CD4+ count make PCP more likely. S. pneumoniae (d)
usually causes a lobar infiltrate on CXR. CXR findings in S. aureus (c)
pneumonia include multilobar consolidation, cavitation, pneumatoceles, and
possibly pneumothorax. Mycoplasma pneumoniae (e) is a common cause of
atypical pneumonia and may have similar CXR findings to PCP. However,
it is often associated with upper respiratory tract symptoms. Influenza (a)
can cause a viral pneumonia; however, it is also commonly associated with
upper respiratory tract symptoms. Influenza is also unlikely to progress
slowly over a period of weeks such as PCP.

![PreTest-5e-00189 source page 218](images/PreTest-5e-00189-PreTest-5e-p0218.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00189 source page 219](images/PreTest-5e-00189-PreTest-5e-p0219.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00189 source page 240](images/PreTest-5e-00189-PreTest-5e-p0240.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ CD4+ T-cell count عنده 150، وهاد تحت 200 يعني خطر opportunistic infections وكمان معيار تشخيص AIDS. الـ presentation بتاعته والـ CXR بتوحي بـ PCP اللي سببها P. jirovecii، وهي غالباً الـ infection اللي بتوصل فيها تشخيص AIDS، و70% تقريباً من مرضى HIV بيصابوا فيها خلال course المرض. الـ bat wing pattern من الـ interstitial infiltrates هو الشكل النموذجي، بس الـ CXR ممكن تكون طبيعية عند 15% لـ 25% من الحالات.
الفخ: الطلاب بيسقطوا على S. pneumoniae أو S. aureus لأنهم شافوا حمى وكحة، وبيفتكروا إن الـ pneumonia العادية هي الأرجح. الفرق إن الـ onset عنده خبيث ومتدريج ومعه opportunistic infection سابقة، و S. pneumoniae بتدي lobar infiltrate بينما S. aureus بتدي multilobar consolidation مع cavitation.

question:
A 59-year-old man is brought into the ED accompanied by his son
who states that his father is acting irritable and occasionally confused. The
son states that his father has a history of hepatitis from a transfusion he
received many years ago. Over the past 5 years, his liver function slowly
deteriorated. His vital signs include BP of 145/80 mm Hg, HR of 78
beats/minute, RR of 16 breaths/minute, temperature of 98°F, and oxygen
saturation of 98%. Laboratory results are all within normal limits, except
for a significantly elevated ammonia level. Which of the following is the
best therapy?
englishExplanation:
229.  The answer is b. The patient has hepatic encephalopathy, which is a
clinical state of disordered cerebral function occurring secondary to acute or
chronic liver disease. Laboratory tests may be normal in patients, but the
serum ammonia level is usually elevated. Lactulose and neomycin
represent the main therapeutic agents. Lactulose is a poorly absorbed sugar
metabolized by colonic bacteria that traps ammonia and helps excrete it in
the stool. Neomycin is a poorly absorbed aminoglycoside that is believed to
act by reducing colonic bacteria responsible for producing ammonia.
No other antibiotics (a, c, d, and e) are indicated in the management of
hepatic encephalopathy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده hepatic encephalopathy، يعني حالة اضطراب في وظائف المخ ناتجة عن مرض كبد حاد أو مزمن، ومعه تغيّر مزاج وتشوش، وكل الفحوصات عادية ما عدا serum ammonia مرتفع بشكل واضح. العلاج الأساسي هو lactulose مع neomycin. الـ lactulose سكر مش يمتص، البكتيريا في الأمعاء الكبيرة بتحوّله وبتساعد على حبس الأمونيا وطردها مع البراز. والـ neomycin aminoglycoside ضعيف الامتصاص بيشتغل بتقليل البكتيريا المعوية اللي بتنتج الأمونيا.
الفخ: أكثر إغراء للطلاب هو يختاروا vancomycin و gentamycin أو ampicillin و gentamycin، لأنهم شافوا المريض محتاج antibiotic وحاسين إنه أي bactericidal antibiotic هو الإجابة. الفرق إن أي antibiotic ثاني مش له دور في hepatic encephalopathy، والعلاج الحقيقي بيتمركز على تقليل الأمونيا من الأمعاء.

question:
A 23-year-old man presents to the ED after sustaining a bee sting.
The pain is isolated to his left arm where the bee sting occurred. Upon
physical examination, you see a single puncture wound with surrounding
erythema and swelling. He denies respiratory distress and is phonating well.
Chest auscultation reveals clear breath sounds bilaterally without wheezing.
The oropharynx is patent without tongue or lip swelling or uvular
displacement. Vital signs are within normal limits. Which of the following
is the most appropriate next step in management?
englishExplanation:
446.  The answer is d. History taking should include prior bee stings, as
each successive sting increases the possibility of anaphylaxis given
sensitization. The ABCs must be initially addressed. Stings most
commonly present with localized burning, erythema, and edema at the sting
site lasting for about 24 hours. The patient is asymptomatic and only
warrants observation at this time. Toxicity and anaphylaxis are typically
evident soon after the sting and include vomiting, diarrhea, fever, and
neurologic manifestations, such as seizures and altered mental status. The
patient most likely sustained a sting from a honeybee or bumblebee given
the single puncture wound. Bees possess retroserrate-barbed stingers, which
are removed upon stinging, thereby eviscerating and killing the insect.
Vespids, such as wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets, do not contain this
mechanism and may sting many times. “Killer bees,” as popularized by the
film industry, contain the same amount of venom as other species. The

difference is that they are more aggressive and prone to swarm and follow a
victim for a longer distance.
The patient does not warrant epinephrine administration (a and b) in
any form as there are no systemic signs of anaphylaxis. Steroids (c) and
antihistamines (e) are usually given in patients with systemic signs. β2agonists (eg, albuterol) may also be given for respiratory symptoms.

![PreTest-5e-00446 source page 568](images/PreTest-5e-00446-PreTest-5e-p0568.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00446 source page 584](images/PreTest-5e-00446-PreTest-5e-p0584.jpg)

![PreTest-5e-00446 source page 585](images/PreTest-5e-00446-PreTest-5e-p0585.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: هاد المريض عنده bee sting، والألم محصور بذراعه اليسرى مع puncture wound واحدة واحمرار وتورم حول المكان بس، وما في أي علامات جهازية. أكثر شي شائع بعد اللدغة هو burning و erythema و edema موضعية بتبقى حوالي 24 ساعة. والـ ABCs عنده تمام وما في أي systemic signs، فالـ epinephrine مش مطلوب والخطوة الصح هي observation بس.
الفخ: أحسن خطأ للطلاب إنه يختاروا subcutaneous epinephrine أو IV steroid أو oral antihistamine، لأنهم شافوا انتفاخ وحساسية. الفرق إن هاد treatment بيتعطى مع علامات جهازية، وهاي الحالة مافية، فالـ observation هي كفاية. لو ظهر vomiting أو altered mental status لازم نغيّر الخطة فوراً.

question:
Shared scenario:
A 33-year-old woman presents to the emergency department (ED) with 8
days of subjective fever, headache, sore throat, and malaise. She states that
acetaminophen and ibuprofen have failed to help her symptoms. She
recently returned from a 2-year volunteer trip with the Peace Corps in West
Africa. She endorses taking her mefloquine weekly. Vitals signs are blood
pressure (BP) 115/75 mm Hg, heart rate (HR) 110 beats/minute, respiratory
rate (RR) 18 breaths/minute, temperature 101.2°F, and pulse oximetry 98%
on room air. She has bilateral conjunctival injection as well as a truncal
maculopapular rash.
