ليش: نسبة التكرار بعد نوبة واحدة من uncomplicated diverticulitis هي من 20% لـ 30%، والنظام الغذائي عالي الألياف ممكن يساعد يمنع نوبات جديدة. وما في دليل إنه تجنب المكسرات وبذور الذرة والفشار أو البزر بيزيد نسبة التكرار، مع إنه المرضى عادةً بينصحوا يتجنبوا هاي الأشياء. يعني النصيحة الشائعة هاي غير مثبتة علميًا.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه نسبة التكرار 75% أو إنه المريضة لازم تتدخل للمستشفى فورًا لل colonoscopy، بس هذول غلط. ال colonoscopy بتتأجل لحد ما تتحسن الحالة الحادة، ونسبة التكرار الفعلية 20% لـ 30% مو 75%.

question:
A 48-year-old male presents to the emergency department with abdominal pain 4 months 
after an uncomplicated Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. The patient’s initial postoperative course was 
uncomplicated and he has been losing weight as expected. However, over the past few weeks, 
he has noted intermittent, crampy, and diffuse abdominal pain that appears unrelated to eating. 
In the ED, his vital signs, blood tests, and CT are normal. What’s the likely explanation for the 
patient’s symptoms?
englishExplanation:
Roux-en-Y bypass creates potential areas of herniation in the mesentery which are 
closed at the time of surgery. Despite closure, some patients experience intestinal herniation 
through mesenteric defects, resulting in abdominal pain. Herniation is often intermittent and 
difficult to diagnose by CT. While the classic “mesenteric swirl sign” may be present, the 
majority of patients may have a normal CT. Thus, patients with otherwise unexplained 
abdominal pain status post bypass surgery may need repeat exploration to exclude an internal 
hernia. Gastrogastric fistulas most often occur in patients with a stapled but undivided stomach 
(the fistula forms between the remaining stomach “pouch” and the undivided remnant), a 
procedure that was performed in early gastric bypass procedures. In contrast to common 
beliefs, gastroesophageal reflux is not a common complication of gastric bypass surgery. 
Cholelithiasis is a common complication of gastric bypass but the patient’s history is not 
suggestive of biliary colic as his symptoms are not tied to eating.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: عملية Roux-en-Y gastric bypass بتخلق مناطق محتملة للفتق في ال mesentery، ومع إنها بتتغلق وقت الجراحة، بعض المرضى بصير عندهم intestinal herniation من خلال ال mesenteric defects وبتسبب ألم بالبطن. ال herniation عادةً intermittent وصعب يتشخص بال CT، لأن أغلب المرضى ممكن يكون ال CT عندهم طبيعي بالرغم من وجود mesenteric swirl sign أحيانًا. لهيك المريض اللي عنده ألم بطن غير مفسر بعد ال bypass ممكن يحتاج exploration مكرر لاستبعاد internal hernia.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Cholelithiasis لأنها اختلاط شائع لل bypass، بس ألمها biliary colic بيرتبط بالأكل بينما مريضنا ألمه مو مرتبط بالأكل. كمان ال CT عند المريض طبيعي مما يدعم ال internal hernia.

question: Which of the following is true about appendicitis in adult women?

options.text: Pregnant women are twice as likely as nonpregnant women to develop appendicitis.
Cervical motion tenderness (CMT) rules out appendicitis.
Even in the third trimester, most pregnant women still have pain in the right lower quadrant.
Due to anatomic changes, appendicitis in pregnant women occurs most often in the third
Fetal abortion occurs in 50% of pregnant women with perforated appendicitis.

correctAnswer: Even in the third trimester, most pregnant women still have pain in the right lower quadrant.
englishExplanation:
Pregnant women develop appendicitis at the same rate as not pregnant women. Due 
to nearby gynecologic structures, women with appendicitis are more frequently misdiagnosed. 
As many as 33% of women with appendicitis are initially misdiagnosed, and as many as 45% of 
women with symptoms of appendicitis are found to have a normal appendix during surgery. 
Although CMT is more common in gynecologic diseases, as many as one-fourth of women with 
appendicitis have CMT upon physical examination. Even in the third trimester, most pregnant 
women still have pain in the right lower quadrant. In pregnant women, appendicitis occurs 
slightly more often in the second trimester, although the reasons for this are not known. Fetal 
abortion complicates perforated maternal appendicitis in 20% of cases.

![subjects1200-f1fa8c56a652a787 source page 135](images/subjects1200-f1fa8c56a652a787-p0135.jpg)

![subjects1200-f1fa8c56a652a787 source page 136](images/subjects1200-f1fa8c56a652a787-p0136.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: حتى في الثلث الثالث من الحمل، لسا أغلب الحوامل بضل عندهم ألم في right lower quadrant عندهم appendicitis، لأن ال appendix ما بتنتقل لهالدرجة. كمان ال CMT أكثر شيوعًا بأمراض النسائية، بس ربع النساء اللي عندهم appendicitis عندهم CMT بالفحص، فما بتستبعد التشخيص. نسبة حدوث ال appendicitis عند الحوامل نفس نسبة غير الحوامل.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه ال appendicitis بالحوامل بتصير أكثر بالثلث الثالث أو إنه CMT بتستبعد التشخيص، وكلاهما غلط. الحقيقة إنه بتحصل أكثر بالثلث الثاني بشكل بسيط، وال CMT موجودة بربع الحالات.

question:
A 67-year-old female with diabetes, hypertension, and a history of an aortoiliac bypass graft 
presents with abdominal pain and dark, “funny-smelling” stools. She states the symptoms 
started 2 days ago and seem to have gone away as she had a “nearnormal” bowel movement 
this morning and no longer has pain. On examination, she has guaiac positive, dark brown, but 
not melenic stool. Which of the following must be excluded as a cause of hemorrhage?
englishExplanation:
This patient has an aortoenteric fistula until proven otherwise. The classic 
presentation is abdominal pain and GI bleeding that resolves spontaneously (the so-called 
herald bleed) in a patient with a prior history of aortic graft. The initial bleeding is thought to 
stop when splanchnic pressure drops and allows adequate clot to form. However, the initial 
bleed is often followed by a massive and often fatal hemorrhage days or possibly weeks later. 
The fistula is caused by S. aureus or Escherichia coli infection of the prior graft and typically 
forms between the aorta and the distal duodenum. Therefore, all patients with a history of 
aortic graft and GI bleeding should undergo esophagogastroduodenoscopy to search for a fistula 
in the distal duodenum. Most of these patients, however, have an alternative, more common 
cause of GI bleeding.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها aortoenteric fistula لحد ما يثبت العكس، لأن القصة الكلاسيكية هي ألم بالبطن مع نزيف معوي بوقف لحاله (اللي بنسميه herald bleed) عند مريض عنده تاريخ aortic graft سابق. النزيف الأولي بيوقف لما ينخفض الضغط ال splanchnic ويتكون clot كافي، بس بعدين عادةً بيجي نزيف ضخم وممكن يكون قاتل بعد أيام أو أسابيع. ال fistula بتنتج عن عدوى S. aureus أو E. coli لل graft وبتتكون عادةً بين الأ aorta وال duodenum البعيد.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Duodenal ulcer لأنه أكثر سبب شائع للنزيف الهضمي العلوي، بس وجود تاريخ aortic graft مع النزيف لازم يخليك تستبعد ال aortoenteric fistula أولًا. لازم تعمل esophagogastroduodenoscopy للبحث عن fistula بال duodenum البعيد.

question:
Which of the following oral medications is most likely to cause serious damage to the 
esophageal mucosa when swallowed?
englishExplanation:
Certain oral medications cause severe esophageal irritation when swallowed— 
doxycycline, tetracycline, aspirin, and potassium chloride. Of these, potassium chloride is the 
most caustic, sometimes leading to esophageal perforation and penetration into the mediastinal 
great vessels.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: في أدوية فموية معينة بتسبب تهيج شديد بالمريء لما تنبلع، زي ال doxycycline وال tetracycline وال aspirin وال potassium chloride. ومن بين كل هذول، ال potassium chloride هو الأكثر caustic، وممكن يوصل لدرجة esophageal perforation واختراق للأوعية الدموية الكبيرة في ال mediastinum. لهيك لازم ناخد بالنا من هالأدوية عند المرضى اللي عندهم مشاكل بالمريء.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Metoprolol أو Hydrochlorothiazide لأنهم أدوية شائعة، بس هذول ما بيعملوا تهيج شديد للمريء. التمييز إنه ال potassium chloride هو الأكثر تسببًا بالضرر وال perforation.

question:
A 45-year-old female presents with intermittent epigastric pain and nausea for several 
weeks. She denies fever, diarrhea, cough, and chest pain. She does not take medications, drink 
alcohol, or smoke. She has had an extensive workup including CT scan of the abdomen and 
pelvis, gall bladder ultrasound, and cardiac stress testing, all of which were normal. You suspect 
gastritis. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation:
Helicobacter pylori infection is the most common cause of gastritis and peptic ulcer 
disease. H. pylori is a gram-negative bacillus that causes gastric and duodenal mucosal 
inflammation. It is implicated in over half of all cases of gastritis and peptic ulcer disease. 
Treatment is with combinations of proton pump inhibitors and antibiotics (e.g., lansoprazole + 
amoxicillin +clarithromycin). The next most common cause of gastritis and peptic ulcer disease is 
NSAID use. Although the patient denies history of medication use, NSAIDs should be specifically 
queried about as patients frequently forget over-the-counter medications that they are taking. 
Alcohol can cause gastritis but usually in moderate to large quantities and regular use. 
Peppermint puts patients at risk for GERD exacerbations but does not usually cause frank 
gastritis. Radon gas exposure is likely the number one source of background ionizing radiation 
and puts patients at risk for lung cancer but does not usually directly cause gastritis.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: ال Helicobacter pylori infection هي السبب الأكثر شيوعًا لل gastritis و peptic ulcer disease، وهي بكتيريا gram-negative bacillus بتسبب التهاب بالمخاطية المعدية والاثنا عشرية. مسؤولة عن أكثر من نص حالات ال gastritis وال peptic ulcer disease، والعلاج بيكون kombinasyon من proton pump inhibitors مع مضادات حيوية زي lansoprazole مع amoxicillin و clarithromycin. المريضة ما بتاخد أدوية ولا بتشرب كحول، فالأسباب الثانية أقل احتمالًا.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا NSAID use لأنه السبب الثاني الأكثر شيوعًا، بس المريضة نفت استعمال الأدوية ولسا لازم نسألها بالتحديد عن ال over-the-counter NSAIDs لأن المرضى بينسوها. رغم هيك ال H. pylori ضل الاحتمال الأول.

question:
A 44-year-old alcoholic man presents with hematemesis. Which of the following is the most 
likely cause?
englishExplanation:
The most common cause of upper GI bleeding in both the general population and 
alcoholics is peptic ulcer disease. When combined with NSAIDs and other ulcerogenic drugs, 
alcohol can contribute to the loss of protective gastric mucosal lining. Treatment in alcoholics is 
the same as for nonalcoholics, with special attention to electrolyte management, prevention of 

alcohol withdrawal, and attention to seizure precautions. Gastric and esophageal varices occur 
at a higher rate in those alcoholics who have a history of portal hypertension from cirrhosis. 
Boerhaave syndrome refers to rupture of the esophagus from forceful vomiting. It usually occurs 
in alcoholics and presents more often as sepsis and hypovolemia due to mediastinitis rather 
than GI bleed. Arteriovenous malformation is a more common cause of lower GI bleed than 
upper GI bleed.

![subjects1200-7b8febb426d2b0b0 source page 138](images/subjects1200-7b8febb426d2b0b0-p0138.jpg)

![subjects1200-7b8febb426d2b0b0 source page 139](images/subjects1200-7b8febb426d2b0b0-p0139.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: السبب الأكثر شيوعًا للنزيف الهضمي العلوي عند الناس عمومًا وعند مدمني الكحول بالتحديد هو peptic ulcer disease. الكحول لما يتحد مع ال NSAIDs وأدوية قرحة ثانية بيساهم بفقدان الطبقة المخاطية الحامية للمعدة. العلاج عند مدمني الكحول نفس علاج غيرهم، بس لازم ننتبه على توازن ال electrolytes ومنع alcohol withdrawal وأخذ احتياطات ال seizure.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Esophageal varices لأنهم بيربطوا الكحول فورًا بال cirrhosis، بس ال varices بتحصل بمعدل أعلى بس عند اللي عندهم portal hypertension. ال Boerhaave syndrome بيجي أكتر ك sepsis و hypovolemia مش كنزيف هضمي.

question: Which of the following is an ingredient in sitz baths?
englishExplanation:
Sitz is a word that comes from the German word, sitzen, meaning “to sit.” A sitz bath 
refers to any device that allows a patient to immerse only the perineum and buttocks in water 
while draping the rest of their body outside the tub. While patients may add various 
medications to the water, it is not recommended and there is no evidence that such additives 
help. Sitz baths are thought to help a variety of perianal complaints, such as hemorrhoids, 
because anal canal pressure decreases significantly in warm water (40°C) and blood flow 
improves.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: كلمة sitz جاية من الكلمة الألمانية sitzen يعني يقعد، وال sitz bath هو أي أداة بتخلي المريض يغمر بس ال perineum والأرداف بالماء ويسيب باقي جسمه برا الحوض. ممكن المرضى يضيفوا أدوية مختلفة على الماء، بس هذا غير موصى فيه وما في دليل إنه هالإضافات بتفيد. ال sitz baths بتساعد لشكاوى perianal متعددة زي ال hemorrhoids لأن ضغط ال anal canal بينخفض بماء دافي 40 درجة وبتتحسن الدورة الدموية.
الفخ: الطلاب بيدوروا على إجابة صحيحة من الخيارات زي Baking soda أو Salicylate، بس الصح إنه ما في أي إضافة أساسية بال sitz bath. الجواب هو None of the above لأنه الماء وحده كافي.

question: Which of the following is true about gastric volvulus?

options.text: It is usually associated with a large umbilical hernia.
It most commonly results from twisting about its short axis.
It most commonly occurs in infants younger than 1 year.
In most cases, a nasogastric tube cannot be passed into the stomach.
Gastric infarction and death occur in 80% of patients if not rapidly diagnosed and treated.

correctAnswer: In most cases, a nasogastric tube cannot be passed into the stomach.
englishExplanation:
Gastric volvulus is a rare disorder that chiefly occurs in older people and results from 
twisting of the stomach about its long axis (organoaxial volvulus). Twenty percent of cases occur 
in infants younger than 1 year due to congenital diaphragmatic defects. In older people, it is 
frequently associated with large paraesophageal hiatal hernias. The classic triad is known as 
Borchardt triad, and consists of severe epigastric pain and abdominal distension, vomiting, and 
the inability to pass a nasogastric tube. If the diagnosis is suspected, the ED physicians should 
attempt to pass a nasogastric tube because this occasionally reduces the volvulus. Due to its 
redundant blood supply, gastric infarction is uncommon, even in delayed cases, occurring in as 
many as 25% of cases.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: gastric volvulus بيصير نتيجة التفاف المعدة حول محورها الطويل (organoaxial volvulus)، وهو disorder نادر بيصير أكتر عند كبار السن، و 20% من الحالات بتحصل عند رضع أصغر من سنة بسبب عيوب خلقية بالحجاب الحاجز. ال classic triad المعروفة باسم Borchardt triad بتتكون من ألم شديد بال epigastrium مع انتفاخ، و vomiting، وعدم القدرة على تمرير nasogastric tube للمعدة. عدم تمرير الأنبوب هو اللي بيعتبر علامة تشخيصية مهمة.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه gastric infarction والموت بيحصلوا بـ 80% من المرضى، بس هذا غلط لأن ال gastric infarction uncommon بسبب التغذية الدموية الغنية وبحصل بحوالي 25% بالحالات المتأخرة. كمان الغالبية بتحصل عند كبار السن مو الرضع.

question:
A 45-year-old obese woman presents with right upper quadrant abdominal pain for several 
weeks. Her pain is worse after she eats. Which of the following clinical features supports the 
diagnosis of biliary colic?

options.text: Colicky spasms of abdominal pain lasting 15 minutes
Radiation of pain to right shoulder
Antecedent use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)

correctAnswer: Radiation of pain to right shoulder
englishExplanation:
Biliary colic, also known as symptomatic cholelithiasis, refers to upper abdominal pain 
caused by gallstones. The name “colic” is actually a misnomer—biliary colic usually causes 
constant, steady pain occurring from 2 to 6 hours, often starting 1 to 2 hours after eating. 
“Colicky,” spasmodic pain is rare. Radiation of pain to the right scapula or shoulder increases the 
likelihood of biliary disease but is not at all sensitive. Biliary colic is no worse on eating protein, 
but may be worse after eating fatty foods. Fever is more characteristic of acute cholecystitis or 
other intra-abdominal inflammation rather than simple biliary colic. Antecedent use of NSAIDs 
supports a diagnosis of gastritis, peptic ulcer disease, or viscous perforation rather than biliary 
colic. Gallstone formation is, however, increased by fibrates, octreotide, oral contraceptive 
agents, and total parenteral nutrition.

![subjects1200-0182825d4886b244 source page 141](images/subjects1200-0182825d4886b244-p0141.jpg)

![subjects1200-0182825d4886b244 source page 142](images/subjects1200-0182825d4886b244-p0142.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: انتشار الألم لل right scapula أو الكتف بيرفع احتمال المرض البiliary، وهو من العلامات اللي بتدعم تشخيص biliary colic. وبالرغم من إنه اسمه colic، إلا إنه عادةً بيعمل ألم constant وثابت بستمر من 2 لـ 6 ساعات وبيبدأ من ساعة لساعتين بعد الأكل، والألم ال colicky spasmodic نادر. كمان الألم ممكن يزيد بعد الأكل الدهني مو البروتين.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Worsened pain on eating protein أو ال colicky spasms اللي بتستمر 15 دقيقة، بس ال biliary colic بتزيد مع الأكل الدهني مو البروتين، والألم عادةً constant مو spasmodic. الحرارة بتدل على cholecystitis مش على biliary colic البسيط.

question:
A 22-year-old Latino male who recently emigrated from Mexico presents to the ED with 
fever, chills, abdominal pain, and intermittent nausea and vomiting. A CT scan of his abdomen is 
shown in Figure below. Which of the following is true?

options.text: This condition requires immediate surgical drainage.
Hyperbilirubinemia is the most commonly abnormal laboratory finding.

englishExplanation:
Amebiasis occurs in 10% of the world’s population and amebic liver abscess is the 
most common extraintestinal manifestation of the disease. Patients with amebic liver abscesses 
more commonly have an acute presentation than patients with pyogenic liver abscesses. 

Transmission occurs through the fecal–oral route and is usually due to contaminated water or 
food products. Infections are always caused by Entamoeba histolytica and bacterial 
superinfections are uncommon. Alkaline phosphatase is elevated in 75% of patients and 
aminotransferases are increased in 50%. Elevated bilirubin levels are uncommon and reflect 
biliary obstruction. In contrast to pyogenic liver abscesses, the treatment is nonsurgical, and 
involves metronidazole 750 mg t.i.d. for 7 days. Following metronidazole, some authorities 
recommend an additional course of a luminal amebicide such as iodoquinol, diloxanide furoate, 
or paromomycin.

![subjects1200-52ca3f001d3f7956 source page 142](images/subjects1200-52ca3f001d3f7956-p0142.jpg)

![subjects1200-52ca3f001d3f7956 source page 143](images/subjects1200-52ca3f001d3f7956-p0143.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: ال amebic liver abscess هو الأكثر شيوعًا من المضاعفات اللي بتحصل برا الأمعاء عند مرضى ال amebiasis، واللي بتصيب 10% من سكان العالم. الانتقال بتحصل عن طريق ال fecal-oral route، وعادةً بسبب ماء أو أكل ملوث. العدوى دائمًا بتسببها Entamoeba histolytica وال bacterial superinfections نادرة، والعلاج غير جراحي عن طريق metronidazole.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه ال hyperbilirubinemia هي أكثر شاذ مخبري أو إنه بحاجة ل drainage جراحي فوري، بس ال bilirubin المرتفع uncommon وبيدل على انسداد صفراوي. العلاج هنا دوائي بال metronidazole مش جراحي بعكس ال pyogenic abscess.

question:
A 47-year-old male with a history of alcoholism presents with a chief complaint of jaundice, 
right upper quadrant pain, and a low-grade fever. He had his last drink earlier in the day. Which 
of the following is true?

options.text: His AST and ALT levels will be more than 10 times normal.
He should be transferred for immediate liver transplantation.
The patient’s fever suggests an infectious cause of his symptoms is most likely.
Reactive leukopenia is the most common cellular laboratory abnormality.
Hepatomegaly is the most common physical examination finding.

correctAnswer: Hepatomegaly is the most common physical examination finding.
englishExplanation:
This patient has acute alcoholic hepatitis. Although most cases of alcoholic hepatitis 
are subclinical or asymptomatic, it may be life threatening. Patients presenting for treatment 
are characterized by fever, right upper quadrant pain, jaundice, anorexia, and occasionally 
nausea and vomiting. Physical examination most commonly reveals hepatomegaly (as opposed 
to the shriveled, firm liver in patients with cirrhosis), jaundice, ascites, splenomegaly, and signs 
of alcohol withdrawal. AST and ALT levels are only modestly elevated, typically remaining below 
300 U/L, and the ratio of AST:ALT is usually greater than 2:1. Bilirubin levels are elevated but are 
variable depending on the severity of the disease. Leukocytosis is common, with a mean WBC 
count of 12,400 per mm3, whereas counts up to 20,000 are not uncommon. Fever is a common 
finding but concomitant infection is uncommon. Bilirubin levels and the prothrombin time (PT) 
have been classically used to stratify patients into low- or high-risk categories by calculating the 
Maddrey discriminant function. 
Discriminant function = 4.6 × (PT in seconds − control in seconds) + bilirubin (mg/dL). 
Levels over 32 correspond with severe disease and a 1-month mortality >50%.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده acute alcoholic hepatitis، والفحص السريري الأكثر شيوعًا فيه هو hepatomegaly، بعكس الكبد المتليف الصغير والصلب اللي بنشوفه بال cirrhosis. المريض بيجي عادةً مع حرارة وألم بال right upper quadrant و jaundice و anorexia. أما ال AST و ALT فبترتفع بشكل بسيط وعادةً بتضل أقل من 300 U/L، ونسبة AST:ALT عادةً أكبر من 2:1.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه ال AST و ALT بكونوا أكثر من 10 أضعاف الطبيعي زي ما بيصير بال hepatitis الفيروسي، بس هنا الارتفاع بسيط. كمان ال leukocytosis شائع مش ال leukopenia، والحرارة شائعة بس العدوى المرافقة uncommon.

question:
A 25-year-old male presents with bright red blood after having a bowel movement. He 
reports some itching and pain in his rectum. Examination reveals a nonthrombosed external 
hemorrhoid. Which of the following is the most appropriate, long-term management option?

options.text: Warm water, stool softeners, high-fiber diet

correctAnswer: Warm water, stool softeners, high-fiber diet
englishExplanation:
External hemorrhoids are best treated with nonpharmacologic therapies. The WASH 
regimen (warm water, analgesia, stool softeners, and high-fiber diet) is probably the most 
effective regimen and also the least likely to cause unacceptable side effects. Opioid pain relief 
without accompanying stool softeners is not recommended as they will further exacerbate 
constipation and straining. Topical corticosteroids can be used acutely (though little data exist 
for true benefit), but long-term use can cause skin atrophy. Topical nitroglycerin is used in 
patients with anal fissures but is not recommended in patients with non-thrombosed external 
hemorrhoids. Topical nifedipine may be used in anal fissures and thrombosed external 
hemorrhoids but is not recommended for non-thrombosed external hemorrhoids.

![subjects1200-ca7bc0a075473248 source page 144](images/subjects1200-ca7bc0a075473248-p0144.jpg)

![subjects1200-ca7bc0a075473248 source page 145](images/subjects1200-ca7bc0a075473248-p0145.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: ال nonthrombosed external hemorrhoids أفضل علاج إلها هو nonpharmacologic، وال WASH regimen (warm water مع analgesia و stool softeners و high-fiber diet) هو الفعال والأقل عرضة للأعراض الجانبية. ال warm water بتقلل ضغط ال anal canal وبتزيد تدفق الدم، وال stool softeners مع الألياف بيمنعوا الإمساك وال straining اللي بزيد الحالة. أما ال opioid pain relief بدون stool softeners فممنوع لأنه بزيد الإمساك سوءًا.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Topical corticosteroids أو Topical nitroglycerin، بس الستيرويدات الموضعية على المدى الطويل بتعمل skin atrophy، وال nitroglycerin مخصصة لل anal fissures مش لل hemorrhoids. الخيار الصحيح هو النهج غير الدوائي.

question:
A 42-year-old male with a history of alcohol abuse presents with acute epigastric abdominal 
pain. His workup reveals acute pancreatitis and he denies any prior history of pancreatitis. A CT 
scan that was ordered as part of his workup is shown in Figure below. Which of the following is 
true?

options.text: The CT is indicative of chronic pancreatitis.
An urgent surgical consult is required for drainage.
The patient should be given broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy.
This finding is common and normally resolves without intervention.

correctAnswer: This finding is common and normally resolves without intervention.
englishExplanation:
The CT scan reveals a hypodense fluid collection surrounding an inflamed pancreas. 
Acute fluid collection is associated with acute pancreatitis in 30% to 50% of patients. These fluid 
collections resolve spontaneously in most patients. A pseudocyst is a fluid collection that 
persists for 4 to 6 weeks and becomes encapsulated by a wall of fibrous or granulation tissue. 
Unless pancreatitis is due to an infectious agent, acute infection of fluid collections or of 
necrotic pancreatic tissue is uncommon. 
Infection usually occurs within the first 2 weeks although abscess formation may not occur until 
1 month after the acute infection. If an abscess does occur, urgent drainage is required.

![subjects1200-752d03679984883a source page 145](images/subjects1200-752d03679984883a-p0145.jpg)

![subjects1200-752d03679984883a source page 146](images/subjects1200-752d03679984883a-p0146.jpg)
arabicExplanation:
ليش: ال CT بيبين hypodense fluid collection حوالين pancreas ملتهبة، وهاي ال acute fluid collection بترافق ال acute pancreatitis في 30% لـ 50% من المرضى. وهالمجموعات السائلة بتحل لحالها spontaneously عند أغلب المرضى بدون أي تدخل. أما ال pseudocyst فهو مجموعة سائلة بتضل موجودة من 4 لـ 6 أسابيع وبتصير مغلفة بجدار من fibrous أو granulation tissue.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه العلامة بتزيد الوفيات 10 أضعاف أو إنه بحاجة ل drainage عاجل، بس ال drainage العاجل مطلوب بس لو صار abscess. العدوى بال collections نادرة إلا إذا السبب كان infectious، وأغلب الحالات بتحل spontaneously.

question:
A 15-year-old male presents with progressively worsening groin and scrotal pain and 
swelling over the last 8 hours. He noticed a bulge in his scrotum the day before when he lifted a 
heavy object. Physical examination demonstrates an afebrile patient with moderate abdominal 
tenderness and fullness, with bowel sounds present in his right hemiscrotum. The testes are not 
tender or enlarged. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.text: Ice pack to the groin and an attempt to reduce the mass

correctAnswer: Ice pack to the groin and an attempt to reduce the mass
englishExplanation:
The patient has evidence of an incarcerated hernia. The presence of fullness and 
bowel sounds in the scrotum indicates a hernia, and tenderness with inability to easily reduce 
the hernia indicates incarceration. Ice packs should be applied to the area to reduce the 
attendant bowel edema and an attempt should be made to reduce the hernia, under procedural 
sedation if necessary. Operative reduction is required if the hernia can’t be reduced. Operative 
reduction and IV antibiotics would also likely be necessary if the patient presented with signs of 
strangulation such as fever, acidosis, and/or severe tenderness. Outpatient referral for an 
incarcerated hernia is not appropriate. Oral hydration may maintain euvolemia, but the 
possibility of procedural sedation or surgery should preclude any oral intake. Incarcerated 
hernia is a clinical diagnosis and urinalysis will not aid diagnostic accuracy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض عنده incarcerated hernia، لأن وجود fullness وأصوات معوية بكيس الصفن بيدل على hernia، والألم مع عدم القدرة على رد الفتق بسهولة بيدل على ال incarceration. الخطوة الصح هي وضع ice pack على المنطقة لتقليل ال bowel edema ومحاولة رد الفتق، ولو لزم تحت procedural sedation. لو ما قدرنا نرد الفتق فساعتها بحتاج operative reduction.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Immediate operative reduction أو Urinalysis، بس الجراحة بتتطلب بس إذا فشلنا برد الفتق أو إذا ظهرت علامات strangulation زي الحرارة وال acidosis. ال incarcerated hernia تشخيص سريري وال urinalysis ما بتزيد دقة التشخيص.

question:
A 52-year-old female presents with right upper quadrant pain and fever for 2 days. The pain 
is unaffected by eating, but she states that it hurts to breathe and cough. Vital signs are 102.5°F, 
HR 110,RR 20, 165/92, 100% RA. She appears fatigued and in some pain. She does not have 
jaundice. Her lungs are clear. She has definite right upper quadrant tenderness without a 
positive Murphy sign. Chest radiography is normal. You order a right upper quadrant ultrasound, 
which shows a normal gall bladder, but a large, cavitary, fluid-filled lesion in her right hepatic 
lobe. Which of the following is the most likely etiology?
englishExplanation:
The patient has evidence of liver abscess, with fever, right upper quadrant pain, and 
the ultrasound findings. Pleuritic pain and cough are common and can confuse the clinical 
picture by seemingly supporting a pulmonary etiology. Liver abscesses are usually pyogenic 
(80%) but can be amebic (10% to 15%) or fungal (<10%). Pyogenic liver abscesses are usually due 
to biliary obstruction or cholangitis but can be caused by other intra-abdominal infections such 
as diverticulitis or appendicitis. Pyogenic liver abscesses are usually polymicrobial, with 
concurrent gram-negative, gram-positive, and anaerobic offenders. Antibiotic treatment should 
therefore be broad-spectrum. Sterile liver abscesses are extremely uncommon, occurring rarely 
in cases of hepatic vasculitis or rheumatologic diseases. E. histolytica is the cause of amebic liver 
abscesses, which are suspected in cases of foreign travel (often with a preceding intestinal 
illness) or oral–anal sexual contact causing fecal–oral contamination. Streptococci alone are not 
usually a cause of liver abscesses. Candidal infection represents less than 10% of all liver 
abscesses.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريضة عندها liver abscess، لأن عندها حرارة وألم بال right upper quadrant مع ultrasound بيبين cavitary fluid-filled lesion بال right hepatic lobe. ال pyogenic liver abscesses بتشكل 80% من الحالات وعادةً بتنتج عن انسداد صفراوي أو cholangitis، وبكونوا polymicrobial مع جراثيم gram-negative و gram-positive و anaerobic مع بعض. لهيك العلاج بالمضادات الحيوية لازم يكون broad-spectrum يغطي كل هالأنواع.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا Entamoeba histolytica لأنها بتعمل amebic abscess، بس هذول بيتشكوا فيهم بس عند وجود سفر للخارج أو intestinal illness سابق أو oral-anal contact. ال candidal infection أقل من 10% وال streptococci لوحدها نادرًا ما بتعمل abscess.

question:
A 57-year-old male with a history of alcoholism and esophageal varices presents after two 
episodes of bloody emesis. Which of the following is true?

options.text: The patient can be discharged if he has a negative nasogastric (NG) tube lavage, stable vital
IV fluids should be given cautiously to avoid over dilution of hemoglobin
Patients requiring a transfusion should receive blood products to achieve a hemoglobin ≥10
Intravenous proton pump inhibitors and somatostatin analogues may be helpful

correctAnswer: Intravenous proton pump inhibitors and somatostatin analogues may be helpful
englishExplanation:
There are few differences in the ED management of patients with presumed variceal 
upper GI hemorrhage compared to other causes of upper GI bleeding. The initial focus is on 
stabilizing unstable patients with intravenous fluids and blood products as needed to maintain a 
target hemoglobin >7 g/dL unless patients are at high risk for, or have evidence of, cardiac 
ischemia or other end-organ dysfunction attributable to anemia. NG tube lavage has not been 
clearly shown to be useful. While a frankly positive lavage predicts high risk lesions, a negative 
lavage does not conclusively rule them out. IV fluids may dilute the hemoglobin concentration 
but they don’t diminish the actual hemoglobin content (and thus, the oxygen carrying capacity 
of blood). While intravenous proton pump inhibitors and somatostatin analogues may not offer 

a significant mortality benefit to patients, they are well tolerated with few significant side 
effects. Their use may be helpful, possibly in consultation with a gastroenterologist who will be 
performing esophagoduodenoscopy.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الادارة الأولية لمريض variceal upper GI hemorrhage بتركز على تثبيت الحالة ب IV fluids و blood products حسب الحاجة للحفاظ على hemoglobin أعلى من 7 g/dL، إلا لو كان عنده خطورة cardiac ischemia. وال intravenous proton pump inhibitors وال somatostatin analogues ممكن يكونوا مفيدين، وهنّ well tolerated مع أعراض جانبية قليلة، وممكن نستعملهم بالتشاور مع ال gastroenterologist اللي بيعمل ال esophagoduodenoscopy.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه المريض ممكن ينصر iف لو كان ال NG tube lavage سلبي، بس هال lavage ما ثبتت فايدتها والنتيجة السلبية ما بتستبعد وجود lesions خطيرة. كمان ال IV fluids ما بتقلل محتوى ال hemoglobin الفعلي وقدرة الدم على نقل الأكسجين.

question: Which of the following is true regarding irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)?

options.text: It is more common in men than in women.
Pain associated with IBS is usually relieved with defecation.
IBS is most commonly caused by unrecognized food allergies.

correctAnswer: Pain associated with IBS is usually relieved with defecation.
englishExplanation:
IBS is a common, chronic GI illness characterized by abdominal pain or discomfort, 
bloating, and either constipation or diarrhea. Although it is not a psychiatric diagnosis, patients 
with IBS more commonly have a concomitant psychiatric diagnosis (most commonly anxiety or 
depression). The cause of IBS is not known, but it is not related to food allergies. It is at least 
twice as common in women as in men. Although there are several clinical criteria for the 
disease, one well known set of criteria (the Rome II criteria) includes abdominal pain that is 
relieved after defecation as necessary for a diagnosis of IBS.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: ال IBS هو مرض معوي مزمن شائع بيتميز بألم أو عدم راحة بالبطن وانتفاخ مع إمساك أو إسهال. من معايير Rome II المعروفة إنه الألم اللي بيرتاح بعد ال defecation بيعتبر ضروري لتشخيص ال IBS. يعني ارتباط الألم بال defecation وارتياحه بعدها من العلامات المميزة للمرض.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه IBS تشخيص نفسي أو إنه ناتج عن حساسية أكل غير معروفة، وكلاهما غلط. صحيح إنه مرضى IBS أكتر عرضة لتشخيص نفسي مرافق زي ال anxiety و depression، بس السبب مجهول وغير مرتبط بحساسية الطعام.

question: Which of the following is true regarding inflammatory bowel disease?

options.text: Toxic megacolon is more common in patients with Crohn disease than ulcerative colitis.
Perianal complications are most common in patients with Crohn disease.
Crohn disease always involves the rectum.
Erythema nodosum is most common in male patients with ulcerative colitis.
Anal fissures in patients with Crohn disease tend to be located in the posterior midline.

correctAnswer: Perianal complications are most common in patients with Crohn disease.
englishExplanation:
Although rectal involvement is uncommon in patients with Crohn disease and nearly 
universal in patients with ulcerative colitis, perianal complications are much more common in 
patients with Crohn disease. The anal canal is the most terminal segment of the large intestine. 
In approximately 25% of patients with Crohn disease, perianal complications may occur before 
the onset of overt disease. Toxic megacolon is more common in patients with ulcerative colitis. 
Erythema nodosum occurs most often in women patients with Crohn disease. Anal fissures 
associated with Crohn disease are typically eccentrically located. In patients without Crohn 
disease, more than 90% of fissures are located in the posterior midline.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: بالرغم من إنه إصابة ال rectum uncommon عند مرضى Crohn disease وشبه عالمية عند مرضى ulcerative colitis، إلا إنه ال perianal complications أكثر بكثير عند مرضى Crohn disease. وفي حوالي 25% من مرضى Crohn ممكن ال perianal complications تظهر قبل بداية المرض الواضح. أما ال toxic megacolon فأكثر شيوعًا عند مرضى ulcerative colitis.
الفخ: الطلاب بيختاروا إنه ال anal fissures بمريض Crohn بتقع بال posterior midline، بس هذا صحيح للناس بدون Crohn (أكثر من 90%). شقوق Crohn عادةً بتقع بشكل eccentric، وال erythema nodosum أكتر عند النساء مش الرجال.

question: Which of the following is true about peptic ulcer disease?

options.text: Pain that wakes patients in the middle of night is typical of duodenal ulcers.
The incidence of bleeding from gastric ulcers is approximately two times that of duodenal
Helicobacter pylori is the major risk factor linked to the development of duodenal ulcers but
Barium contrast is the diagnostic study of choice to diagnose peptic ulcer disease.
Only 50% of those people infected with H. pylori will develop a peptic ulcer in their lifetime.

correctAnswer: Pain that wakes patients in the middle of night is typical of duodenal ulcers.
englishExplanation:
The pain of duodenal ulcers is usually described as a burning or gnawing epigastric 
sensation that is decreased with food or antacids. The pain typically occurs 2 to 3 hours after a 
meal. Classically, two-third of patients with duodenal ulcers describe pain that wakes them from 
sleep in the middle of the night, although few patients have pain on waking in the morning. The 
pain of gastric ulcers tends to occur more quickly after meals and may even be precipitated by 

food in some patients. Therefore, anorexia and weight loss occur in approximately 50% of 
patients with gastric ulcers but rarely occur in patients with duodenal ulcers. Duodenal ulcers 
are twice as likely to be complicated by bleeding as gastric ulcers. H. pylori, although more 
commonly found in the setting of duodenal ulcers, is the major risk factor for the development 
of either type of ulcer. Flexible endoscopy is the diagnostic study of choice for peptic ulcer 
disease. Finally, only 15% to 20% of patients colonized with H. pylori will develop a peptic ulcer 
in their lifetime.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الجواب الصحيح هو إنه ألم duodenal ulcer عادةً يجي كإحساس حارق أو قارض بالـ epigastrium ويهدأ لما ياكل المريض أو ياخد antacids، والوجع ببلش بعد الأكل بساعتين لثلاث ساعات. وكلاسيكياً ثلثين مرضى duodenal ulcer يوصفوا وجع بيصحّيهم من النوم نص الليل، وشوي مرضى بس عندهم وجع الصبح أول ما يفيقوا. أما gastric ulcer فالوجع يجي أسرع بعد الأكل وأحياناً يزيد مع الأكل نفسه، عشان هيك anorexia وweight loss تصير عند حوالي 50% من مرضى gastric ulcer بس نادراً عند مرضى duodenal ulcer.
الفخ: كتير طلاب يختاروا إن الـ barium contrast هو التشخيص المفضل، بس الصحيح إن flexible endoscopy هو diagnostic study of choice للـ peptic ulcer disease، فخلي بالك من اللي بنص السؤال.

question:
Which of the following is the major pathophysiologic mechanism in gastroesophageal reflux 
disease (GERD)?
englishExplanation:
While all mechanisms contribute to GERD, lower esophageal dysfunction is the major 
one. This underscores the importance of behavioral changes in the management of GERD. While 
proton pump inhibitors and antihistamines are important to reduce acid production, reduction 
in smoking, alcohol intake, caffeine use, fatty foods, and large meals, exercise and lying down 
immediately after eating is also necessary for successful treatment.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: كل الميكانيزمات اللي بالسؤال بتساهم بالـ GERD، بس النقص بمستوى lower esophageal sphincter هو الميكانيزم الرئيسي واللي عليه العمود الفقري بالمرض. وهاد الشي بفسّر ليش التعديلات السلوكية مهمة جداً بالعلاج، لأنه لازم نقلل smoking وalcohol وcaffeine والدهون والوجبات الكبيرة، وكمان الرياضة والاستلقاء فوراً بعد الأكل. يعني حتى مع استخدام proton pump inhibitors والـ antihistamines لتقليل حمض المعدة، بدون تغيير هالسلوكيات العلاج ما بينجح كفاية.
الفخ: بعض الطلاب يختاروا increased gastric acid production لأنه بفكروا الحمض هو المشكلة الأساسية، بس الصحيح إن dismotility بالـ lower esophageal sphincter هو المحور، والحمض عامل مساعد بس.

question: Which of the following is true about volvulus?

options.text: Plain films are more often diagnostic in cases of cecal volvulus than sigmoid volvulus.
Reduction of cecal volvulus is best achieved endoscopically.
Cecal volvulus is diagnosed by visualizing a massively dilated cecum in the left upper quadrant
Cecal volvulus is more common than sigmoid volvulus.
Cecal volvulus is most common in patients aged 25 to 35 years.

correctAnswer: Cecal volvulus is diagnosed by visualizing a massively dilated cecum in the left upper quadrant
englishExplanation:
Sigmoid volvulus accounts for 75% of volvulus cases, whereas cecal volvulus accounts 
for the remaining 25%. Although patients with cecal volvulus are younger than patients with 
sigmoid volvulus, they are not young, as affected patients are typically in their late fifties. Plain 
films are diagnostic in 80% of cases of sigmoid volvulus but <50% of cases of cecal volvulus. The 

classic findings of cecal volvulus include a massively dilated cecum typically in the left upper 
quadrant or epigastrium (i.e., not within the right abdomen). Although selected patients with 
sigmoid volvulus may be candidates for endoscopic reduction, patients with cecal volvulus 
almost always require surgical repair due to the difficulty of accessing this area endoscopically 
and the need for cecopexy to prevent recurrence.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ cecal volvulus بيتشخص لما نشوف الـ cecum متوسّع بشكل ضخم وموجود بالـ left upper quadrant أو بالـ epigastrium، يعني ما بيكون بالجهة اليمنى من البطن. ونحنا نعرف إن cecal volvulus بيشكل 25% من حالات volvulus بس، بينما sigmoid volvulus بيشكل 75%. وكمان الـ plain films بتشخّص 80% من حالات sigmoid volvulus بينما أقل من 50% من حالات cecal volvulus. وعشان الوصول للـ cecum بالمنظار صعب ولازم cecopexy عشان نمنع الرجعة، فمرضى cecal volvulus غالباً بحتاجوا جراحة.
الفخ: طلاب كتير يختاروا إن reduction بالمنظار هو الأفضل، بس هاد للـ sigmoid volvulus بس، لأن cecal volvulus صعب نوصلّه endoscopically وبيحتاج surgical repair.

question:
What is the sensitivity of plain abdominal radiographs for the diagnosis of small bowel 
obstruction (SBO)?
englishExplanation:
Abdominal radiography is generally considered the first-line imaging modality to 
evaluate patients with suspected SBO. The sensitivity of plain radiography is about 75%. If 
radiographs are normal, but the diagnosis of SBO is still suspected clinically, then CT 
abdomen/pelvis, with both sensitivity and specificity of over 85%, can be used to confirm the 
diagnosis. CT also identifies many causes of SBO (such as volvulus or intussusception), other 
diagnoses in the differential of SBO, and complications such as closed-loop obstruction. To avoid 
unnecessary ionizing radiation, use of abdominal radiography is most efficient in patients with 
known prior SBOs who present with typical signs and symptoms without systemic toxicity or 
severe focal tenderness (which could indicate a closed-loop process).
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ abdominal radiography هي أول خط تصوير لمريض suspected SBO، وحساسيتها حوالي 75%. فإذا طلعت الصورة طبيعية بس لسا الشك سريري بوجود SBO، منروح للـ CT abdomen/pelvis اللي حساسيتها وخصوصيتها فوق 85% ومنأكد التشخيص. وكمان الـ CT بيكشف أسباب SBO متل volvulus أو intussusception، وبكشف التشاخيص التفريقية والت complications متل closed-loop obstruction. وعشان نتجنب radiation زيادة، الـ radiography بتكون أكفأ عند مريض عندو SBO سابق وبجي بأعراض نموذجية بدون toxicity أو focal tenderness شديد.
الفخ: ممكن الطالب يفكر إن الحساسية 90% أو 100%، بس الرقم الصحيح 75%، وتذكّر إن الـ CT هي اللي بتوصل فوق 85%.

question:
A 46-year-old female presents with a large amount of bright red bloody stool. In the ED she 
experiences another episode of significant rectal bleeding. The most likely underlying cause is:
englishExplanation:
Diverticulosis is the most common cause of lower gastrointestinal bleeding (LGIB), 
which may be massive in 5% of cases. However, most cases of LGIB due to diverticulosis are mild 
and resolve without intervention. Interestingly, although most diverticula are located in the left 
(descending) or sigmoid colon, most bleeding diverticula are located in the right colon. This is 
fortuitous, because most cases of angiodysplasia, a common cause of severe LGIB in the elderly, 
are also located in the right colon. Angiographic studies performed to localize bleeding, 
therefore, canalize the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) first.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ diverticulosis هو أكثر سبب شائع للـ lower gastrointestinal bleeding، وفي 5% من الحالات بيكون النزف ضخم كتير. بس الحقيقة اللطيفة إنه رغم إن أغلب diverticula موجودة بالـ left أو sigmoid colon، أغلب اللي بتنزف موجودة بالـ right colon. وهاد من حسن الحظ لأنه أكثر حالات angiodysplasia كمان بالـ right colon، فلهيك الـ angiographic studies للـ localize النزف بيدخلوا على الـ superior mesenteric artery أول شي. وعمرها 46 سنة بتوافق هالتشخيص كسبب شائع للنزف السفلي.
الفخ: طلاب كتير يختاروا angiodysplasia، وهي فعلاً سبب مهم بس غالباً بالمسنين ومع نزف شديد متكرر، بينما diverticulosis هو الأكثر شيوعاً بشكل عام.

question:
A 56-year-old male presents with postoperative bloating. The consulting surgeon suspects an 
ileus. Which of the following lab findings is most likely contributing to the patient’s symptoms?
englishExplanation:
Postoperative ileus is a common, expected outcome after laparotomy. However, 
multiple electrolyte abnormalities may also cause or exacerbate the condition. Hypokalemia is 
the most common electrolyte abnormality responsible for ileus, though hypomagnesemia, 
hyponatremia, hypocalcemia, and uremia may also contribute.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ postoperative ileus حالة شائعة ومتوقعة بعد laparotomy، بس فيه اضطرابات كتير بالشوارد ممكن تسببه أو تزيده. والـ hypokalemia هو أكثر اضطراب شوارد مسؤول عن الـ ileus. وكمان الـ hypomagnesemia وhyponatremia وhypocalcemia والـ uremia ممكن تساهم بالحالة. فعشان هيك مريض بعد العملية وعندو bloating لازم نفكر بالـ hypokalemia أول شي ونصحّح الشوارد لأنه تصحيحها جزء أساسي من العلاج.
الفخ: ممكن الطالب يختار uremia أو hypomagnesemia لأنهما مذكورين بالسؤال، بس الأكثر شيوعاً وأقوى عامل هو hypokalemia، فخليها أول الاحتمالات.

question:
A 54-year-old male with a history of chronic alcohol abuse is brought in by his wife because 
of a “big stomach” and confusion. She tells you his stomach has been big for 1 year but over the 
last month she adds that he seems to be forgetting things, has had difficulty sleeping, and has 
not been tending to his own appearance. Which of the following is true?

options.text: Ammonia levels correlate with the severity of his illness.
The most common finding on CT of the brain is hydrocephalus.
Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis is the most common precipitant.
Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding may exacerbate or trigger this condition.
The treatment of choice is ceftriaxone.

correctAnswer: Gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding may exacerbate or trigger this condition.
englishExplanation:
This patient is manifesting signs of hepatic encephalopathy (HE). HE is graded on a 
four stage scale, and its symptoms range from subtle personality changes and sleep 
disturbances to confusion, disorientation, stupor, and coma. Although elevated ammonia levels 
may support the diagnosis, they do not always correlate with the severity of illness and normal 

levels do not exclude the diagnosis. Roughly 25% of patients will have non-nitrogenous causes of 
encephalopathy. However, azotemia is the most common precipitant and GI bleeding is a very 
common cause of azotemia and may frequently trigger or exacerbate HE. The treatment of 
choice is ammonia-lowering therapy with lactulose, or with neomycin in the case of 
azotemia-induced causes. Otherwise, treatment should be directed at the underlying 
precipitant.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: المريض هاد عندو manifestations الـ hepatic encephalopathy، لأن عندو استسقاء كبير من سنة ومع الشهر الأخير صار ينسى ويعاني من اضطراب بالنوم وما بمهتم بمظهره. والـ ammonia المرتفع بيدعم التشخيص بس ما بيتوافق دايماً مع شدة المرض، والمستوى الطبيعي ما بنفي التشخيص. والـ azotemia هو أكثر precipitants شيوعاً، والـ GI bleeding سبب شائع كتير للـ azotemia وبيقدر يثير أو يزيد الـ HE. والعلاج المفضل هو lactulose لخفض الأمونيا، أو neomycin لو السبب azotemia، وإلا فوقتها العلاج موجّه للسبب الأساسي.
الفخ: طلاب كتير يختاروا إن الـ ammonia بيتوافق مع شدة المرض، وهاد غلط لأنه ما بينعكس دايماً على الشدة، وكتير مرضى عندهم أسباب non-nitrogenous.

question:
A 55-year-old male presents from his doctor’s office with nausea, vomiting, right upper 
quadrant pain, and abnormal outpatient labs. Which of the following is consistent with alcoholic 
hepatitis?
englishExplanation:
Alcoholic hepatitis is a type of acute ethanol-induced liver disease. Patients usually 
experience nonspecific symptoms such as fever, myalgias, nausea, and vomiting, in addition to 
the more specific sign of right upper quadrant tenderness. Laboratory work often shows mild 
elevations of WBC count, transaminases, and PT. Significant elevations of transaminases are far 
more likely to be seen in viral or drug-induced hepatitis. Most patients who have acute alcoholic 
hepatitis have a chronic history of alcohol abuse and are usually magnesium-deficient. 
Treatment of alcoholic hepatitis involves symptom control, intravenous fluids, correction of 
electrolyte abnormalities, and supplementation with thiamine and glucose.
arabicExplanation:
ليش: الـ alcoholic hepatitis هو نوع من أمراض الكبد الحادة الناتجة عن الإيثانول، والمريض بيجي بأعراض غير نوعية متل fever وmyalgias وnausea وvomiting مع tenderness بالـ right upper quadrant. والتحاليل عادةً بتورّي ارتفاع بسيط بالـ WBC count والـ transaminases والـ PT، يعني الـ leukocytosis من ضمن الصورة. أما الارتفاع الكبير بالـ transaminases فهو أكثر احتمالاً بالـ viral أو drug-induced hepatitis. وأغلب مرضى alcoholic hepatitis عندهم تاريخ مزمن مع الخمر وبنقص magnesium، والعلاج بتركز على الأعراض والسوائل وتصحيح الشوارد وthiamine وglucose.
الفخ: ممكن الطالب يختار AST أو ALT فوق 20 ضعف الطبيعي، بس هالارتفاع الضخم بشير للـ viral أو drug-induced hepatitis مو للكحولي.

question:
A 22-year-old male presents for substernal chest burning for several weeks which is worse 
after eating. He denies fever, cough, or shortness of breath. He does not smoke, drink alcohol, 
drink caffeine, or take over-the-counter nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). His only 
medication is a pill for acne. His physical examination, chest x-ray, and EKG are normal. Which of 
the following is the most likely cause?
englishExplanation:
Given his history of acne, he is very likely taking doxycycline, which is a common 
cause of pill esophagitis. Other medications that cause pill esophagitis include aspirin and 
NSAIDs, iron supplements, and bisphosphonates. Symptomatology is the same as that for 
gastroesophageal reflux disease. Pill esophagitis can be treated supportively or with proton 
pump inhibitors. Prevention by drinking a full glass of water with the offending medication is 
useful. Pneumonia is less likely given the lack of dyspnea, fever, cough, crackles, or chest x-ray 
abnormality. Asthma would be unlikely without cough or shortness of breath. Pericarditis is 
possible but usually causes some positional changes or EKG abnormalities, sometimes with an 
antecedent viral syndrome. Psychogenic somatic symptoms should be a diagnosis of exclusion.
